नीचे दिए गए चार ग्राफों (चित्र 3.1) में से केवल एक ही ग्राफ ऐसा है जिसके लिए समय अंतराल \((0, T)\) में किसी उपयुक्त \(T\) के लिए औसत वेग शून्य हो सकता है। वह ग्राफ कौन-सा है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Four position-time (\(x\)-\(t\)) graphs are given for motion starting at \(t = 0\). We need to identify the graph for which the average velocity over \((0, T)\) can be zero for some \(T > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Position \(x\) is plotted along the vertical axis and time \(t\) along the horizontal axis. The initial position is \(x(0)\) at \(t = 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Average velocity over the time interval \((0, T)\) is given by: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T - 0} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] For \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) with \(T > 0\), we must have \(x(T) = x(0)\). Geometrically, a horizontal line drawn from \((0, x(0))\) parallel to the time axis must intersect the \(x\)-\(t\) curve at some \(t = T > 0\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
In the first graph, \(x\) starts at a negative value, increases, crosses zero, and remains positive, never returning to its initial negative value. In the third graph, \(x\) decreases monotonically from a positive value, so \(x(T) < x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\). In the fourth graph, \(x\) increases monotonically from zero, so \(x(T) > x(0)\) for all \(T > 0\). Only in the second graph does \(x\) start at a positive value \(x(0) > 0\), rise to a maximum, and then decrease below \(x(0)\), intersecting the horizontal line \(x = x(0)\) at some \(T > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(x(T) = x(0)\) at the intersection time \(T > 0\), the net displacement is zero and hence the average velocity vanishes. Thus, the graph that starts at a positive \(x(0)\), rises to a peak, and then falls below \(x(0)\) is the correct graph.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
\(t = 0\) से प्रारंभ होने वाली गति के लिए चार स्थिति-समय (\(x\)-\(t\)) ग्राफ दिए गए हैं। हमें वह ग्राफ पहचानना है जिसके लिए किसी \(T > 0\) के लिए \((0, T)\) अंतराल में औसत वेग शून्य हो सकता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
स्थिति \(x\) ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर और समय \(t\) क्षैतिज अक्ष पर अंकित है। \(t = 0\) पर प्रारंभिक स्थिति \(x(0)\) है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
समय अंतराल \((0, T)\) में औसत वेग का सूत्र है: \[v_{\text{avg}} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T - 0} = \frac{x(T) - x(0)}{T}\] \(T > 0\) के साथ \(v_{\text{avg}} = 0\) होने के लिए \(x(T) = x(0)\) होना आवश्यक है। ज्यामितीय रूप से, \((0, x(0))\) से समय अक्ष के समानांतर खींची गई क्षैतिज रेखा को किसी \(t = T > 0\) पर \(x\)-\(t\) वक्र को प्रतिच्छेद करना चाहिए।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
पहले ग्राफ में \(x\) ऋणात्मक मान से शुरू होकर बढ़ता है, शून्य को पार करता है और धनात्मक बना रहता है, अतः कभी प्रारंभिक ऋणात्मक मान पर नहीं लौटता। तीसरे ग्राफ में \(x\) एक धनात्मक मान से एकदिष्ट रूप से घटता है, इसलिए सभी \(T > 0\) के लिए \(x(T) < x(0)\) रहता है। चौथे ग्राफ में \(x\) शून्य से एकदिष्ट रूप से बढ़ता है, इसलिए सभी \(T > 0\) के लिए \(x(T) > x(0)\) रहता है। केवल दूसरे ग्राफ में \(x\) एक धनात्मक मान \(x(0) > 0\) से शुरू होकर अधिकतम तक बढ़ता है और फिर \(x(0)\) से नीचे गिरता है, जिससे यह किसी \(T > 0\) पर \(x = x(0)\) की क्षैतिज रेखा को काटता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
चूँकि प्रतिच्छेदन समय \(T > 0\) पर \(x(T) = x(0)\) है, इसलिए कुल विस्थापन शून्य है और औसत वेग शून्य हो जाता है। अतः वह ग्राफ जो धनात्मक \(x(0)\) से शुरू होकर शिखर तक जाता है और फिर \(x(0)\) से नीचे गिरता है, सही उत्तर है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q02 - Signs of displacement velocity acceleration for lift

questiontext.text:
A lift is coming from 8th floor and is just about to reach 4th floor. Taking ground floor as origin and positive direction upwards for all quantities, which one of the following is correct?

एक लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से आ रही है और 4वीं मंजिल पर पहुँचने ही वाली है। भूतल को मूल बिंदु तथा सभी राशियों के लिए ऊपर की दिशा को धनात्मक मानने पर, निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The lift moves from the 8th floor downwards and is just about to stop at the 4th floor.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The upward direction is taken as positive and the downward direction as negative. Following the standard convention for displacement from the starting floor (8th floor), downward displacement is negative.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Velocity \(v\) is in the direction of motion. When an object slows down (retards), its acceleration \(a\) is directed opposite to its velocity \(v\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since the lift is moving downwards from the 8th floor towards the 4th floor, its displacement \(x\) is downwards, so \(x < 0\). Its velocity is also directed downwards, so \(v < 0\). Because it is just about to reach the 4th floor and stop, it is decelerating; therefore, the acceleration acts in the upward direction, giving \(a > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Combining the signs, we obtain \(x < 0\), \(v < 0\), and \(a > 0\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से नीचे की ओर आ रही है और 4वीं मंजिल पर रुकने ही वाली है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
ऊपर की दिशा को धनात्मक और नीचे की दिशा को ऋणात्मक माना गया है। प्रारंभिक मंजिल (8वीं मंजिल) से विस्थापन के लिए नीचे की ओर विस्थापन ऋणात्मक लिया जाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
वेग \(v\) गति की दिशा में होता है। जब कोई वस्तु मंदित होती है (धीमी होती है), तो उसका त्वरण \(a\) उसके वेग \(v\) की विपरीत दिशा में होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
चूँकि लिफ्ट 8वीं मंजिल से 4वीं मंजिल की ओर नीचे आ रही है, इसका विस्थापन \(x\) नीचे की ओर है, इसलिए \(x < 0\) है। इसका वेग भी नीचे की ओर है, अतः \(v < 0\) है। चूँकि यह 4वीं मंजिल पर पहुँचकर रुकने ही वाली है, यह मंदित हो रही है; इसलिए त्वरण ऊपर की दिशा में कार्य करता है, जिससे \(a > 0\) प्राप्त होता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
सभी चिह्नों को संयोजित करने पर हमें \(x < 0\), \(v < 0\), और \(a > 0\) प्राप्त होता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q03 - Bounds on displacement from bounded speed

questiontext.text:
In one dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v\) satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\).

एकविमीय गति में, तात्क्षणिक चाल \(v\) संबंध \(0 \le v < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करती है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
For a particle in one-dimensional motion, the instantaneous speed satisfies \(0 \le v < v_0\) over a time interval \(T\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Motion can occur in either the positive or negative direction along the line. Thus, the instantaneous velocity \(v_x\) satisfies \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) is the time integral of instantaneous velocity: \[x = \int_0^T v_x \, dt\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) at every instant, integrating over the interval \(0\) to \(T\) gives: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_x \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt \implies -v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] Displacement can be negative if the particle moves in the negative direction, acceleration can be negative when slowing down or speeding up in the negative direction, and turning points can exist where \(v = 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The bounds have units of length and hold regardless of direction changes. Therefore, the displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
एकविमीय गति कर रहे कण के लिए, समय अंतराल \(T\) में तात्क्षणिक चाल \(0 \le v < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करती है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
गति रेखा के अनुदिश धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक किसी भी दिशा में हो सकती है। अतः तात्क्षणिक वेग \(v_x\) संबंध \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) को संतुष्ट करता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
समय \(T\) में विस्थापन \(x\), तात्क्षणिक वेग का समय समाकल होता है: \[x = \int_0^T v_x \, dt\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
चूँकि प्रत्येक क्षण \(-v_0 < v_x < v_0\) है, इसलिए \(0\) से \(T\) तक समाकलन करने पर प्राप्त होता है: \[\int_0^T (-v_0) \, dt < \int_0^T v_x \, dt < \int_0^T v_0 \, dt \implies -v_0 T < x < v_0 T\] यदि कण ऋणात्मक दिशा में चलता है तो विस्थापन ऋणात्मक हो सकता है, त्वरण भी ऋणात्मक हो सकता है, और जहाँ \(v = 0\) हो वहाँ मोड़ बिंदु (turning points) भी हो सकते हैं।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
सीमाओं की इकाई लंबाई की है और ये दिशा परिवर्तन से स्वतंत्र हैं। अतः समय \(T\) में विस्थापन \(x\), \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\) को संतुष्ट करता है।

answer.text: The displacement in time \(T\) must always take non-negative values.
The displacement \(x\) in time \(T\) satisfies \(-v_0 T < x < v_0 T\).
The acceleration is always a non-negative number.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q04 - Average speed for equal half distances

questiontext.text:
A vehicle travels half the distance \(L\) with speed \(V_1\) and the other half with speed \(V_2\), then its average speed is

एक वाहन आधी दूरी \(L/2\) को \(V_1\) चाल से तथा शेष आधी दूरी को \(V_2\) चाल से तय करता है, तो इसकी औसत चाल है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Total distance \(= L\). First half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is covered at speed \(V_1\), and the second half distance \(= \frac{L}{2}\) is covered at speed \(V_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Speeds \(V_1\) and \(V_2\) are positive scalar quantities.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[\text{Average speed} = \frac{\text{Total distance}}{\text{Total time}}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Time taken for the first half: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\). Time taken for the second half: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\). Total time: \[T = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] Average speed: \[V_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{T} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
If \(V_1 = V_2 = V\), the formula reduces to \(V\), which is consistent. Thus, the average speed is \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
कुल दूरी \(= L\)। पहली आधी दूरी \(= \frac{L}{2}\) चाल \(V_1\) से और दूसरी आधी दूरी \(= \frac{L}{2}\) चाल \(V_2\) से तय की जाती है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
चाल \(V_1\) और \(V_2\) धनात्मक अदिश राशियाँ हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\[\text{औसत चाल} = \frac{\text{कुल दूरी}}{\text{कुल समय}}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
पहली आधी दूरी तय करने में लगा समय: \(t_1 = \frac{L/2}{V_1} = \frac{L}{2V_1}\)। दूसरी आधी दूरी तय करने में लगा समय: \(t_2 = \frac{L/2}{V_2} = \frac{L}{2V_2}\)। कुल समय: \[T = t_1 + t_2 = \frac{L}{2V_1} + \frac{L}{2V_2} = \frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}\] औसत चाल: \[V_{\text{avg}} = \frac{L}{T} = \frac{L}{\frac{L(V_1 + V_2)}{2V_1 V_2}} = \frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\]

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यदि \(V_1 = V_2 = V\) हो, तो सूत्र से \(V\) प्राप्त होता है, जो संगत है। अतः औसत चाल \(\frac{2V_1 V_2}{V_1 + V_2}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q05 - Distance covered with direction reversal

questiontext.text:
The displacement of a particle is given by \(x = (t - 2)^2\) where \(x\) is in metres and \(t\) in seconds. The distance covered by the particle in first \(4\) seconds is

एक कण का विस्थापन \(x = (t - 2)^2\) द्वारा दिया गया है, जहाँ \(x\) मीटर में और \(t\) सेकंड में है। प्रथम \(4\) सेकंड में कण द्वारा तय की गई दूरी है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Position function: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), time interval: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Distance is the total path length travelled, regardless of direction, so we must check whether the particle reverses direction during the interval.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Instantaneous velocity is \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\). Distance covered in an interval is \(\int |v| \, dt\), or the sum of magnitudes of displacements between turning points.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Differentiating \(x(t)\): \[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt} = 2(t - 2)\] Setting \(v(t) = 0\) gives \(t = 2\text{ s}\), which lies within \((0, 4)\text{ s}\). Now evaluate \(x\) at \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\), and \(t = 4\): \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] Distance from \(t = 0\) to \(t = 2\text{ s}\): \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\). Distance from \(t = 2\) to \(t = 4\text{ s}\): \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\). Total distance \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although net displacement is \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\), the particle reverses direction at \(t = 2\text{ s}\), so the total distance covered is \(8\text{ m}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
स्थिति फलन: \(x(t) = (t - 2)^2\text{ m}\), समय अंतराल: \(t = 0\text{ s}\) से \(t = 4\text{ s}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
दूरी, दिशा की परवाह किए बिना तय की गई कुल पथ लंबाई होती है, इसलिए हमें यह जाँचना होगा कि क्या कण इस अंतराल में अपनी दिशा बदलता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
तात्क्षणिक वेग \(v = \frac{dx}{dt}\) है। किसी अंतराल में तय की गई दूरी \(\int |v| \, dt\) या मोड़ बिंदुओं के बीच विस्थापनों के परिमाणों का योग होती है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
\(x(t)\) का अवकलन करने पर: \[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt} = 2(t - 2)\] \(v(t) = 0\) रखने पर \(t = 2\text{ s}\) प्राप्त होता है, जो \((0, 4)\text{ s}\) के भीतर स्थित है। अब \(t = 0\), \(t = 2\), और \(t = 4\) पर \(x\) का मान ज्ञात करते हैं: \[x(0) = (0 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \[x(2) = (2 - 2)^2 = 0\text{ m}\] \[x(4) = (4 - 2)^2 = 4\text{ m}\] \(t = 0\) से \(t = 2\text{ s}\) तक दूरी: \(|x(2) - x(0)| = |0 - 4| = 4\text{ m}\)। \(t = 2\) से \(t = 4\text{ s}\) तक दूरी: \(|x(4) - x(2)| = |4 - 0| = 4\text{ m}\)। कुल दूरी \(= 4\text{ m} + 4\text{ m} = 8\text{ m}\)।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यद्यपि कुल विस्थापन \(x(4) - x(0) = 0\) है, कण \(t = 2\text{ s}\) पर अपनी दिशा बदलता है, अतः तय की गई कुल दूरी \(8\text{ m}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q06 - Time to walk up moving escalator

questiontext.text:
At a metro station, a girl walks up a stationary escalator in time \(t_1\). If she remains stationary on the escalator, then the escalator take her up in time \(t_2\). The time taken by her to walk up on the moving escalator will be

एक मेट्रो स्टेशन पर एक लड़की स्थिर एस्केलेटर पर चलकर \(t_1\) समय में ऊपर जाती है। यदि वह एस्केलेटर पर स्थिर खड़ी रहे, तो एस्केलेटर उसे \(t_2\) समय में ऊपर ले जाता है। चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर चलकर ऊपर जाने में उसे कितना समय लगेगा?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Time to walk up a stationary escalator \(= t_1\). Time for the moving escalator to carry her up when she stands still \(= t_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let the length of the escalator be \(L\). Both her walking speed relative to the escalator and the escalator's speed relative to the ground are directed upwards along the escalator.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
When she walks up the moving escalator, her speed relative to the ground is the sum of her walking speed relative to the escalator (\(v_g\)) and the escalator's speed (\(v_e\)): \[v = v_g + v_e\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Speed of the girl relative to the escalator: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\). Speed of the escalator relative to the ground: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\). Net upward speed relative to the ground: \[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] Therefore, the time \(t\) taken to cover length \(L\) is: \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The result has dimensions of time and is less than both \(t_1\) and \(t_2\), as expected. Thus, the time taken is \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
स्थिर एस्केलेटर पर चलकर ऊपर जाने का समय \(= t_1\)। स्थिर खड़े रहने पर चलती एस्केलेटर द्वारा ऊपर ले जाने का समय \(= t_2\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
मान लीजिए एस्केलेटर की लंबाई \(L\) है। एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष लड़की की चाल और जमीन के सापेक्ष एस्केलेटर की चाल दोनों एस्केलेटर के अनुदिश ऊपर की ओर हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
जब वह चलती हुई एस्केलेटर पर ऊपर चलती है, तो जमीन के सापेक्ष उसकी चाल, एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष उसकी चाल (\(v_g\)) और एस्केलेटर की चाल (\(v_e\)) के योग के बराबर होती है: \[v = v_g + v_e\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
एस्केलेटर के सापेक्ष लड़की की चाल: \(v_g = \frac{L}{t_1}\)। जमीन के सापेक्ष एस्केलेटर की चाल: \(v_e = \frac{L}{t_2}\)। जमीन के सापेक्ष कुल ऊपर की ओर चाल: \[v = \frac{L}{t_1} + \frac{L}{t_2} = L\left(\frac{t_1 + t_2}{t_1 t_2}\right)\] अतः लंबाई \(L\) तय करने में लगा समय \(t\) होगा: \[t = \frac{L}{v} = \frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
परिणाम की विमा समय की है और यह \(t_1\) तथा \(t_2\) दोनों से कम है, जो कि अपेक्षित है। अतः लगा समय \(\frac{t_1 t_2}{t_2 + t_1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q07 - Linear graph of quantity A versus B

questiontext.text:
The variation of quantity \(A\) with quantity \(B\), plotted in Fig. 3.2 describes the motion of a particle in a straight line.

चित्र 3.2 में खींचा गया राशि \(A\) का राशि \(B\) के साथ परिवर्तन एक सरल रेखा में कण की गति को दर्शाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The given graph shows a straight line with a positive slope and a positive intercept on the \(A\)-axis, so \(A = mB + c\) with \(m > 0\) and \(c > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
We test standard kinematic relationships for straight-line motion where \(B\) represents time \(t\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For uniform motion (constant velocity \(v \neq 0\)): \(x = x_0 + vt\). For uniformly accelerated motion (constant acceleration \(a \neq 0\)): \(v = u + at\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
If \(B\) represents time \(t\), then \(A\) increases linearly with time. - If motion is uniform, velocity is constant, so a velocity-time graph would be a horizontal line (\(m = 0\)), which contradicts the positive slope. However, displacement \(x = x_0 + vt\) is linear with positive slope when \(v > 0\) and \(x_0 > 0\). - If motion is uniformly accelerated, velocity \(v = u + at\) is linear with positive slope when \(a > 0\) and \(u > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, quantity \(B\) may represent time, quantity \(A\) is displacement if motion is uniform, and quantity \(A\) is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
दिया गया ग्राफ धनात्मक ढाल और \(A\)-अक्ष पर धनात्मक अंतःखंड वाली एक सरल रेखा दर्शाता है, अर्थात \(A = mB + c\) जहाँ \(m > 0\) और \(c > 0\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
हम सरल रेखीय गति के मानक गतिकी संबंधों की जाँच करते हैं जहाँ \(B\) समय \(t\) को दर्शाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
एकसमान गति (नियत वेग \(v \neq 0\)) के लिए: \(x = x_0 + vt\)। एकसमान त्वरित गति (नियत त्वरण \(a \neq 0\)) के लिए: \(v = u + at\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
यदि \(B\) समय \(t\) को दर्शाता है, तो \(A\) समय के साथ रैखिक रूप से बढ़ता है। - यदि गति एकसमान है, तो वेग नियत रहता है, अतः वेग-समय ग्राफ एक क्षैतिज रेखा (\(m = 0\)) होगा, जो धनात्मक ढाल से मेल नहीं खाता। परंतु \(v > 0\) और \(x_0 > 0\) होने पर विस्थापन \(x = x_0 + vt\) धनात्मक ढाल वाली सरल रेखा होता है। - यदि गति एकसमान त्वरित है, तो \(a > 0\) और \(u > 0\) होने पर वेग \(v = u + at\) धनात्मक ढाल वाली सरल रेखा होता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः राशि \(B\) समय को दर्शा सकती है, यदि गति एकसमान है तो राशि \(A\) विस्थापन है, और यदि गति एकसमान त्वरित है तो राशि \(A\) वेग है।

answer.text: Quantity A is velocity if motion is uniform.
Quantity A is displacement if motion is uniform.
Quantity A is velocity if motion is uniformly accelerated.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q08 - Interpreting position versus time graph

questiontext.text:
A graph of \(x\) versus \(t\) is shown in Fig. 3.3. Choose correct alternatives from below.

चित्र 3.3 में \(x\) बनाम \(t\) का ग्राफ दर्शाया गया है। नीचे दिए गए सही विकल्पों का चयन कीजिए।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
On a position-time (\(x\)-\(t\)) graph, the slope \(\frac{dx}{dt}\) gives the instantaneous velocity, the curvature (concavity) indicates the sign of acceleration \(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\), and the slope of the chord joining two points gives the average velocity between them.

Step 2: Evaluation
At \(t = 0\) (point A), the tangent to the curve is horizontal, so the initial velocity is zero; thus, the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\). At point B, the curve is at a local maximum (concave downwards), which means \(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} < 0\), so the acceleration \(a < 0\) (not positive). At point C, the tangent is horizontal and it is an inflection point where curvature changes sign, so both velocity and acceleration vanish (\(v = 0, a = 0\)).

Step 3: Application
Point D has a lower \(x\)-coordinate than point A (\(x_D < x_A\)), so the displacement \(x_D - x_A < 0\), making the average velocity between A and D negative (not positive). Comparing the steepness of the tangents at D and E, the magnitude of the slope at D is greater than at E, so the speed at D exceeds that at E.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\), at C both velocity and acceleration vanish, and the speed at D exceeds that at E.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
स्थिति-समय (\(x\)-\(t\)) ग्राफ पर, ढाल \(\frac{dx}{dt}\) तात्क्षणिक वेग देता है, वक्रता (अवतलता/उत्तलता) त्वरण \(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2}\) का चिह्न बताती है, और दो बिंदुओं को मिलाने वाली जीवा का ढाल उनके बीच औसत वेग देता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
\(t = 0\) (बिंदु A) पर वक्र की स्पर्श रेखा क्षैतिज है, अतः प्रारंभिक वेग शून्य है; इसलिए कण को \(t = 0\) पर विरामावस्था से छोड़ा गया था। बिंदु B पर वक्र स्थानीय उच्चिष्ठ पर है (नीचे की ओर अवतल), जिसका अर्थ है \(\frac{d^2x}{dt^2} < 0\), अतः त्वरण \(a < 0\) है (धनात्मक नहीं)। बिंदु C पर स्पर्श रेखा क्षैतिज है और यह एक नति-परिवर्तन बिंदु (inflection point) है जहाँ वक्रता का चिह्न बदलता है, इसलिए वेग और त्वरण दोनों शून्य हो जाते हैं (\(v = 0, a = 0\))।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
बिंदु D का \(x\)-निर्देशांक बिंदु A से कम है (\(x_D < x_A\)), इसलिए विस्थापन \(x_D - x_A < 0\) है, जिससे A और D के बीच औसत वेग ऋणात्मक होता है (धनात्मक नहीं)। D और E पर स्पर्श रेखाओं की तीव्रता की तुलना करने पर, D पर ढाल का परिमाण E से अधिक है, अतः D पर चाल E से अधिक है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः कण को \(t = 0\) पर विरामावस्था से छोड़ा गया था, C पर वेग और त्वरण दोनों शून्य हो जाते हैं, तथा D पर चाल E से अधिक है।

answer.text: The particle was released from rest at \(t = 0\).
At C, the velocity and the acceleration vanish.
Average velocity for the motion between A and D is positive.
The speed at D exceeds that at E.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q09 - One-dimensional motion x equals t minus sin t

questiontext.text:
For the one-dimensional motion, described by \(x = t - \sin t\)

\(x = t - \sin t\) द्वारा वर्णित एकविमीय गति के लिए

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The position as a function of time is \(x(t) = t - \sin t\) for \(t > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Time \(t\) is in radians for the trigonometric function, and \(x, v, a\) are measured along the line of motion.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt}\] Also, for all \(t > 0\), \(t > \sin t\) and \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since \(t > \sin t\) for all \(t > 0\), we have \(x(t) = t - \sin t > 0\) for all \(t > 0\). 2. Differentiating \(x(t)\): \[v(t) = 1 - \cos t\] Since \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\), we get \(0 \le 1 - \cos t \le 2\), so \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\). At \(t = 2\pi, 4\pi, \dots\), \(v(t) = 0\), so \(v(t) > 0\) is not true for all \(t > 0\). 3. Differentiating \(v(t)\): \[a(t) = \sin t\] Since \(\sin t\) takes negative values (e.g., for \(\pi < t < 2\pi\)), \(a(t) > 0\) is not true for all \(t > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, \(x(t) > 0\) for all \(t > 0\), and \(v(t)\) lies between \(0\) and \(2\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
\(t > 0\) के लिए समय के फलन के रूप में स्थिति \(x(t) = t - \sin t\) दी गई है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
त्रिकोणमितीय फलन के लिए समय \(t\) रेडियन में है, तथा \(x, v, a\) गति की रेखा के अनुदिश मापे गए हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\[v(t) = \frac{dx}{dt}, \quad a(t) = \frac{dv}{dt}\] साथ ही, सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(t > \sin t\) तथा \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\) होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
1. चूँकि सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(t > \sin t\) होता है, इसलिए सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(x(t) = t - \sin t > 0\) है। 2. \(x(t)\) का अवकलन करने पर: \[v(t) = 1 - \cos t\] चूँकि \(-1 \le \cos t \le 1\) है, इसलिए \(0 \le 1 - \cos t \le 2\), अर्थात \(v(t)\) का मान \(0\) और \(2\) के बीच रहता है। \(t = 2\pi, 4\pi, \dots\) पर \(v(t) = 0\) होता है, अतः सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(v(t) > 0\) सत्य नहीं है। 3. \(v(t)\) का अवकलन करने पर: \[a(t) = \sin t\] चूँकि \(\sin t\) ऋणात्मक मान भी लेता है (जैसे \(\pi < t < 2\pi\) के लिए), अतः सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(a(t) > 0\) सत्य नहीं है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः सभी \(t > 0\) के लिए \(x(t) > 0\) है, तथा \(v(t)\) का मान \(0\) और \(2\) के बीच रहता है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q10 - Acceleration and speed of oscillating spring-mass

questiontext.text:
A spring with one end attached to a mass and the other to a rigid support is stretched and released.

एक स्प्रिंग के एक सिरे से द्रव्यमान जुड़ा है और दूसरा सिरा दृढ़ आधार से जुड़ा है; इसे खींचकर छोड़ दिया जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a spring-mass system is stretched by a displacement \(x\) from its equilibrium position (\(x = 0\)) and released, the restoring force is \(F = -kx\), producing acceleration \(a = -\frac{k}{m}x = -\omega^2 x\).

Step 2: Evaluation
At the instant of release, the displacement \(|x|\) is at its maximum value (amplitude \(A\)), so the magnitude of acceleration \(|a| = \omega^2 |x|\) is maximum. At the equilibrium position (\(x = 0\)), the restoring force and acceleration are zero (\(|a| = 0\)), while all potential energy is converted into kinetic energy, making the speed maximum.

Step 3: Application
If the motion is damped or in general non-ideal cases, the mass can come to rest with minimum speed (\(v = 0\)) even when displacement is not at its initial maximum, so it is not always true that displacement magnitude is maximum whenever speed is minimum.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Thus, the magnitude of acceleration when just released is maximum, and the speed is maximum when the mass is at the equilibrium position.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
जब किसी स्प्रिंग-द्रव्यमान निकाय को उसकी साम्यावस्था (\(x = 0\)) से विस्थापन \(x\) तक खींचकर छोड़ा जाता है, तो प्रत्यानयन बल \(F = -kx\) लगता है, जिससे त्वरण \(a = -\frac{k}{m}x = -\omega^2 x\) उत्पन्न होता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
छोड़ने के क्षण विस्थापन \(|x|\) अपने अधिकतम मान (आयाम \(A\)) पर होता है, अतः त्वरण का परिमाण \(|a| = \omega^2 |x|\) अधिकतम होता है। साम्यावस्था (\(x = 0\)) पर प्रत्यानयन बल और त्वरण शून्य होते हैं (\(|a| = 0\)), जबकि संपूर्ण स्थितिज ऊर्जा गतिज ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित हो जाती है, जिससे चाल अधिकतम होती है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
अवमंदित गति या सामान्य स्थितियों में द्रव्यमान न्यूनतम चाल (\(v = 0\)) पर तब भी आ सकता है जब विस्थापन अपने प्रारंभिक अधिकतम मान पर न हो, इसलिए यह सदैव सत्य नहीं है कि जब भी चाल न्यूनतम हो तब विस्थापन का परिमाण अधिकतम हो।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः छोड़ने के तुरंत बाद त्वरण का परिमाण अधिकतम होता है, तथा जब द्रव्यमान साम्यावस्था पर होता है तब चाल अधिकतम होती है।

answer.text: Magnitude of acceleration, when just released is maximum.
Magnitude of acceleration, when at equilibrium position, is maximum.
Speed is maximum when mass is at equilibrium position.
Magnitude of displacement is always maximum whenever speed is minimum.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINASTRAIGHTLINE_MCQ_Q11 - Ball bouncing elastically in moving train

questiontext.text:
A ball is bouncing elastically with a speed \(1\text{ m/s}\) between walls of a railway compartment of size \(10\text{ m}\) in a direction perpendicular to walls. The train is moving at a constant velocity of \(10\text{ m/s}\) parallel to the direction of motion of the ball. As seen from the ground,

एक गेंद \(10\text{ m}\) आकार के रेलवे डिब्बे की दीवारों के बीच दीवारों के लंबवत दिशा में \(1\text{ m/s}\) की चाल से प्रत्यास्थ रूप से टकरा रही है। ट्रेन गेंद की गति की दिशा के समानांतर \(10\text{ m/s}\) के नियत वेग से चल रही है। जमीन से देखने पर,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Width of compartment \(L = 10\text{ m}\). Speed of ball relative to train \(v_{BT} = 1\text{ m/s}\). Velocity of train relative to ground \(v_T = 10\text{ m/s}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the direction of motion of the train as positive. Both the train frame and the ground frame are inertial frames since the train moves with constant velocity.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Velocity of ball relative to ground: \(v_B = v_T + v_{BT}\). Time between successive collisions: \(t = \frac{L}{|v_{BT}|}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Time between consecutive collisions with the walls is \(t = \frac{10\text{ m}}{1\text{ m/s}} = 10\text{ s}\). 2. When the ball moves in the direction of the train, its speed relative to the ground is \(10 + 1 = 11\text{ m/s}\). After colliding elastically, it moves opposite to the train relative to the compartment, so its velocity relative to the ground is \(10 - 1 = 9\text{ m/s}\). 3. Because both \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(9\text{ m/s}\) are positive, the direction of motion of the ball relative to the ground never changes, while its speed changes every \(10\text{ s}\). 4. In any \(20\text{ s}\) interval, the ball spends \(10\text{ s}\) at \(11\text{ m/s}\) and \(10\text{ s}\) at \(9\text{ m/s}\), covering \(11(10) + 9(10) = 200\text{ m}\), so its average speed is fixed at \(10\text{ m/s}\). 5. Since the train moves at constant velocity, the acceleration of the ball measured from the ground is identical to that measured from the train.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Thus, as seen from the ground, the speed of the ball changes every \(10\text{ seconds}\), the average speed over any \(20\text{ second}\) interval is fixed, and the acceleration of the ball is the same as from the train.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
डिब्बे की चौड़ाई \(L = 10\text{ m}\)। ट्रेन के सापेक्ष गेंद की चाल \(v_{BT} = 1\text{ m/s}\)। जमीन के सापेक्ष ट्रेन का वेग \(v_T = 10\text{ m/s}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
ट्रेन की गति की दिशा को धनात्मक मानें। चूँकि ट्रेन नियत वेग से चल रही है, इसलिए ट्रेन और जमीन दोनों जड़त्वीय निर्देश तंत्र हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
जमीन के सापेक्ष गेंद का वेग: \(v_B = v_T + v_{BT}\)। क्रमागत टक्करों के बीच समय: \(t = \frac{L}{|v_{BT}|}\)।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
1. दीवारों से क्रमागत टक्करों के बीच का समय \(t = \frac{10\text{ m}}{1\text{ m/s}} = 10\text{ s}\) है। 2. जब गेंद ट्रेन की दिशा में चलती है, तो जमीन के सापेक्ष उसकी चाल \(10 + 1 = 11\text{ m/s}\) होती है। प्रत्यास्थ टक्कर के बाद वह डिब्बे के सापेक्ष विपरीत दिशा में चलती है, अतः जमीन के सापेक्ष उसका वेग \(10 - 1 = 9\text{ m/s}\) होता है। 3. चूँकि \(11\text{ m/s}\) और \(9\text{ m/s}\) दोनों धनात्मक हैं, इसलिए जमीन के सापेक्ष गेंद की गति की दिशा कभी नहीं बदलती, जबकि उसकी चाल प्रत्येक \(10\text{ s}\) में बदलती है। 4. किसी भी \(20\text{ s}\) के अंतराल में, गेंद \(10\text{ s}\) तक \(11\text{ m/s}\) से और \(10\text{ s}\) तक \(9\text{ m/s}\) से चलती है, जिससे वह \(11(10) + 9(10) = 200\text{ m}\) दूरी तय करती है; अतः उसकी औसत चाल \(10\text{ m/s}\) पर नियत रहती है। 5. चूँकि ट्रेन नियत वेग से चल रही है, जमीन से मापा गया गेंद का त्वरण ट्रेन से मापे गए त्वरण के समान होता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः जमीन से देखने पर गेंद की चाल प्रत्येक \(10\text{ सेकंड}\) में बदलती है, किसी भी \(20\text{ सेकंड}\) के अंतराल में औसत चाल नियत रहती है, और गेंद का त्वरण ट्रेन से देखे जाने वाले त्वरण के समान होता है।

answer.text: the direction of motion of the ball changes every \(10\text{ seconds}\).
average speed of ball over any \(20\text{ second}\) interval is fixed.
the acceleration of ball is the same as from the train.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_1 - Angle between two perpendicular vectors

questiontext.text: The angle between \(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two vectors are given in Cartesian component form as \(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The unit vectors \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) are mutually orthogonal unit vectors along the positive \(X\)-axis and \(Y\)-axis, respectively, so \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{i}} = \hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 1\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 0\). The angle \(\theta\) between two non-zero vectors lies in the range \(0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The dot product of two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) is given by \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\cos\theta\), so \(\cos\theta = \frac{\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Compute the dot product: \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = (1)(1) + (1)(-1) = 1 - 1 = 0\).
Compute the magnitudes: \(|\mathbf{A}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = \sqrt{1^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{2}\).
Substitute into the cosine formula: \(\cos\theta = \frac{0}{\sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{2}} = 0\).
For \(0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ\), \(\cos\theta = 0\) gives \(\theta = 90^\circ\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The vectors lie along \(45^\circ\) above and \(45^\circ\) below the positive \(X\)-axis, so the angle between them is indeed \(90^\circ\). The final answer is \(90^\circ\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_2 - Fundamental property of a scalar quantity

questiontext.text: Which one of the following statements is true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A scalar quantity is completely specified by its magnitude (with appropriate units) and has no direction associated with it. Because it has no directional dependence, a scalar is invariant under rotations or changes in the orientation of coordinate axes.

Step 2: Evaluation
Testing each physical claim against known scalar quantities:
1. Conservation in a process is not a defining property of scalars; for example, kinetic energy and temperature are scalars that are not generally conserved.
2. Scalars can take negative values; for example, temperature on the Celsius scale, electric charge, and gravitational potential energy can all be negative.
3. Scalars can vary from one point to another in space; for example, temperature or electric potential can be a function of position.

Step 3: Application
Since a scalar has no direction, its measured value does not depend on how an observer orients their coordinate axes.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The true statement is that a scalar quantity has the same value for observers with different orientations of the axes.

answer.text: A scalar quantity is the one that is conserved in a process.
A scalar quantity is the one that can never take negative values.
A scalar quantity is the one that does not vary from one point to another in space.
A scalar quantity has the same value for observers with different orientations of the axes.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_3 - Signs of components of two vectors

questiontext.text:
Figure 4.1 shows the orientation of two vectors \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) in the \(XY\) plane.

If \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)

which of the following is correct?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two vectors in the \(XY\) plane are \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). In the diagram, the positive \(X\)-axis points to the right and the positive \(Y\)-axis points upward from the origin \(O\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
A vector's \(x\)-component is positive if it points toward the right (positive \(X\)-direction) and negative if it points toward the left. Its \(y\)-component is positive if it points upward (positive \(Y\)-direction) and negative if it points downward.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For any planar vector \(\mathbf{w} = w_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + w_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), \(w_x\) and \(w_y\) represent the signed displacements from the tail to the head of the vector along the \(X\)-axis and \(Y\)-axis, respectively.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For vector \(\mathbf{u}\), its tail is at the origin \(O\) and its head lies in the first quadrant (to the right and upward). Therefore, \(a > 0\) and \(b > 0\).
For vector \(\mathbf{v}\), moving from its tail to its head goes toward the right (increasing \(x\)) and downward (decreasing \(y\)). Therefore, \(p > 0\) and \(q < 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Combining the signs gives \(a > 0\), \(b > 0\), \(p > 0\), and \(q < 0\). Thus, \(a\), \(p\) and \(b\) are positive while \(q\) is negative.

answer.text: \(a\) and \(p\) are positive while \(b\) and \(q\) are negative.
\(a\), \(p\) and \(b\) are positive while \(q\) is negative.
\(a\), \(q\) and \(b\) are positive while \(p\) is negative.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_4 - Maximum component of vector along X-axis

questiontext.text: The component of a vector \(\mathbf{r}\) along X-axis will have maximum value if

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Consider a vector \(\mathbf{r}\) of fixed magnitude \(r = |\mathbf{r}|\) making an angle \(\theta\) with the positive \(X\)-axis.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The angle \(\theta\) is measured from the positive \(X\)-axis.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The scalar component of \(\mathbf{r}\) along the \(X\)-axis is \(r_x = r\cos\theta\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since the maximum possible value of \(\cos\theta\) is \(+1\), which occurs when \(\theta = 0^\circ\), the component \(r_x\) attains its maximum value \(r_x = r\) when \(\theta = 0^\circ\).
At \(\theta = 90^\circ\) (positive \(Y\)-axis) or \(\theta = 270^\circ\) (negative \(Y\)-axis), \(r_x = 0\). At \(\theta = 45^\circ\), \(r_x = r/\sqrt{2} < r\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
An angle \(\theta = 0^\circ\) corresponds to \(\mathbf{r}\) pointing along the positive \(X\)-axis. Therefore, the component is maximum when \(\mathbf{r}\) is along the positive X-axis.

answer.text: \(\mathbf{r}\) makes an angle of \(45^\circ\) with the X-axis

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_5 - Horizontal range of projectile at 45 degrees

questiontext.text: The horizontal range of a projectile fired at an angle of \(15^\circ\) is \(50\text{ m}\). If it is fired with the same speed at an angle of \(45^\circ\), its range will be

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Angle of projection \(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\), corresponding horizontal range \(R_1 = 50\text{ m}\). Second angle of projection \(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\) with the same projection speed \(u\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected, and the projectile lands at the same horizontal level from which it is launched under uniform gravitational acceleration \(g\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal range of a projectile launched with speed \(u\) at angle \(\theta\) to the horizontal is \(R = \frac{u^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For \(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\):
\(R_1 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 15^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 30^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{2g}\).
Since \(R_1 = 50\text{ m}\), we obtain \(\frac{u^2}{g} = 2 R_1 = 100\text{ m}\).
For \(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\):
\(R_2 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 45^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 90^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{g} = 100\text{ m}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
At \(45^\circ\), the range is maximum and equals twice the range at \(15^\circ\), which has units of metres. The range will be \(100\text{ m}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_6 - Identifying vector quantities among physical quantities

questiontext.text: Consider the quantities, pressure, power, energy, impulse, gravitational potential, electrical charge, temperature, area. Out of these, the only vector quantities are

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A vector quantity possesses both magnitude and direction and obeys the laws of vector addition, whereas a scalar quantity is completely specified by its magnitude alone.

Step 2: Evaluation
Classify each given physical quantity:
- Pressure: scalar (acts isotropically at a point in a fluid).
- Power: scalar (rate of doing work, \(P = \mathbf{F} \cdot \mathbf{v}\)).
- Energy: scalar.
- Impulse: vector (\(\mathbf{J} = \mathbf{F}\Delta t = \Delta\mathbf{p}\), has the direction of change in momentum).
- Gravitational potential: scalar (work done per unit mass).
- Electrical charge: scalar.
- Temperature: scalar.
- Area: vector (represented by an area vector \(\mathbf{A} = A\hat{\mathbf{n}}\) directed normal to the surface).

Step 3: Application
Out of the entire list, only impulse and area are vector quantities.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The only vector quantities among the listed quantities are impulse and area.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_7 - Constant speed in two dimensional motion

questiontext.text: In a two dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v_0\) is a positive constant. Then which of the following are necessarily true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Instantaneous speed \(v = \frac{ds}{dt}\) is the rate of change of path length (distance) \(s\) with respect to time \(t\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Since \(v = v_0\) is constant, integrating over any time interval \(\Delta t\) gives the path length traversed as \(s = v_0 \Delta t\). Thus, equal path lengths are necessarily traversed in equal time intervals.
In contrast, consider uniform circular motion (a 2D motion with constant speed \(v_0\)):
- Over one complete revolution, the net displacement is zero, so average velocity can be zero.
- Over one complete revolution, the velocity returns to its initial value, so average acceleration is zero over that interval, but not over a half-revolution (it does not always vanish).
- Displacements in equal time intervals have different directions along a curved path, so they are not equal vectors.

Step 3: Application
Only the path length relation \(s = v_0 \Delta t\) holds universally for any 2D trajectory at constant speed \(v_0\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, equal path lengths are traversed in equal intervals.

answer.text: The average velocity is not zero at any time.
Displacements in equal time intervals are equal.
Equal path lengths are traversed in equal intervals.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_8 - Acceleration direction in planar constant speed motion

questiontext.text: In a two dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v_0\) is a positive constant. Then which of the following are necessarily true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In a two-dimensional motion, the position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) always lies in a fixed plane. Consequently, its first time derivative \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \frac{d\mathbf{r}}{dt}\) and second time derivative \(\mathbf{a}(t) = \frac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt}\) must also lie in that same plane.

Step 2: Evaluation
Check each claim:
- The acceleration need not be zero because the direction of velocity can change even when speed is constant (for example, in curved motion).
- The acceleration is not necessarily bounded because the radius of curvature \(R\) of an arbitrary 2D path can become arbitrarily small, making \(|\mathbf{a}| = \frac{v_0^2}{R}\) arbitrarily large.
- The motion need not be uniform circular motion, as the particle can move at constant speed along any smooth planar curve (such as a parabola or straight line).

Step 3: Application
Because the trajectory is confined to a single plane, the change in velocity \(\Delta\mathbf{v}\) over any interval lies in that plane, so \(\mathbf{a} = \lim_{\Delta t \to 0} \frac{\Delta\mathbf{v}}{\Delta t}\) necessarily lies in the plane of motion.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The acceleration of the particle is necessarily in the plane of motion.

answer.text: The acceleration of the particle is zero.
The acceleration of the particle is bounded.
The acceleration of the particle is necessarily in the plane of motion.
The particle must be undergoing a uniform circular motion

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_9 - Vector triple and scalar products of coplanar vectors

questiontext.text: Three vectors \(\mathbf{A}\), \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(\mathbf{C}\) add up to zero. Find which is false.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Three vectors satisfy \(\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B} + \mathbf{C} = \mathbf{0}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The vectors are assumed to be general vectors in three-dimensional space satisfying the closure condition.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Since \(\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B} + \mathbf{C} = \mathbf{0}\), the three vectors form a closed triangle and are coplanar. The cross product \(\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}\) is perpendicular to the plane containing \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Because \(\mathbf{C} = -(\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B})\) lies in the plane of \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\), and \(\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}\) is perpendicular to that plane, the scalar triple product is always zero: \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \cdot \mathbf{C} = 0\), regardless of whether \(\mathbf{B}\) and \(\mathbf{C}\) are parallel or not.
Therefore, claiming that \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \cdot \mathbf{C}\) is not zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel is false.
In contrast, \(\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B} = -(\mathbf{B} + \mathbf{C}) \times \mathbf{B} = \mathbf{B} \times \mathbf{C}\), which is perpendicular to \(\mathbf{C}\) and non-zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel; hence \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \times \mathbf{C}\) is non-zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel, and it lies in the plane of \(\mathbf{A}, \mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The false statement is that \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \cdot \mathbf{C}\) is not zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel.

answer.text: \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \times \mathbf{C}\) is not zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel
\((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \cdot \mathbf{C}\) is not zero unless \(\mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) are parallel
If \(\mathbf{A}, \mathbf{B}, \mathbf{C}\) define a plane, \((\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}) \times \mathbf{C}\) is in that plane

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_10 - Condition for magnitude of sum equalling magnitude

questiontext.text: It is found that \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A}|\). This necessarily implies,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) satisfy the magnitude condition \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A}|\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(A = |\mathbf{A}| \geq 0\) and \(B = |\mathbf{B}| \geq 0\) denote the magnitudes of the vectors.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The squared magnitude of the vector sum is \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}|^2 = (\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}) \cdot (\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}) = A^2 + B^2 + 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Squaring both sides of \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A}|\) gives:
\(A^2 + B^2 + 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = A^2\).
Subtracting \(A^2\) from both sides:
\(2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -B^2 \implies \mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -\frac{B^2}{2}\).
Since \(B^2 \geq 0\), it follows that \(-\frac{B^2}{2} \leq 0\), so \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} \leq 0\) necessarily holds.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Equality holds when \(\mathbf{B} = \mathbf{0}\), and for non-zero \(\mathbf{B}\), \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} < 0\) (meaning the angle between \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) is obtuse, not necessarily antiparallel or perpendicular). Thus, the necessary implication is \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} \leq 0\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_11 - Comparing projectiles with different maximum heights

questiontext.text: Two particles are projected in air with speed \(v_o\) at angles \(\theta_1\) and \(\theta_2\) (both acute) to the horizontal, respectively. If the height reached by the first particle is greater than that of the second, then tick the right choices

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two particles are projected with equal speed \(v_0\) at acute angles \(\theta_1\) and \(\theta_2\) (\(0^\circ < \theta_1, \theta_2 < 90^\circ\)). The maximum height reached satisfies \(H_1 > H_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected and acceleration due to gravity \(g\) is constant.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Maximum height: \(H = \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta}{2g}\).
Time of flight: \(T = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\).
Horizontal range: \(R = \frac{v_0^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(H_1 > H_2\) and \(v_0, g\) are identical:
\(\frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta_1}{2g} > \frac{v_0^2 \sin^2\theta_2}{2g} \implies \sin^2\theta_1 > \sin^2\theta_2\).
Because \(\theta_1\) and \(\theta_2\) are acute, \(\sin\theta > 0\) and \(\sin\theta\) is strictly increasing with \(\theta\). Therefore, \(\sin\theta_1 > \sin\theta_2 \implies \theta_1 > \theta_2\).
For the time of flight, \(T = \frac{2v_0 \sin\theta}{g}\). Since \(\sin\theta_1 > \sin\theta_2\), it follows that \(T_1 > T_2\).
Horizontal range depends on \(\sin 2\theta\), which increases up to \(45^\circ\) and decreases beyond \(45^\circ\), so \(R_1\) need not be greater than \(R_2\). Total energy \(U = \frac{1}{2}mv_0^2\) depends on mass \(m\), which is not given.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both \(\theta_1 > \theta_2\) and \(T_1 > T_2\) are necessarily true.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_12 - Particle sliding on parabolic track and projectile

questiontext.text: A particle slides down a frictionless parabolic (\(y = x^2\)) track (A - B - C) starting from rest at point A (Fig. 4.2). Point B is at the vertex of parabola and point C is at a height less than that of point A. After C, the particle moves freely in air as a projectile. If the particle reaches highest point at P, then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A particle starts from rest at point A on a frictionless parabolic track \(y = x^2\), passes through the vertex B (\(y_B = 0\)) and point C (\(y_C < y_A\)), and then moves as a free projectile reaching its highest point at P.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take gravitational potential energy to be zero at the vertex B (\(y = 0\)). Air resistance is negligible.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Total mechanical energy is \(E = \text{KE} + \text{PE} = \frac{1}{2}mv^2 + mgy\). Since the track is frictionless (normal force does zero work) and gravity is conservative, total mechanical energy is conserved throughout the motion.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
By conservation of mechanical energy, the total energy at P equals the total energy at A: \(E_P = E_A\).
At A, the particle is at rest, so \(\text{KE}_A = 0\) and \(E_A = mgy_A\).
At P, the highest point of the projectile trajectory, the vertical velocity is zero, but the horizontal velocity \(v_x = v_0 \cos\theta\) is non-zero. Hence \(\text{KE}_P = \frac{1}{2}mv_x^2 > 0\).
From \(mgy_P + \text{KE}_P = mgy_A\), it follows that \(y_P < y_A\), so height at P is less than height at A.
At B, \(y_B = 0\), so \(\text{KE}_B = E_A\). Since \(y_P > 0\), \(\text{KE}_P = E_A - mgy_P < \text{KE}_B\).
The time from A to B along the constrained track differs from the time from B to P (which includes projectile motion reaching a lower height \(y_P < y_A\)).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Only the statement that total energy at P equals total energy at A is correct.

answer.text: total energy at \(\mathrm{P} =\) total energy at A
time of travel from A to B = time of travel from B to P.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_13 - Incorrect kinematic relations for general motion

questiontext.text: Following are four different relations about displacement, velocity and acceleration for the motion of a particle in general. Choose the incorrect one (s) :

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For the motion of a particle in general (where acceleration may vary with time), average velocity and average acceleration are defined solely in terms of the net change in position and velocity over the time interval \(t_2 - t_1\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Evaluate each kinematic relation:
1. \(\mathbf{v}_{av} = \frac{\mathbf{r}(t_2) - \mathbf{r}(t_1)}{t_2 - t_1}\) is the exact definition of average velocity and holds for any motion.
2. \(\mathbf{a}_{av} = \frac{\mathbf{v}(t_2) - \mathbf{v}(t_1)}{t_2 - t_1}\) is the exact definition of average acceleration and holds for any motion.
3. \(\mathbf{v}_{av} = \frac{1}{2}[\mathbf{v}(t_1) + \mathbf{v}(t_2)]\) is valid only when acceleration is constant; it is incorrect for motion in general.
4. \(\mathbf{r} = \frac{1}{2}(\mathbf{v}(t_2) - \mathbf{v}(t_1))(t_2 - t_1)\) is incorrect (even for constant acceleration, displacement involves the sum \(\mathbf{v}(t_2) + \mathbf{v}(t_1)\), not the difference).

Step 3: Application
The question asks to choose the incorrect relations for motion in general.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The incorrect relations are \(\mathbf{v}_{av} = \frac{1}{2}[\mathbf{v}(t_1) + \mathbf{v}(t_2)]\) and \(\mathbf{r} = \frac{1}{2}(\mathbf{v}(t_2) - \mathbf{v}(t_1))(t_2 - t_1)\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_14 - Properties of uniform circular motion

questiontext.text: For a particle performing uniform circular motion, choose the correct statement(s) from the following:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In uniform circular motion, a particle moves in a circular path of constant radius \(r\) with constant speed \(v\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Analyze each physical property:
1. Speed: By definition of uniform circular motion, the magnitude of velocity (speed) remains constant.
2. Direction of velocity: Instantaneous velocity is always tangent to the circular path, which is perpendicular to the radius vector.
3. Acceleration: The centripetal acceleration always points radially inward toward the centre of the circle, so its direction continuously changes as the particle moves.
4. Angular momentum: \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\) has constant magnitude \(mvr\) and constant direction (perpendicular to the plane of the circle along the axis of rotation, by the right-hand rule), so its direction does not change.

Step 3: Application
The first three statements accurately describe uniform circular motion, whereas the statement about changing direction of angular momentum is false.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The correct statements are that the magnitude of particle velocity remains constant, particle velocity remains directed perpendicular to the radius vector, and the direction of acceleration keeps changing as the particle moves.

answer.text: Particle velocity remains directed perpendicular to radius vector.
Direction of acceleration keeps changing as particle moves.
Angular momentum is constant in magnitude but direction keeps changing.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_15 - Condition for equal magnitudes of sum and difference

questiontext.text: For two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\), \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{B}|\) is always true when

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) satisfy \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{B}|\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(A = |\mathbf{A}|\) and \(B = |\mathbf{B}|\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
\(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}|^2 = A^2 + B^2 + 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\) and \(|\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{B}|^2 = A^2 + B^2 - 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Squaring both sides of \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{B}|\) gives:
\(A^2 + B^2 + 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = A^2 + B^2 - 2\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\).
Simplifying yields \(4\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\), or \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\cos\theta = 0\).
This condition is satisfied when \(\mathbf{A} \perp \mathbf{B}\) (\(\theta = 90^\circ\)) or when either \(|\mathbf{A}| = 0\) or \(|\mathbf{B}| = 0\).
Merely having \(|\mathbf{A}| = |\mathbf{B}| \neq 0\) does not guarantee \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\), and if they are parallel or antiparallel with non-zero magnitudes, \(|\mathbf{A} + \mathbf{B}| \neq |\mathbf{A} - \mathbf{B}|\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The relation is always true when \(\mathbf{A} \perp \mathbf{B}\) or when either \(|\mathbf{A}|\) or \(|\mathbf{B}|\) is zero.

answer.text: \(|\mathbf{A}| = |\mathbf{B}| \neq 0\) and \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) are parallel or anti parallel

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MATCHING_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_26 - Matching vector addition and subtraction diagrams

questiontext.text:
Given below in column I are the relations between vectors \(\mathbf{a}\), \(\mathbf{b}\) and \(\mathbf{c}\) and in column II are the orientations of \(\mathbf{a}\), \(\mathbf{b}\) and \(\mathbf{c}\) in the \(XY\) plane. Match the relation in column I to correct orientations in column II.

Column II

(i)

(ii)

(iii)

(iv)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Four vector relations are given in terms of planar vectors \(\mathbf{a}\), \(\mathbf{b}\), and \(\mathbf{c}\), along with four triangle-law diagrams labeled (i), (ii), (iii), and (iv).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
In each diagram, the arrow indicates the direction from the tail to the head of the vector.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By the triangle law of vector addition, if two vectors are placed head-to-tail, their resultant vector runs from the tail of the first vector to the head of the second vector. If three vectors form a closed loop head-to-tail, their vector sum is zero.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
- In diagram (i), \(\mathbf{a}\) and \(\mathbf{c}\) are head-to-tail and \(\mathbf{b}\) runs from the tail of \(\mathbf{a}\) to the head of \(\mathbf{c}\), giving \(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{c} = \mathbf{b}\), or \(\mathbf{b} - \mathbf{a} = \mathbf{c}\).
- In diagram (ii), \(\mathbf{a}\), \(\mathbf{b}\), and \(\mathbf{c}\) form a closed head-to-tail loop, giving \(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} + \mathbf{c} = \mathbf{0}\).
- In diagram (iv), \(\mathbf{a}\) and \(\mathbf{b}\) are head-to-tail and \(\mathbf{c}\) runs from the tail of \(\mathbf{a}\) to the head of \(\mathbf{b}\), giving \(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} = \mathbf{c}\).
- By elimination, \(\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{c} = \mathbf{b}\) corresponds to diagram (iii) (which represents \(\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{c} = \mathbf{b}\) when \(\mathbf{b}\) is directed from the head of \(\mathbf{c}\) to the head of \(\mathbf{a}\)).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The correct matches are \(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} = \mathbf{c} \to \text{(iv)}\), \(\mathbf{a} - \mathbf{c} = \mathbf{b} \to \text{(iii)}\), \(\mathbf{b} - \mathbf{a} = \mathbf{c} \to \text{(i)}\), and \(\mathbf{a} + \mathbf{b} + \mathbf{c} = 0 \to \text{(ii)}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MATCHING_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_27 - Matching dot product values with angles

questiontext.text: If \(|\mathbf{A}| = 2\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = 4\), then match the relations in column I with the angle \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) in column II.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Vector magnitudes are \(|\mathbf{A}| = 2\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = 4\). Four dot product values are given: \(0\), \(+8\), \(4\), and \(-8\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The angle \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) satisfies \(0^\circ \leq \theta \leq 180^\circ\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The scalar (dot) product is \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\cos\theta\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Here \(|\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}| = 2 \times 4 = 8\), so \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = 8\cos\theta\).
- For \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = 0\): \(\cos\theta = 0 \implies \theta = 90^\circ\).
- For \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = +8\): \(\cos\theta = \frac{8}{8} = 1 \implies \theta = 0\).
- For \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = 4\): \(\cos\theta = \frac{4}{8} = \frac{1}{2} \implies \theta = 60^\circ\).
- For \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = -8\): \(\cos\theta = \frac{-8}{8} = -1 \implies \theta = 180^\circ\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Each dot product uniquely determines \(\theta\) in \([0^\circ, 180^\circ]\): \(0 \to 90^\circ\), \(+8 \to 0\), \(4 \to 60^\circ\), and \(-8 \to 180^\circ\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MATCHING_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q4_28 - Matching cross product magnitudes with angles

questiontext.text: If \(|\mathbf{A}| = 2\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = 4\), then match the relations in column I with the angle \(\theta\) between \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) in column II

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Vector magnitudes are \(|\mathbf{A}| = 2\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = 4\). Four cross product magnitudes are given: \(0\), \(8\), \(4\), and \(4\sqrt{2}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
For the listed angles, \(\theta \in [0^\circ, 90^\circ]\), where \(\sin\theta \geq 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The magnitude of the vector (cross) product is \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\sin\theta\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Here \(|\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}| = 2 \times 4 = 8\), so \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = 8\sin\theta\).
- For \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = 0\): \(\sin\theta = 0 \implies \theta = 0^\circ\).
- For \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = 8\): \(\sin\theta = \frac{8}{8} = 1 \implies \theta = 90^\circ\).
- For \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = 4\): \(\sin\theta = \frac{4}{8} = \frac{1}{2} \implies \theta = 30^\circ\).
- For \(|\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}| = 4\sqrt{2}\): \(\sin\theta = \frac{4\sqrt{2}}{8} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \implies \theta = 45^\circ\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The matching angles are \(0 \to 0^\circ\), \(8 \to 90^\circ\), \(4 \to 30^\circ\), and \(4\sqrt{2} \to 45^\circ\).

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q01 - Angle between two given vectors

questiontext.text:
The angle between \(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) is

\(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) ভেক্টর দুটির মধ্যবর্তী কোণ হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The two vectors are given as \(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The unit vectors \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) are mutually perpendicular unit vectors along the positive \(X\)-axis and \(Y\)-axis, respectively, so \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{i}} = \hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 1\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The dot product of two vectors \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) is given by \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\cos\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle between them.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the dot product \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\):
\(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = (\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}) \cdot (\hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}) = (1)(1) + (1)(-1) = 1 - 1 = 0\).
Calculate the magnitudes:
\(|\mathbf{A}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}\) and \(|\mathbf{B}| = \sqrt{1^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{2}\).
Substitute into the dot product formula:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|} = \frac{0}{\sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{2}} = 0 \implies \theta = 90^\circ\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since both vectors have non-zero magnitudes and their scalar product is zero, they are orthogonal. Therefore, the angle between \(\mathbf{A}\) and \(\mathbf{B}\) is \(90^\circ\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
দুটি ভেক্টর হলো \(\mathbf{A} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B} = \hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
\(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) এবং \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) যথাক্রমে ধনাত্মক \(X\)-অক্ষ এবং \(Y\)-অক্ষ বরাবর পরস্পর লম্ব একক ভেক্টর, তাই \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{i}} = \hat{\mathbf{j}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 1\) এবং \(\hat{\mathbf{i}} \cdot \hat{\mathbf{j}} = 0\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\(\mathbf{A}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B}\) ভেক্টর দুটির ডট গুণফল হলো \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = |\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|\cos\theta\), যেখানে \(\theta\) হলো তাদের মধ্যবর্তী কোণ।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
ডট গুণফল \(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}\) নির্ণয় করি:
\(\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = (\hat{\mathbf{i}} + \hat{\mathbf{j}}) \cdot (\hat{\mathbf{i}} - \hat{\mathbf{j}}) = (1)(1) + (1)(-1) = 1 - 1 = 0\)।
ভেক্টর দুটির মান নির্ণয় করি:
\(|\mathbf{A}| = \sqrt{1^2 + 1^2} = \sqrt{2}\) এবং \(|\mathbf{B}| = \sqrt{1^2 + (-1)^2} = \sqrt{2}\)।
সূত্রে মান বসিয়ে পাই:
\(\cos\theta = \frac{\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}}{|\mathbf{A}||\mathbf{B}|} = \frac{0}{\sqrt{2} \times \sqrt{2}} = 0 \implies \theta = 90^\circ\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই এবং চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যেহেতু দুটি ভেক্টরেরই মান অশূন্য এবং তাদের স্কেলার গুণফল শূন্য, তাই তারা পরস্পর লম্ব। সুতরাং, \(\mathbf{A}\) এবং \(\mathbf{B}\)-এর মধ্যবর্তী কোণ হলো \(90^\circ\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q02 - True statement about a scalar quantity

questiontext.text:
Which one of the following statements is true?

নিচের কোন বিবৃতিটি সত্য?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A scalar quantity is a physical quantity that is completely specified by its magnitude (and unit) alone, without any associated direction, and remains invariant under rotation of the coordinate axes.

Step 2: Evaluation
1. A scalar need not be conserved in a process (for example, kinetic energy is not conserved in an inelastic collision).
2. A scalar can take negative values (for example, temperature in Celsius, electric charge, or gravitational potential energy).
3. A scalar can vary from one point to another in space (for example, temperature or gravitational potential in a room or field).
4. Because a scalar has no directional dependence, its value does not change when the coordinate axes are rotated to different orientations.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, a scalar quantity has the same value for observers with different orientations of the axes.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
স্কেলার রাশি হলো এমন একটি ভৌত রাশি যা শুধুমাত্র মান (এবং একক) দ্বারা সম্পূর্ণভাবে প্রকাশিত হয়, এর কোনো দিক নেই এবং স্থানাঙ্ক অক্ষের ঘূর্ণনের ফলে এর মানের কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
১. কোনো প্রক্রিয়ায় স্কেলার রাশি সংরক্ষিত নাও থাকতে পারে (যেমন, অস্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষে গতিশক্তি সংরক্ষিত থাকে না)।
২. স্কেলার রাশির মান ঋণাত্মক হতে পারে (যেমন, সেলসিয়াস স্কেলে তাপমাত্রা, তড়িৎ আধান বা মহাকর্ষীয় স্থিতিশক্তি)।
৩. স্থানে স্থানে স্কেলার রাশির মান পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে (যেমন, ঘরের বিভিন্ন বিন্দুতে তাপমাত্রা বা মহাকর্ষীয় বিভব)।
৪. যেহেতু স্কেলার রাশির কোনো দিক-নির্ভরতা নেই, তাই স্থানাঙ্ক অক্ষের অভিমুখ পরিবর্তন করলেও এর মান অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, অক্ষের বিভিন্ন অভিমুখের পর্যবেক্ষকদের জন্য একটি স্কেলার রাশির মান একই থাকে।

answer.text: A scalar quantity is the one that is conserved in a process.
A scalar quantity is the one that can never take negative values.
A scalar quantity is the one that does not vary from one point to another in space.
A scalar quantity has the same value for observers with different orientations of the axes.

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q03 - Signs of components of two vectors in XY plane

questiontext.text:
Figure 4.1 shows the orientation of two vectors \(\mathbf{u}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) in the \(XY\) plane.

If \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), which of the following is correct?

চিত্র ৪.১-এ \(XY\) সমতলে \(\mathbf{u}\) এবং \(\mathbf{v}\) দুটি ভেক্টরের অভিমুখ দেখানো হয়েছে।

যদি \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) এবং \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) হয়, তবে নিচের কোনটি সঠিক?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two vectors in the \(XY\) plane are given by \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) and \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\). In the diagram, vector \(\mathbf{u}\) starts at the origin \(O\) and points into the first quadrant (to the right and upwards). Vector \(\mathbf{v}\) starts at the head of \(\mathbf{u}\) and points downwards and slightly to the right.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Moving along the \(+X\) direction corresponds to a positive \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) component, while moving along the \(-X\) direction corresponds to a negative \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) component. Similarly, moving along \(+Y\) gives a positive \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) component, and moving along \(-Y\) gives a negative \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) component.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For any vector \(\mathbf{w} = w_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + w_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\), the sign of \(w_x\) depends on the horizontal displacement from tail to head, and the sign of \(w_y\) depends on the vertical displacement from tail to head.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For vector \(\mathbf{u}\): from its tail at \(O\) to its head, the horizontal displacement is to the right (\(+X\)) and the vertical displacement is upwards (\(+Y\)). Thus, \(a > 0\) and \(b > 0\).
For vector \(\mathbf{v}\): from its tail to its head, the horizontal displacement is to the right (\(+X\)) and the vertical displacement is downwards (\(-Y\)). Thus, \(p > 0\) and \(q < 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Combining these results, \(a\), \(b\), and \(p\) are positive while \(q\) is negative.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(XY\) সমতলে দুটি ভেক্টর হলো \(\mathbf{u} = a\hat{\mathbf{i}} + b\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) এবং \(\mathbf{v} = p\hat{\mathbf{i}} + q\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)। চিত্রে, \(\mathbf{u}\) ভেক্টরটি মূলবিন্দু \(O\) থেকে শুরু হয়ে প্রথম পাদে (ডানদিকে ও উপরে) নির্দেশিত। \(\mathbf{v}\) ভেক্টরটি \(\mathbf{u}\)-এর শীর্ষবিন্দু থেকে শুরু হয়ে নিচের দিকে এবং সামান্য ডানদিকে নির্দেশিত।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
\(+X\) দিকে সরণ ধনাত্মক \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) উপাংশ এবং \(-X\) দিকে সরণ ঋণাত্মক \(\hat{\mathbf{i}}\) উপাংশ নির্দেশ করে। একইভাবে, \(+Y\) দিকে সরণ ধনাত্মক \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) উপাংশ এবং \(-Y\) দিকে সরণ ঋণাত্মক \(\hat{\mathbf{j}}\) উপাংশ নির্দেশ করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
যেকোনো ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{w} = w_x\hat{\mathbf{i}} + w_y\hat{\mathbf{j}}\)-এর জন্য, \(w_x\)-এর চিহ্ন পাদবিন্দু থেকে শীর্ষবিন্দু পর্যন্ত অনুভূমিক সরণের ওপর এবং \(w_y\)-এর চিহ্ন উল্লম্ব সরণের ওপর নির্ভর করে।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(\mathbf{u}\) ভেক্টরের ক্ষেত্রে: \(O\) থেকে শীর্ষবিন্দু পর্যন্ত অনুভূমিক সরণ ডানদিকে (\(+X\)) এবং উল্লম্ব সরণ উপরের দিকে (\(+Y\))। সুতরাং, \(a > 0\) এবং \(b > 0\)।
\(\mathbf{v}\) ভেক্টরের ক্ষেত্রে: পাদবিন্দু থেকে শীর্ষবিন্দু পর্যন্ত অনুভূমিক সরণ ডানদিকে (\(+X\)) এবং উল্লম্ব সরণ নিচের দিকে (\(-Y\))। সুতরাং, \(p > 0\) এবং \(q < 0\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই এবং চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অতএব, \(a\), \(p\) এবং \(b\) ধনাত্মক এবং \(q\) ঋণাত্মক।

answer.text: \(a\) and \(p\) are positive while \(b\) and \(q\) are negative.
\(a, p\) and \(b\) are positive while \(q\) is negative.
\(a, q\) and \(b\) are positive while \(p\) is negative.
\(a, b, p\) and \(q\) are all positive.

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q04 - Maximum component of a vector along X-axis

questiontext.text:
The component of a vector \(\mathbf{r}\) along X-axis will have maximum value if

X-অক্ষ বরাবর একটি ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{r}\)-এর উপাংশের মান সর্বাধিক হবে যদি

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The component of a vector \(\mathbf{r}\) of magnitude \(r\) along the positive X-axis is given by \(r_x = r \cos\theta\), where \(\theta\) is the angle made by \(\mathbf{r}\) with the positive X-axis.

Step 2: Evaluation
Since the maximum value of \(\cos\theta\) is \(+1\), which occurs at \(\theta = 0^\circ\), the component \(r_x\) reaches its maximum value \(+r\) when \(\mathbf{r}\) points along the positive X-axis. Along the positive or negative Y-axis (\(\theta = 90^\circ\) or \(270^\circ\)), \(r_x = 0\). At \(\theta = 45^\circ\), \(r_x = \frac{r}{\sqrt{2}} < r\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the component of \(\mathbf{r}\) along the X-axis is maximum when \(\mathbf{r}\) is along the positive X-axis.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
\(r\) মানের একটি ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{r}\)-এর ধনাত্মক X-অক্ষ বরাবর উপাংশ হলো \(r_x = r \cos\theta\), যেখানে \(\theta\) হলো \(\mathbf{r}\) ভেক্টরটি ধনাত্মক X-অক্ষের সাথে যে কোণ উৎপন্ন করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
যেহেতু \(\cos\theta\)-এর সর্বাধিক মান \(+1\) এবং তা \(\theta = 0^\circ\) কোণে পাওয়া যায়, তাই \(\mathbf{r}\) যখন ধনাত্মক X-অক্ষ বরাবর থাকে তখন \(r_x\)-এর মান সর্বাধিক (\(+r\)) হয়। ধনাত্মক বা ঋণাত্মক Y-অক্ষ বরাবর (\(\theta = 90^\circ\) বা \(270^\circ\)) \(r_x = 0\) হয় এবং \(\theta = 45^\circ\) কোণে \(r_x = \frac{r}{\sqrt{2}} < r\) হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, \(\mathbf{r}\) ধনাত্মক X-অক্ষ বরাবর থাকলে X-অক্ষ বরাবর এর উপাংশের মান সর্বাধিক হবে।

answer.text: \(\mathbf{r}\) makes an angle of \(45^{\circ}\) with the X-axis

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q05 - Horizontal range of projectile at 45 degrees

questiontext.text:
The horizontal range of a projectile fired at an angle of \(15^{\circ}\) is \(50\text{ m}\). If it is fired with the same speed at an angle of \(45^{\circ}\), its range will be

\(15^{\circ}\) কোণে নিক্ষিপ্ত একটি প্রাসের অনুভূমিক পাল্লা \(50\text{ m}\)। যদি একই বেগে এটিকে \(45^{\circ}\) কোণে নিক্ষেপ করা হয়, তবে এর পাল্লা হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial projection angle \(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\), horizontal range \(R_1 = 50\text{ m}\).
Second projection angle \(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\), with the same projection speed \(u\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Air resistance is neglected and acceleration due to gravity \(g\) is constant over the trajectory, with launch and landing at the same horizontal level.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The horizontal range of a projectile launched with speed \(u\) at an angle \(\theta\) to the horizontal is \(R = \frac{u^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For \(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\):
\(R_1 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 15^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 30^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{2g} = 50\text{ m}\).
This gives \(\frac{u^2}{g} = 100\text{ m}\).
For \(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\):
\(R_2 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 45^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 90^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{g} = 100\text{ m}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The range at \(45^\circ\) is twice the range at \(15^\circ\), and the unit is metres (\(\text{m}\)). Thus, the range is \(100\text{ m}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
প্রথম নিক্ষেপণ কোণ \(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\), অনুভূমিক পাল্লা \(R_1 = 50\text{ m}\)।
দ্বিতীয় নিক্ষেপণ কোণ \(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\), এবং নিক্ষেপণ বেগ \(u\) একই রয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
বায়ুর বাধা নগণ্য এবং অভিকর্ষজ ত্বরণ \(g\) ধ্রুবক ধরা হয়েছে, এবং নিক্ষেপণ ও পতন একই অনুভূমিক তলে ঘটে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
অনুভূমিকের সাথে \(\theta\) কোণে \(u\) বেগে নিক্ষিপ্ত প্রাসের অনুভূমিক পাল্লা হলো \(R = \frac{u^2 \sin 2\theta}{g}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(\theta_1 = 15^\circ\)-এর জন্য:
\(R_1 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 15^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 30^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{2g} = 50\text{ m}\)।
এখান থেকে পাই, \(\frac{u^2}{g} = 100\text{ m}\)।
\(\theta_2 = 45^\circ\)-এর জন্য:
\(R_2 = \frac{u^2 \sin(2 \times 45^\circ)}{g} = \frac{u^2 \sin 90^\circ}{g} = \frac{u^2}{g} = 100\text{ m}\)।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই এবং চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(45^\circ\) কোণে পাল্লা \(15^\circ\) কোণের পাল্লার দ্বিগুণ এবং একক হলো মিটার (\(\text{m}\))। সুতরাং, পাল্লা হবে \(100\text{ m}\)।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q06 - Identifying vector quantities among given physical quantities

questiontext.text:
Consider the quantities, pressure, power, energy, impulse, gravitational potential, electrical charge, temperature, area. Out of these, the only vector quantities are

চাপ, ক্ষমতা, শক্তি, ঘাত, মহাকর্ষীয় বিভব, তড়িৎ আধান, তাপমাত্রা, ক্ষেত্রফল — এই রাশিগুলি বিবেচনা করো। এদের মধ্যে একমাত্র ভেক্টর রাশিগুলি হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A vector quantity possesses both magnitude and a specific direction and obeys the laws of vector addition, whereas a scalar quantity is specified by magnitude alone.

Step 2: Evaluation
- Pressure, power, energy, gravitational potential, electrical charge, and temperature are all scalar quantities.
- Impulse (\(\mathbf{J} = \mathbf{F}\Delta t = \Delta\mathbf{p}\)) has both magnitude and direction (the direction of change in momentum), so it is a vector.
- Area is treated as a vector quantity (\(\mathbf{A} = A\hat{\mathbf{n}}\)), directed perpendicular (normal) to the surface.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Out of the given quantities, only impulse and area are vector quantities.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
ভেক্টর রাশির মান ও নির্দিষ্ট দিক উভয়ই থাকে এবং এটি ভেক্টর যোগের সূত্র মেনে চলে, অন্যদিকে স্কেলার রাশি শুধুমাত্র মান দ্বারা প্রকাশিত হয়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
- চাপ, ক্ষমতা, শক্তি, মহাকর্ষীয় বিভব, তড়িৎ আধান এবং তাপমাত্রা সবই স্কেলার রাশি।
- ঘাত (\(\mathbf{J} = \mathbf{F}\Delta t = \Delta\mathbf{p}\))-এর মান এবং দিক (ভরবেগের পরিবর্তনের দিক) উভয়ই আছে, তাই এটি একটি ভেক্টর রাশি।
- ক্ষেত্রফলকে ভেক্টর রাশি (\(\mathbf{A} = A\hat{\mathbf{n}}\)) হিসেবে গণ্য করা হয়, যার দিক তলের সাথে অভিলম্ব বরাবর হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
প্রদত্ত রাশিগুলির মধ্যে শুধুমাত্র ঘাত এবং ক্ষেত্রফল হলো ভেক্টর রাশি।

name.text: NEETUG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MOTIONINAPLANE_MCQ_Q07 - Two-dimensional motion with constant positive speed

questiontext.text:
In a two dimensional motion, instantaneous speed \(v_0\) is a positive constant. Then which of the following are necessarily true?

একটি দ্বিমাত্রিক গতিতে, তাৎক্ষণিক দ্রুতি \(v_0\) একটি ধনাত্মক ধ্রুবক। তাহলে নিচের কোনটি আবশ্যিকভাবে সত্য?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Instantaneous speed is the rate of change of path length (distance) with respect to time: \(v_0 = \frac{ds}{dt}\). In two-dimensional motion, the direction of velocity can change even when speed \(v_0\) is constant.

Step 2: Evaluation
- For uniform circular motion at constant speed \(v_0\), the particle returns to its starting point after one full revolution, making displacement and average velocity zero; thus, average velocity need not be non-zero at all times.
- Over half a revolution in uniform circular motion, the velocity reverses direction, so \(\Delta \mathbf{v} = 2v_0 \neq 0\), meaning average acceleration does not always vanish.
- Because the direction of velocity can change, displacement vectors in equal time intervals need not be equal.
- Since \(v_0 = \frac{ds}{dt}\) is constant, the path length traversed in any time interval \(\Delta t\) is \(\Delta s = v_0 \Delta t\), which depends only on \(\Delta t\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, equal path lengths are necessarily traversed in equal intervals of time.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
