एक शॉटपुट प्रतियोगिता में एक एथलीट \(10\text{ kg}\) द्रव्यमान के शॉटपुट को जमीन से \(1.5\text{ m}\) की ऊँचाई से \(45^\circ\) के कोण पर \(1\text{ m s}^{-1}\) की प्रारंभिक चाल से फेंकता है। वायु प्रतिरोध को नगण्य तथा गुरुत्वीय त्वरण को \(10\text{ m s}^{-2}\) मानते हुए, ठीक जमीन पर पहुँचते समय शॉटपुट की गतिज ऊर्जा होगी

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the shotput, \(m = 10\text{ kg}\); initial speed, \(v_i = 1\text{ m s}^{-1}\); angle of projection, \(\theta = 45^\circ\); initial height above the ground, \(h_i = 1.5\text{ m}\); final height at the ground, \(h_f = 0\text{ m}\); acceleration due to gravity, \(g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}\); air resistance is negligible.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the ground level as the zero reference for gravitational potential energy (\(U_f = 0\)). Since air resistance is negligible, only the conservative gravitational force does work on the shotput during its flight.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By the law of conservation of mechanical energy, the total mechanical energy remains constant: \[K_i + U_i = K_f + U_f\] where kinetic energy \(K = \frac{1}{2}mv^2\) and gravitational potential energy \(U = mgh\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Initial kinetic energy: \[K_i = \frac{1}{2} m v_i^2 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10\text{ kg} \times (1\text{ m s}^{-1})^2 = 5.0\text{ J}\] Initial potential energy: \[U_i = m g h_i = 10\text{ kg} \times 10\text{ m s}^{-2} \times 1.5\text{ m} = 150.0\text{ J}\] Since \(U_f = 0\): \[K_f = K_i + U_i = 5.0\text{ J} + 150.0\text{ J} = 155.0\text{ J}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both terms have units of joules (\(\text{kg m}^2\text{ s}^{-2}\)), and the final kinetic energy is greater than the initial kinetic energy because potential energy converts into kinetic energy regardless of the projection angle. Thus, the kinetic energy of the shotput when it just reaches the ground is \(155.0\text{ J}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आंकड़े और शर्तें
शॉटपुट का द्रव्यमान, \(m = 10\text{ kg}\); प्रारंभिक चाल, \(v_i = 1\text{ m s}^{-1}\); प्रक्षेपण कोण, \(\theta = 45^\circ\); जमीन से प्रारंभिक ऊँचाई, \(h_i = 1.5\text{ m}\); जमीन पर अंतिम ऊँचाई, \(h_f = 0\text{ m}\); गुरुत्वीय त्वरण, \(g = 10\text{ m s}^{-2}\); वायु प्रतिरोध नगण्य है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएं और चिह्न परिपाटी
जमीन के स्तर को गुरुत्वीय स्थितिज ऊर्जा के शून्य संदर्भ (\(U_f = 0\)) के रूप में लें। चूँकि वायु प्रतिरोध नगण्य है, इसलिए उड़ान के दौरान शॉटपुट पर केवल संरक्षी गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल कार्य करता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
यांत्रिक ऊर्जा संरक्षण के नियम के अनुसार, कुल यांत्रिक ऊर्जा नियत रहती है: \[K_i + U_i = K_f + U_f\] जहाँ गतिज ऊर्जा \(K = \frac{1}{2}mv^2\) और गुरुत्वीय स्थितिज ऊर्जा \(U = mgh\) है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
प्रारंभिक गतिज ऊर्जा: \[K_i = \frac{1}{2} m v_i^2 = \frac{1}{2} \times 10\text{ kg} \times (1\text{ m s}^{-1})^2 = 5.0\text{ J}\] प्रारंभिक स्थितिज ऊर्जा: \[U_i = m g h_i = 10\text{ kg} \times 10\text{ m s}^{-2} \times 1.5\text{ m} = 150.0\text{ J}\] चूँकि \(U_f = 0\): \[K_f = K_i + U_i = 5.0\text{ J} + 150.0\text{ J} = 155.0\text{ J}\]

चरण 5: जांच और अंतिम उत्तर
दोनों पदों के मात्रक जूल (\(\text{kg m}^2\text{ s}^{-2}\)) हैं, और प्रक्षेपण कोण से स्वतंत्र रहते हुए स्थितिज ऊर्जा के गतिज ऊर्जा में रूपांतरण के कारण अंतिम गतिज ऊर्जा प्रारंभिक गतिज ऊर्जा से अधिक है। अतः ठीक जमीन पर पहुँचते समय शॉटपुट की गतिज ऊर्जा \(155.0\text{ J}\) है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQI_WORKENERGYPOWER_MCQ_Q617 - Kinetic energy versus depth for falling sphere

questiontext.text:
Which of the diagrams in Fig. 6.9 correctly shows the change in kinetic energy of an iron sphere falling freely in a lake having sufficient depth to impart it a terminal velocity?

चित्र 6.9 में कौन-सा आरेख किसी पर्याप्त गहरी झील, जिसमें लोहे का गोला सीमांत वेग प्राप्त कर सके, में मुक्त रूप से गिरते हुए लोहे के गोले की गतिज ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन को सही दर्शाता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An iron sphere falls freely from rest (zero initial speed at zero depth) in a lake of sufficient depth to reach terminal velocity \(v_T\). Each graph plots kinetic energy (\(\text{K.E.}\)) on the vertical axis against depth (\(h\)) on the horizontal axis.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Depth \(h\) is measured downward from the water surface (\(h = 0\)). Downward forces (weight \(mg\)) are taken as positive, while upward forces (buoyancy \(F_B\) and viscous drag \(F_v = 6\pi\eta r v\)) oppose the downward motion.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By the work-energy theorem, the rate of change of kinetic energy with depth equals the net downward force: \[\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh} = F_{\text{net}} = (mg - F_B) - 6\pi\eta r v\] where \(v\) is the instantaneous downward velocity.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
At \(h = 0\), the sphere starts from rest (\(v = 0\)), so \(\text{K.E.} = 0\) and the initial slope of the \(\text{K.E.}\) versus depth curve is maximum and positive: \[\left.\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh}\right|_{h=0} = mg - F_B > 0\] As the sphere descends, its speed \(v\) increases, causing the viscous drag \(6\pi\eta r v\) to increase. Consequently, \(F_{\text{net}}\) decreases continuously, meaning the slope \(\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh}\) decreases monotonically (the curve is concave downward). Once the sphere attains terminal velocity \(v_T\), \(6\pi\eta r v_T = mg - F_B\), so \(F_{\text{net}} = 0\). Beyond this depth, the slope becomes zero and the kinetic energy remains constant at \(\frac{1}{2}mv_T^2\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
A curve that starts at the origin with a non-zero positive slope, bends downward with decreasing slope, and flattens into a horizontal line at large depth matches the physical behavior. Therefore, the correct diagram is the one showing kinetic energy rising from zero with decreasing slope and asymptotically approaching a constant horizontal value.

चरण 1: दिए गए आंकड़े और शर्तें
लोहे का एक गोला पर्याप्त गहरी झील में विराम अवस्था (शून्य गहराई पर शून्य प्रारंभिक चाल) से मुक्त रूप से गिरता है और सीमांत वेग \(v_T\) प्राप्त करता है। प्रत्येक आरेख में ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर गतिज ऊर्जा (\(\text{K.E.}\)) तथा क्षैतिज अक्ष पर गहराई (\(h\)) दर्शाई गई है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएं और चिह्न परिपाटी
गहराई \(h\) को जल की सतह (\(h = 0\)) से नीचे की ओर मापा जाता है। नीचे की ओर लगने वाले बल (भार \(mg\)) को धनात्मक तथा ऊपर की ओर लगने वाले बलों (उत्प्लावन बल \(F_B\) और श्यान कर्षण बल \(F_v = 6\pi\eta r v\)) को गति के विपरीत लिया जाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
कार्य-ऊर्जा प्रमेय के अनुसार, गहराई के साथ गतिज ऊर्जा के परिवर्तन की दर नेट अधोमुखी बल के बराबर होती है: \[\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh} = F_{\text{net}} = (mg - F_B) - 6\pi\eta r v\] जहाँ \(v\) तात्क्षणिक अधोमुखी वेग है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
\(h = 0\) पर गोला विराम से प्रारंभ होता है (\(v = 0\)), इसलिए \(\text{K.E.} = 0\) और \(\text{K.E.}\) बनाम गहराई वक्र का प्रारंभिक ढाल अधिकतम तथा धनात्मक होता है: \[\left.\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh}\right|_{h=0} = mg - F_B > 0\] जैसे-जैसे गोला नीचे जाता है, उसकी चाल \(v\) बढ़ती है, जिससे श्यान कर्षण \(6\pi\eta r v\) बढ़ता है। परिणामस्वरूप \(F_{\text{net}}\) लगातार घटता है, अर्थात् वक्र का ढाल \(\frac{d(\text{K.E.})}{dh}\) एकदिष्ट रूप से घटता है (वक्र नीचे की ओर अवतल होता है)। जब गोला सीमांत वेग \(v_T\) प्राप्त कर लेता है, तब \(6\pi\eta r v_T = mg - F_B\), जिससे \(F_{\text{net}} = 0\) हो जाता है। इसके बाद ढाल शून्य हो जाता है और गतिज ऊर्जा \(\frac{1}{2}mv_T^2\) पर नियत रहती है।

चरण 5: जांच और अंतिम उत्तर
मूल बिंदु से धनात्मक ढाल के साथ प्रारंभ होकर घटते हुए ढाल के साथ मुड़ने वाला और अधिक गहराई पर क्षैतिज हो जाने वाला वक्र इस भौतिक व्यवहार के अनुरूप है। अतः सही आरेख वह है जिसमें गतिज ऊर्जा शून्य से घटते ढाल के साथ बढ़ती है और अंततः एक नियत क्षैतिज मान प्राप्त कर लेती है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQI_WORKENERGYPOWER_MCQ_Q618 - Force applied by batsman on bat

questiontext.text:
A cricket ball of mass \(150\text{ g}\) moving with a speed of \(126\text{ km/h}\) hits at the middle of the bat, held firmly at its position by the batsman. The ball moves straight back to the bowler after hitting the bat. Assuming that collision between ball and bat is completely elastic and the two remain in contact for \(0.001\text{ s}\), the force that the batsman had to apply to hold the bat firmly at its place would be

\(150\text{ g}\) द्रव्यमान की एक क्रिकेट की गेंद \(126\text{ km/h}\) की चाल से चलती हुई बल्लेबाज द्वारा अपने स्थान पर दृढ़ता से पकड़े गए बल्ले के बीचों-बीच टकराती है। बल्ले से टकराने के बाद गेंद सीधे गेंदबाज की ओर वापस लौटती है। यह मानते हुए कि गेंद और बल्ले के बीच संघट्ट पूर्णतः प्रत्यास्थ है तथा दोनों \(0.001\text{ s}\) तक संपर्क में रहते हैं, बल्ले को अपने स्थान पर दृढ़ता से थामे रखने के लिए बल्लेबाज द्वारा लगाया गया बल होगा

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the cricket ball, \(m = 150\text{ g} = 0.15\text{ kg}\); initial speed, \(u = 126\text{ km/h}\); contact duration, \(\Delta t = 0.001\text{ s} = 10^{-3}\text{ s}\); the bat is held stationary and the collision is completely elastic.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Take the direction from the bowler toward the batsman as positive. Since the bat is held firmly at rest and is effectively much more massive than the ball, in a completely elastic head-on collision the ball rebounds straight back with the same speed in the opposite direction (\(v = -u\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Convert speed from \(\text{km/h}\) to \(\text{m/s}\) using \(1\text{ km/h} = \frac{5}{18}\text{ m/s}\). By the impulse-momentum theorem, the average force \(F\) exerted on the ball (and by Newton's third law, equal in magnitude to the force required to hold the bat steady) is: \[F = \frac{|\Delta p|}{\Delta t} = \frac{|m(v - u)|}{\Delta t}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Converting the speed to SI units: \[u = 126 \times \frac{5}{18}\text{ m/s} = 35\text{ m/s}\] Final velocity of the ball: \[v = -35\text{ m/s}\] Magnitude of change in momentum: \[|\Delta p| = |0.15\text{ kg} \times (-35\text{ m/s} - 35\text{ m/s})| = 0.15 \times 70 = 10.5\text{ kg m s}^{-1}\] Average force applied: \[F = \frac{10.5\text{ N s}}{0.001\text{ s}} = 1.05 \times 10^4\text{ N}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The unit \(\text{kg m s}^{-2}\) corresponds to newtons (\(\text{N}\)), and a large impulsive force is expected for a very short contact time of \(1\text{ ms}\). Thus, the force the batsman had to apply is \(1.05 \times 10^4\text{ N}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आंकड़े और शर्तें
क्रिकेट की गेंद का द्रव्यमान, \(m = 150\text{ g} = 0.15\text{ kg}\); प्रारंभिक चाल, \(u = 126\text{ km/h}\); संपर्क समय, \(\Delta t = 0.001\text{ s} = 10^{-3}\text{ s}\); बल्ला स्थिर पकड़ा गया है और संघट्ट पूर्णतः प्रत्यास्थ है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएं और चिह्न परिपाटी
गेंदबाज से बल्लेबाज की ओर की दिशा को धनात्मक लें। चूँकि बल्ला दृढ़ता से स्थिर रखा गया है, इसलिए पूर्णतः प्रत्यास्थ सम्मुख संघट्ट में गेंद विपरीत दिशा में समान चाल से सीधे वापस लौटती है (\(v = -u\))।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
\(1\text{ km/h} = \frac{5}{18}\text{ m/s}\) का उपयोग करके चाल को \(\text{m/s}\) में बदलें। आवेग-संवेग प्रमेय से, गेंद पर लगने वाला औसत बल (तथा न्यूटन के तृतीय नियम से बल्ले को स्थिर रखने के लिए आवश्यक बल का परिमाण) है: \[F = \frac{|\Delta p|}{\Delta t} = \frac{|m(v - u)|}{\Delta t}\]

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
चाल को SI मात्रकों में बदलने पर: \[u = 126 \times \frac{5}{18}\text{ m/s} = 35\text{ m/s}\] गेंद का अंतिम वेग: \[v = -35\text{ m/s}\] संवेग परिवर्तन का परिमाण: \[|\Delta p| = |0.15\text{ kg} \times (-35\text{ m/s} - 35\text{ m/s})| = 0.15 \times 70 = 10.5\text{ kg m s}^{-1}\] आरोपित औसत बल: \[F = \frac{10.5\text{ N s}}{0.001\text{ s}} = 1.05 \times 10^4\text{ N}\]

चरण 5: जांच और अंतिम उत्तर
मात्रक \(\text{kg m s}^{-2}\) न्यूटन (\(\text{N}\)) के समतुल्य है, और \(1\text{ ms}\) जैसे अत्यंत अल्प संपर्क समय के लिए उच्च आवेगी बल अपेक्षित है। अतः बल्लेबाज द्वारा लगाया गया बल \(1.05 \times 10^4\text{ N}\) है।

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_WORKENERGYPOWER_MCQ_Q619 - Work done on man climbing staircase

questiontext.text:
A man, of mass \(m\), standing at the bottom of the staircase, of height \(L\) climbs it and stands at its top.

\(m\) द्रव्यमान का एक व्यक्ति \(L\) ऊँचाई की सीढ़ी के निचले सिरे पर खड़ा है, वह उस पर चढ़ता है और उसके शीर्ष पर खड़ा हो जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the work-energy theorem, the net work done by all forces (external and internal) acting on a body equals the change in its kinetic energy: \(W_{\text{all}} = \Delta K\). Also, mechanical work done by a force is \(W = \int \vec{F}\cdot d\vec{r}\), where \(d\vec{r}\) is the displacement of the point of application of the force.

Step 2: Evaluation of Forces and Energy
1. The man is initially at rest at the bottom (\(K_i = 0\)) and finally at rest at the top (\(K_f = 0\)). Therefore, \(\Delta K = K_f - K_i = 0\), which means the total work done by all forces on the man is zero (not \(mgL\)).
2. Gravitational force \(mg\) acts vertically downward while the man moves vertically upward by height \(L\). Hence, the work done by the gravitational force on the man is \(-mgL\) (negative, not \(+mgL\)).
3. While climbing, the normal reaction force from each step acts on the man's stationary foot; the point of application of this reaction force undergoes zero displacement while the force is acting. Consequently, the reaction force from a step does no work on the man. (Instead, internal muscular forces do positive work \(+mgL\) that raises the man's centre of mass.)

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the two correct conclusions are that the work done by all forces on the man is zero, and the reaction force from a step does not do work because the point of application of the force does not move while the force exists.

चरण 1: वैचारिक सिद्धांत
कार्य-ऊर्जा प्रमेय के अनुसार, किसी पिंड पर कार्य करने वाले सभी बलों (बाह्य तथा आंतरिक) द्वारा किया गया कुल कार्य उसकी गतिज ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन के बराबर होता है: \(W_{\text{all}} = \Delta K\)। साथ ही, किसी बल द्वारा किया गया कार्य \(W = \int \vec{F}\cdot d\vec{r}\) होता है, जहाँ \(d\vec{r}\) बल के अनुप्रयोग बिंदु का विस्थापन है।

चरण 2: बलों और ऊर्जा का मूल्यांकन
1. व्यक्ति प्रारंभ में नीचे विराम अवस्था में है (\(K_i = 0\)) और अंत में शीर्ष पर विराम अवस्था में है (\(K_f = 0\))। अतः \(\Delta K = K_f - K_i = 0\), जिसका अर्थ है कि व्यक्ति पर सभी बलों द्वारा किया गया कुल कार्य शून्य है (न कि \(mgL\))।
2. गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल \(mg\) ऊर्ध्वाधर नीचे की ओर लगता है जबकि व्यक्ति ऊर्ध्वाधर ऊपर की ओर \(L\) ऊँचाई तक जाता है। अतः गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल द्वारा किया गया कार्य \(-mgL\) है (ऋणात्मक, न कि \(+mgL\))।
3. चढ़ते समय, प्रत्येक सीढ़ी से लगने वाला प्रतिक्रिया बल व्यक्ति के स्थिर पैर पर कार्य करता है; जब यह बल कार्य कर रहा होता है, तब बल के अनुप्रयोग बिंदु का विस्थापन शून्य होता है। अतः सीढ़ी से लगने वाला प्रतिक्रिया बल कोई कार्य नहीं करता। (इसके बजाय आंतरिक पेशीय बल \(+mgL\) धनात्मक कार्य करते हैं।)

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः दो सही निष्कर्ष यह हैं कि व्यक्ति पर सभी बलों द्वारा किया गया कार्य शून्य है, तथा सीढ़ी से लगने वाला प्रतिक्रिया बल कार्य नहीं करता क्योंकि बल के अस्तित्व के दौरान बल के अनुप्रयोग बिंदु की गति नहीं होती।

answer.text: Work done by all forces on man is equal to the rise in potential energy \(mgL\).
Work done by all forces on man is zero.
Work done by the gravitational force on man is \(mgL\).
The reaction force from a step does not do work because the point of application of the force does not move while the force exists.

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_WORKENERGYPOWER_MCQ_Q620 - Bullet emerging from soft target

questiontext.text:
A bullet of mass \(m\) fired at \(30^{\circ}\) to the horizontal leaves the barrel of the gun with a velocity \(v\). The bullet hits a soft target at a height \(h\) above the ground while it is moving downward and emerges out with half the kinetic energy it had before hitting the target.

Which of the following statements are correct in respect of bullet after it emerges out of the target?

\(m\) द्रव्यमान की एक गोली क्षैतिज से \(30^{\circ}\) के कोण पर दागी जाती है और \(v\) वेग से बंदूक की नाल से बाहर निकलती है। नीचे की ओर गति करते समय गोली जमीन से \(h\) ऊँचाई पर एक नरम लक्ष्य से टकराती है और टकराने से पहले की अपनी गतिज ऊर्जा की आधी गतिज ऊर्जा के साथ बाहर निकलती है।

लक्ष्य से बाहर निकलने के बाद गोली के संबंध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सही हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A bullet of mass \(m\) is fired at \(30^\circ\) to the horizontal with initial speed \(v\). While descending at height \(h\), it passes through a soft target and emerges with kinetic energy \(K_2 = \frac{1}{2} K_1\), where \(K_1\) is its kinetic energy just before entering the target.

Step 2: Evaluation of Speed and Trajectory
Let \(v_1\) and \(v_2\) be the speeds of the bullet just before hitting and just after emerging from the target. Since \(K_2 = \frac{1}{2} K_1\): \[\frac{1}{2} m v_2^2 = \frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{1}{2} m v_1^2\right) \implies v_2 = \frac{v_1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.707\,v_1\] Because \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} > \frac{1}{2}\), the velocity (speed) of the bullet after emerging is more than half of its earlier velocity.
Furthermore, because the bullet's velocity changes upon emerging while it still retains a non-zero horizontal component and moves under gravity, it does not fall vertically downward nor follow the original trajectory; instead, it moves along a different parabolic path.

Step 3: Evaluation of Energy Dissipation
Half of the bullet's kinetic energy is lost inside the soft target due to resistive forces. By conservation of energy, this lost mechanical energy is converted into heat and deformation energy, increasing the internal energy of the particles of the target.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, after emerging from the target, the bullet's velocity is more than half of its earlier velocity, it moves in a different parabolic path, and the internal energy of the particles of the target increases.

चरण 1: दिए गए आंकड़े और शर्तें
\(m\) द्रव्यमान की एक गोली क्षैतिज से \(30^\circ\) पर \(v\) प्रारंभिक चाल से दागी जाती है। \(h\) ऊँचाई पर नीचे आते समय यह एक नरम लक्ष्य को भेदती है और \(K_2 = \frac{1}{2} K_1\) गतिज ऊर्जा के साथ बाहर निकलती है, जहाँ \(K_1\) लक्ष्य से टकराने से ठीक पहले की गतिज ऊर्जा है।

चरण 2: चाल और प्रक्षेप पथ का मूल्यांकन
माना लक्ष्य से टकराने से ठीक पहले तथा निकलने के ठीक बाद गोली की चाल क्रमशः \(v_1\) और \(v_2\) है। चूँकि \(K_2 = \frac{1}{2} K_1\): \[\frac{1}{2} m v_2^2 = \frac{1}{2} \left(\frac{1}{2} m v_1^2\right) \implies v_2 = \frac{v_1}{\sqrt{2}} \approx 0.707\,v_1\] चूँकि \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} > \frac{1}{2}\), इसलिए बाहर निकलने के बाद गोली का वेग उसके पहले के वेग के आधे से अधिक होता है।
इसके अतिरिक्त, बाहर निकलने पर गोली का वेग परिवर्तित हो जाता है जबकि उसमें क्षैतिज घटक अभी भी विद्यमान रहता है और वह गुरुत्व के अधीन गति करती है; अतः यह न तो ऊर्ध्वाधर नीचे गिरती है और न ही पुराने पथ पर रहती है, बल्कि एक भिन्न परवलयाकार पथ पर गति करती है।

चरण 3: ऊर्जा क्षय का मूल्यांकन
प्रतिरोधी बलों के कारण गोली की आधी गतिज ऊर्जा नरम लक्ष्य के भीतर व्यय हो जाती है। ऊर्जा संरक्षण के अनुसार, यह यांत्रिक ऊर्जा ऊष्मा और विरूपण ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित होकर लक्ष्य के कणों की आंतरिक ऊर्जा को बढ़ा देती है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः लक्ष्य से बाहर निकलने के बाद गोली का वेग उसके पहले के वेग के आधे से अधिक होगा, गोली एक भिन्न परवलयाकार पथ पर गति करेगी, और लक्ष्य के कणों की आंतरिक ऊर्जा बढ़ेगी।

answer.text: The velocity of the bullet will be reduced to half its initial value.
The velocity of the bullet will be more than half of its earlier velocity.
The bullet will continue to move along the same parabolic path.
The bullet will move in a different parabolic path.
The bullet will fall vertically downward after hitting the target.
The internal energy of the particles of the target will increase.

name.text: NCERTEXEMPLAR_PHYSICS_MCQII_WORKENERGYPOWER_MCQ_Q621 - Head-on collision of equal mass blocks

questiontext.text:
Two blocks \(M_1\) and \(M_2\) having equal mass are free to move on a horizontal frictionless surface. \(M_2\) is attached to a massless spring as shown in Fig. 6.10. Initially \(M_2\) is at rest and \(M_1\) is moving toward \(M_2\) with speed \(v\) and collides head-on with \(M_2\).

दो समान द्रव्यमान के गुटके \(M_1\) और \(M_2\) एक क्षैतिज घर्षणरहित पृष्ठ पर गति करने के लिए स्वतंत्र हैं। चित्र 6.10 में दर्शाए अनुसार \(M_2\) से एक द्रव्यमानरहित स्प्रिंग जुड़ी है। प्रारंभ में \(M_2\) विरामावस्था में है तथा \(M_1\), \(v\) चाल से \(M_2\) की ओर गति करते हुए \(M_2\) से सम्मुख संघट्ट करता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two blocks of equal mass \(M_1 = M_2 = m\) lie on a horizontal frictionless surface. Block \(M_2\) has a massless spring attached to it and is initially at rest. Block \(M_1\) moves with speed \(v\) toward \(M_2\) and collides head-on.

Step 2: Evaluation of Momentum and Energy at Maximum Compression
1. Since there is no external horizontal force on the two-block and spring system, linear momentum is conserved at every instant during the collision, including when the spring is fully compressed.
2. At full compression, both blocks move with a common velocity \(v_{\text{cm}}\). By momentum conservation: \[mv = (m + m)v_{\text{cm}} \implies v_{\text{cm}} = \frac{v}{2}\] Hence, at maximum compression, the system still possesses kinetic energy \(\frac{1}{2}(2m)\left(\frac{v}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{4}mv^2\), which is half of the initial kinetic energy. Thus, not all of the initial kinetic energy of \(M_1\) is stored as potential energy of the spring.

Step 3: Evaluation of Final State and Effect of Friction
3. Because the spring is massless and the surface is frictionless, no mechanical energy is lost; the collision is completely elastic. In a one-dimensional elastic collision between two equal masses where the second mass is initially at rest, the two bodies exchange velocities: \(M_1\) comes to rest and \(M_2\) moves forward with speed \(v\).
4. If the horizontal surface has friction, mechanical energy is dissipated as heat during the motion and compression/expansion process, so kinetic energy is not conserved and the collision cannot be elastic.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Therefore, if the spring is massless, the final state of \(M_1\) is a state of rest, and if the surface on which the blocks are moving has friction, then the collision cannot be elastic.

चरण 1: दिए गए आंकड़े और शर्तें
समान द्रव्यमान \(M_1 = M_2 = m\) के दो गुटके एक क्षैतिज घर्षणरहित पृष्ठ पर रखे हैं। गुटके \(M_2\) से एक द्रव्यमानरहित स्प्रिंग जुड़ी है और वह प्रारंभ में विराम अवस्था में है। गुटका \(M_1\), \(v\) चाल से \(M_2\) की ओर गति करता है और सम्मुख संघट्ट करता है।

चरण 2: अधिकतम संपीडन पर संवेग और ऊर्जा का मूल्यांकन
1. चूँकि दोनों गुटकों तथा स्प्रिंग के निकाय पर कोई बाह्य क्षैतिज बल कार्य नहीं कर रहा है, अतः स्प्रिंग के पूर्णतः संपीडित होने सहित संघट्ट के प्रत्येक क्षण पर रैखिक संवेग संरक्षित रहता है।
2. पूर्ण संपीडन की स्थिति में दोनों गुटके एक उभयनिष्ठ वेग \(v_{\text{cm}}\) से गति करते हैं। संवेग संरक्षण से: \[mv = (m + m)v_{\text{cm}} \implies v_{\text{cm}} = \frac{v}{2}\] अतः अधिकतम संपीडन पर निकाय की गतिज ऊर्जा \(\frac{1}{2}(2m)\left(\frac{v}{2}\right)^2 = \frac{1}{4}mv^2\) होती है, जो प्रारंभिक गतिज ऊर्जा की आधी है। इसलिए \(M_1\) की संपूर्ण गतिज ऊर्जा स्प्रिंग की स्थितिज ऊर्जा में संचित नहीं होती।

चरण 3: अंतिम अवस्था और घर्षण के प्रभाव का मूल्यांकन
3. चूँकि स्प्रिंग द्रव्यमानरहित है और पृष्ठ घर्षणरहित है, अतः कोई यांत्रिक ऊर्जा क्षय नहीं होता और संघट्ट पूर्णतः प्रत्यास्थ होता है। समान द्रव्यमानों के एकविमीय प्रत्यास्थ संघट्ट में, जब दूसरा पिंड प्रारंभ में विराम में हो, दोनों पिंड अपने वेगों का विनिमय कर लेते हैं: \(M_1\) विराम में आ जाता है और \(M_2\), \(v\) चाल से आगे बढ़ता है।
4. यदि पृष्ठ पर घर्षण हो, तो गति के दौरान यांत्रिक ऊर्जा ऊष्मा के रूप में क्षयित होगी, जिससे गतिज ऊर्जा संरक्षित नहीं रहेगी और संघट्ट प्रत्यास्थ नहीं हो सकता।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः यदि स्प्रिंग द्रव्यमानरहित है तो \(M_1\) की अंतिम अवस्था विराम अवस्था होगी, तथा यदि गुटकों की गति वाले पृष्ठ पर घर्षण है तो संघट्ट प्रत्यास्थ नहीं हो सकता।

answer.text: While spring is fully compressed all the KE of \(M_1\) is stored as PE of spring.
While spring is fully compressed the system momentum is not conserved, though final momentum is equal to initial momentum.
If spring is massless, the final state of the \(M_1\) is state of rest.
If the surface on which blocks are moving has friction, then collision cannot be elastic.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q71 - Centre of mass outside the body

questiontext.text: 7.1 For which of the following does the centre of mass lie outside the body?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The centre of mass of a body is the weighted average position of all its mass elements. For a solid, convex, uniform body, the centre of mass lies inside the material of the body. However, for a hollow or ring-shaped body with a central cavity, the centre of mass can lie in the empty space outside the physical material.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Body
A pencil, a shotput (solid sphere), and a dice (solid cube) are all solid bodies whose mass is distributed continuously throughout their volume, so their centres of mass lie inside their respective materials. A bangle is a circular ring whose mass is concentrated along its circumference. By symmetry, its centre of mass lies at its geometric centre, which is in the empty space surrounded by the ring.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the centre of mass lies outside the body for a bangle.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q72 - Centre of mass of sphere with sand

questiontext.text: 7.2 Which of the following points is the likely position of the centre of mass of the system shown in Fig. 7.1?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The centre of mass of a composite system shifts toward the region containing greater mass. In a hollow sphere whose upper half is filled with air and lower half is filled with sand, the density of sand is much greater than the density of air.

Step 2: Evaluation of the Mass Distribution
Because the lower hemisphere contains sand (far greater mass than the air in the upper hemisphere), the centre of mass of the system must lie below the geometric centre of the sphere along the vertical axis of symmetry. For a uniform solid hemisphere of radius \(R\), the centre of mass lies at a distance \(\frac{3R}{8}\) below the flat face (the geometric centre). Including the uniform hollow spherical shell shifts the centre of mass slightly upward toward the geometric centre, placing it just below the horizontal diameter in the sand-filled region.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Point C lies along the vertical symmetry axis just below the geometric centre inside the sand-filled lower half, so C is the likely position of the centre of mass.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q73 - Change in angular momentum on elastic bounce

questiontext.text: 7.3 A particle of mass \(m\) is moving in \(yz\)-plane with a uniform velocity \(v\) with its trajectory running parallel to \(+\text{ve}\) \(y\)-axis and intersecting \(z\)-axis at \(z = a\) (Fig. 7.2). The change in its angular momentum about the origin as it bounces elastically from a wall at \(y = \text{constant}\) is:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A particle of mass \(m\) moves in the \(yz\)-plane parallel to the \(+y\)-axis at \(z = a\) with uniform speed \(v\). It bounces elastically from a wall located at \(y = \text{constant}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\) form a right-handed orthonormal basis. Before hitting the wall, the velocity is \(\mathbf{v}_i = v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\). Since the collision with the wall at \(y = \text{constant}\) is elastic and normal to the wall, the \(y\)-component of velocity reverses while \(z = a\) remains unchanged, giving \(\mathbf{v}_f = -v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The angular momentum of a particle about the origin is \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p} = m(\mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{v})\). The position vector at the wall is \(\mathbf{r} = y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Initial angular momentum about the origin:
\[\mathbf{L}_i = m(y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\]
Final angular momentum about the origin:
\[\mathbf{L}_f = m(y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (-v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = +mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\]
Change in angular momentum:
\[\Delta \mathbf{L} = \mathbf{L}_f - \mathbf{L}_i = mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x - (-mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x) = 2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units of \(mva\) are \(\text{kg}\cdot\text{m}^2/\text{s}\), matching angular momentum, and the vector is independent of \(y\) as required. Therefore, the change in angular momentum is \(2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\).

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q74 - Disc rotating with uniform angular velocity

questiontext.text: 7.4 When a disc rotates with uniform angular velocity, which of the following is not true?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Uniform angular velocity means that the angular velocity vector \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) is constant in both magnitude (angular speed) and direction (orientation of the axis and sense of rotation) over time, and is non-zero if the disc is rotating.

Step 2: Evaluation
Since \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) is constant, the sense of rotation remains the same, the orientation of the axis of rotation remains the same, and the speed of rotation is non-zero and remains constant. However, angular acceleration is defined as \(\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \frac{d\boldsymbol{\omega}}{dt}\). Because \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) does not change with time, \(\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \mathbf{0}\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Thus, the statement that the angular acceleration is non-zero and remains same is not true.

answer.text: The orientation of the axis of rotation remains same.
The speed of rotation is non-zero and remains same.
The angular acceleration is non-zero and remains same.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q75 - Moment of inertia of square plate with hole

questiontext.text: 7.5 A uniform square plate has a small piece \(Q\) of an irregular shape removed and glued to the centre of the plate leaving a hole behind (Fig. 7.3). The moment of inertia about the \(z\)-axis is then

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The moment of inertia of a system about an axis is given by \(I_z = \sum m_i r_i^2\), where \(r_i\) is the perpendicular distance of mass element \(m_i\) from the \(z\)-axis.

Step 2: Evaluation
Originally, the piece \(Q\) of mass \(m_Q\) was located at some non-zero distance \(r > 0\) from the \(z\)-axis (which passes through the centre of the plate). Removing \(Q\) reduces the moment of inertia by \(\Delta I_{\text{removed}} = m_Q r^2\). Gluing the same piece at the centre of the plate places its mass closer to (effectively on) the \(z\)-axis, contributing a much smaller moment of inertia \(I_{\text{centre}} \ll m_Q r^2\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Since mass is moved closer to the axis of rotation, the net moment of inertia about the \(z\)-axis is decreased.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q76 - Quadrant of centre of mass of modified plate

questiontext.text: 7.6 In problem 7.5 (a uniform square plate has a small piece \(Q\) of an irregular shape removed from the first quadrant and glued to the centre of the plate leaving a hole behind, as shown in Fig. 7.3), the CM of the plate is now in the following quadrant of \(x\)-\(y\) plane,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For a uniform square plate centred at the origin \((0,0)\), the initial centre of mass is at \((0,0)\). If a piece of mass \(m_Q\) located at \((x_Q, y_Q)\) is removed and placed at the origin \((0,0)\), the new centre of mass coordinates are \(\mathbf{r}_{\text{cm}} = \frac{M_{\text{total}}(0,0) - m_Q(x_Q, y_Q) + m_Q(0,0)}{M_{\text{total}}} = -\frac{m_Q}{M_{\text{total}}}(x_Q, y_Q)\).

Step 2: Evaluation
From the diagram, the removed piece \(Q\) lies in the first quadrant, where \(x_Q > 0\) and \(y_Q > 0\). Therefore, the new centre of mass has coordinates \(x_{\text{cm}} < 0\) and \(y_{\text{cm}} < 0\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both coordinates being negative places the new centre of mass in quadrant III.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q77 - Centre of mass of non-uniform rod

questiontext.text: 7.7 The density of a non-uniform rod of length \(1\text{ m}\) is given by \(\rho(x) = a(1+bx^2)\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants and \(0 \le x \le 1\). The centre of mass of the rod will be at

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A rod of length \(L = 1\text{ m}\) extends from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 1\) with linear mass density \(\rho(x) = a(1 + bx^2)\), where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The rod lies along the \(x\)-axis from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 1\). An infinitesimal element of length \(dx\) at position \(x\) has mass \(dm = \rho(x)\,dx\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The \(x\)-coordinate of the centre of mass of a continuous one-dimensional body is:
\[x_{\text{cm}} = \frac{\int_0^L x \rho(x)\,dx}{\int_0^L \rho(x)\,dx}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Evaluate the numerator:
\[\int_0^1 x \cdot a(1 + bx^2)\,dx = a \int_0^1 (x + bx^3)\,dx = a \left[ \frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{bx^4}{4} \right]_0^1 = a\left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{b}{4}\right) = \frac{a(2 + b)}{4}\]
Evaluate the denominator:
\[\int_0^1 a(1 + bx^2)\,dx = a \left[ x + \frac{bx^3}{3} \right]_0^1 = a\left(1 + \frac{b}{3}\right) = \frac{a(3 + b)}{3}\]
Divide the numerator by the denominator:
\[x_{\text{cm}} = \frac{\frac{a(2 + b)}{4}}{\frac{a(3 + b)}{3}} = \frac{3(2 + b)}{4(3 + b)}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
For a uniform rod (\(b = 0\)), the expression gives \(x_{\text{cm}} = \frac{3 \times 2}{4 \times 3} = \frac{1}{2}\text{ m}\), which is correct. Thus, the centre of mass is at \(\frac{3(2+b)}{4(3+b)}\).

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQI_Q78 - Merry-go-round angular speed after jump

questiontext.text: 7.8 A Merry-go-round, made of a ring-like platform of radius \(R\) and mass \(M\), is revolving with angular speed \(\omega\). A person of mass \(M\) is standing on it. At one instant, the person jumps off the round, radially away from the centre of the round (as seen from the round). The speed of the round afterwards is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A ring-like platform of mass \(M\) and radius \(R\) rotates with angular speed \(\omega\), carrying a person of mass \(M\) on its rim. The person jumps off radially away from the centre as seen from the round.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
No external torque acts on the platform-plus-person system about the vertical rotation axis. Furthermore, as seen from the round, the person jumps radially, meaning the impulse exerted by the person on the round is purely radial.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Angular momentum of the system is conserved: \(L_i = L_f\). Also, a radial force has zero moment arm about the centre, so \(\boldsymbol{\tau} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Because the person jumps radially as seen from the rotating platform, the person retains the tangential velocity \(v_t = \omega R\) of the platform rim at the instant of leaving. Therefore, the angular momentum carried away by the person is \(L_{\text{person}} = M v_t R = M R^2 \omega\).
Initially, the total angular momentum is:
\[L_i = (I_{\text{ring}} + I_{\text{person}})\omega = (MR^2 + MR^2)\omega = 2MR^2\omega\]
After the jump, by conservation of angular momentum:
\[L_{\text{ring}}' + L_{\text{person}} = 2MR^2\omega \implies MR^2\omega' + MR^2\omega = 2MR^2\omega \implies \omega' = \omega\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Equivalently, since the person exerts only a radial force on the round, zero torque acts on the round itself, so its angular speed remains \(\omega\).

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQII_Q79 - Direction of angular momentum and momentum

questiontext.text: 7.9 Choose the correct alternatives:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In rotational motion, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) are related through the inertia tensor. In translational motion, linear momentum is \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Statement
1. For a general rotational motion (for example, rotation about an axis that is not a principal axis of symmetry), \(\mathbf{L}\) and \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel.
2. Even for rotation about a fixed axis, if the body is not symmetric about that axis (not a principal axis), \(\mathbf{L}\) has components perpendicular to \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\), so they are not always parallel.
3. For general translational motion, \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\), where mass \(m\) is a positive scalar; therefore, \(\mathbf{p}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.
4. In general translational motion (such as projectile motion or circular motion), the acceleration \(\mathbf{a}\) can be at any angle to the velocity \(\mathbf{v}\), so they need not be parallel.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The correct statements are that for a general rotational motion, \(\mathbf{L}\) and \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel, and for a general translational motion, \(\mathbf{p}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.

answer.text: For a general rotational motion, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel.
For a rotational motion about a fixed axis, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) are always parallel.
For a general translational motion, momentum \(\mathbf{p}\) and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.
For a general translational motion, acceleration \(\mathbf{a}\) and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQII_Q710 - Angular momentum of two parallel moving particles

questiontext.text: 7.10 Figure 7.4 shows two identical particles 1 and 2, each of mass \(m\), moving in opposite directions with same speed \(v\) along parallel lines. At a particular instant, \(\mathbf{r}_1\) and \(\mathbf{r}_2\) are their respective position vectors drawn from point A which is in the plane of the parallel lines. Choose the correct options:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two particles 1 and 2, each of mass \(m\), move with speed \(v\) in opposite directions along parallel lines at perpendicular distances \(d_1\) and \(d_2\) (\(d_2 > d_1\)) from point A in the same plane.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(\odot\) denote a unit vector directed out of the page and \(\otimes\) denote a unit vector directed into the page. Particle 1 moves to the right along the upper line, and particle 2 moves to the left along the lower line.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The angular momentum of a particle about point A is \(\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\), whose magnitude is \(mvd\), where \(d\) is the perpendicular distance from A to the line of motion.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For particle 1: \(\mathbf{r}_1\) points down and right from A, while \(\mathbf{v}_1\) points to the right. By the right-hand rule, \(\mathbf{r}_1 \times \mathbf{v}_1\) points out of the page (\(\odot\)), with magnitude \(mvd_1\). Thus \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1\odot\).
For particle 2: \(\mathbf{r}_2\) points down and right from A, while \(\mathbf{v}_2\) points to the left. By the right-hand rule, \(\mathbf{r}_2 \times \mathbf{v}_2\) points into the page (\(\otimes\)), with magnitude \(mvd_2\). Thus \(\mathbf{l}_2 = mvd_2\otimes\).
Since \(d_2 > d_1\) and \(\mathbf{l}_1\) and \(\mathbf{l}_2\) are oppositely directed, the total angular momentum about A is:
\[\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{l}_1 + \mathbf{l}_2 = mv(d_2 - d_1)\otimes\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The magnitudes use perpendicular distances \(d_1\) and \(d_2\) rather than \(r_1\) and \(r_2\). Hence, \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1\odot\) and \(\mathbf{l} = mv(d_2 - d_1)\otimes\) are correct.

answer.text: Angular momentum \(\mathbf{l}_1\) of particle 1 about A is \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \odot\)
Angular momentum \(\mathbf{l}_2\) of particle 2 about A is \(\mathbf{l}_2 = mvr_2 \otimes\)
Total angular momentum of the system about A is \(\mathbf{l} = mv(r_1 + r_2) \odot\)

Total angular momentum of the system about A is \(\mathbf{l} = mv(d_2 - d_1) \otimes\)
\(\odot\) represents a unit vector coming out of the page. \(\otimes\) represents a unit vector going into the page.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQII_Q711 - Conditions for zero net external torque

questiontext.text: 7.11 The net external torque on a system of particles about an axis is zero. Which of the following are compatible with it?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The torque of a force \(\mathbf{F}\) about an axis is the component along that axis of \(\boldsymbol{\tau} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{F}\), where \(\mathbf{r}\) is the position vector from a point on the axis to the point of application of the force.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Condition
1. If forces act radially from a point on the axis, \(\mathbf{r}\) and \(\mathbf{F}\) are parallel (or antiparallel), so \(\mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{F} = \mathbf{0}\).
2. If forces act directly on the axis of rotation, the perpendicular distance from the axis is zero (\(\mathbf{r} = \mathbf{0}\)), giving zero torque.
3. If forces act parallel to the axis of rotation, \(\mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{F}\) is perpendicular to the axis, so its component along the axis of rotation is zero.
4. If individual forces produce non-zero torques that are equal in magnitude and opposite in direction, their vector sum is zero.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
All four situations are compatible with the net external torque about the axis being zero.

answer.text: The forces may be acting radially from a point on the axis.
The forces may be acting on the axis of rotation.
The forces may be acting parallel to the axis of rotation.
The torque caused by some forces may be equal and opposite to that caused by other forces.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQII_Q712 - Torque on lamina about two perpendicular axes

questiontext.text: 7.12 Figure 7.5 shows a lamina in \(x\)-\(y\) plane. Two axes \(z\) and \(z'\) pass perpendicular to its plane. A force \(\mathbf{F}\) acts in the plane of lamina at point P as shown. Which of the following are true? (The point P is closer to \(z'\)-axis than the \(z\)-axis.)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A force \(\mathbf{F}\) acts in the \(x\)-\(y\) plane at point P on a lamina. Two parallel axes \(z\) and \(z'\) are perpendicular to the lamina (pointing along \(+\hat{\mathbf{k}}\)), with P closer to the \(z'\)-axis than to the \(z\)-axis.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Torque about an axis is given by \(\boldsymbol{\tau} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{F}\), where \(\mathbf{r}\) is drawn from the axis to point P, and the direction is determined by the right-hand rule.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Magnitude of torque is \(\tau = r_\perp F\), where \(r_\perp\) is the perpendicular distance from the axis to the line of action of \(\mathbf{F}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. From the \(z\)-axis (on the left) to P, \(\mathbf{r}\) points toward the right, and \(\mathbf{F}\) tends to rotate the lamina counter-clockwise about the \(z\)-axis when viewed from above, so \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\) is along \(+\hat{\mathbf{k}}\), not \(-\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).
2. From the \(z'\)-axis (on the right) to P, \(\mathbf{r}'\) points toward the left, and \(\mathbf{F}\) tends to rotate the lamina clockwise about the \(z'\)-axis when viewed from above, so \(\boldsymbol{\tau}'\) is along \(-\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).
3. Because P is farther from the \(z\)-axis than from the \(z'\)-axis, the perpendicular lever arm from the \(z\)-axis is larger, so the magnitude of \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\) about the \(z\)-axis is greater than that about the \(z'\)-axis.
4. Torques calculated about two different axes cannot be added together to give a "total torque".

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, the torque \(\boldsymbol{\tau}'\) about the \(z'\)-axis is along \(-\hat{\mathbf{k}}\), and the torque \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\) about the \(z\)-axis is greater in magnitude than that about the \(z'\)-axis.

answer.text: Torque \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\) caused by \(\mathbf{F}\) about \(z\) axis is along \(-\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).
Torque \(\boldsymbol{\tau}'\) caused by \(\mathbf{F}\) about \(z'\) axis is along \(-\hat{\mathbf{k}}\).
Torque \(\boldsymbol{\tau}\) caused by \(\mathbf{F}\) about \(z\) axis is greater in magnitude than that about \(z'\) axis.

name.text: PHYSICS_CH07_MCQII_Q713 - Moment of inertia of a cube

questiontext.text: 7.13 With reference to Fig. 7.6 of a cube of edge \(a\) and mass \(m\), state whether the following are true or false. (O is the centre of the cube.) Select the true statements.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A uniform solid cube of edge length \(a\) and mass \(m\) has its centre at O. The \(x\), \(y\), and \(z\) axes pass through O parallel to the edges of the cube. The axis \(z'\) passes along edge AD parallel to the \(z\)-axis, and the axis \(z''\) passes along the face diagonal BG.

Step 2: Relevant Formulae and Principles
1. The perpendicular axis theorem (\(I_z = I_x + I_y\)) applies only to planar (2D) laminae, not to 3D solids like a cube.
2. By the parallel axis theorem, \(I = I_{\text{cm}} + md^2\) for two parallel axes separated by distance \(d\).

Step 3: Step-by-Step Evaluation
1. Because the cube is a 3D body, \(I_x = I_y = I_z = \frac{1}{6}ma^2\) by symmetry, so \(I_z \neq I_x + I_y\). Hence \(I_z = I_x + I_y\) is false.
2. The axis \(z'\) (along edge AD) is parallel to the \(z\)-axis through O, and the perpendicular distance between them is \(d = \sqrt{\left(\frac{a}{2}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{a}{2}\right)^2} = \frac{a}{\sqrt{2}}\). By the parallel axis theorem, \(I'_z = I_z + m\left(\frac{a}{\sqrt{2}}\right)^2 = I_z + \frac{ma^2}{2}\). Hence this relation is true.
3. The axis \(z''\) (along BG) is not parallel to the \(z\)-axis, so the parallel axis theorem cannot be applied between \(z\) and \(z''\). Hence \(I''_z = I_z + \frac{ma^2}{2}\) is false.
4. By symmetry of the cube about its centre O, the moments of inertia about the \(x\)-axis and \(y\)-axis are equal: \(I_x = I_y\). Hence this is true.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The true statements are \(I'_z = I_z + \frac{ma^2}{2}\) and \(I_x = I_y\).

answer.text: The moment of inertia of cube about \(z\)-axis is \(I_z = I_x + I_y\)
The moment of inertia of cube about \(z'\) is \(I'_z = I_z + \frac{ma^2}{2}\)
The moment of inertia of cube about \(z''\) is \(I''_z = I_z + \frac{ma^2}{2}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_1 - Centre of mass lying outside the body

questiontext.text:
7.1 For which of the following does the centre of mass lie outside the body?

৭.১ নিচের কোনটির ভরকেন্দ্র বস্তুর বাইরে অবস্থান করে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The centre of mass of a rigid body is the weighted average position of its mass distribution. For a uniform, solid, convex object, the centre of mass lies inside the material of the body. However, for a hollow or ring-shaped object, the mass is distributed around an empty central region, so the centre of mass can lie in the empty space outside the material.

Step 2: Evaluation
A pencil, a shotput (solid sphere), and a dice (solid cube) are all solid objects whose mass is distributed throughout their interior, so their centres of mass lie inside the body. A bangle is a thin circular ring; by symmetry, its centre of mass lies at its geometric centre, where there is no material.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the centre of mass lies outside the body for a bangle.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
কোনো দৃঢ় বস্তুর ভরকেন্দ্র হলো তার ভর বণ্টনের গড় অবস্থান। সুষম ও নিরেট বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে ভরকেন্দ্র বস্তুর উপাদানের ভেতরেই থাকে। কিন্তু ফাঁপা বা বলয়াকৃতি বস্তুর ক্ষেত্রে ভর একটি খালি কেন্দ্রের চারপাশে বণ্টিত থাকে, ফলে ভরকেন্দ্র বস্তুর উপাদানের বাইরে খালি স্থানে অবস্থান করতে পারে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
একটি পেন্সিল, একটি শটপাট (নিরেট গোলক) এবং একটি ছক্কা (নিরেট ঘনক)—এই সবগুলোই নিরেট বস্তু, তাই এদের ভরকেন্দ্র বস্তুর ভেতরেই থাকে। অন্যদিকে, একটি চুড়ি হলো একটি সরু বৃত্তাকার বলয়; প্রতিসাম্যের কারণে এর ভরকেন্দ্র এর জ্যামিতিক কেন্দ্রে অবস্থান করে, যেখানে কোনো উপাদান নেই।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, একটি চুড়ির ভরকেন্দ্র বস্তুর বাইরে অবস্থান করে।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_2 - Likely position of centre of mass of sphere

questiontext.text:
7.2 Which of the following points is the likely position of the centre of mass of the system shown in Fig. 7.1?

৭.২ চিত্র ৭.১-এ প্রদর্শিত সংস্থাটির ভরকেন্দ্রের সম্ভাব্য অবস্থান নিচের কোন বিন্দুতে হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A hollow sphere has its upper half filled with air and its lower half filled with sand. Four points A, B, C, and D lie along the vertical diameter: A is in the upper air-filled half, B is at the geometric centre (interface between air and sand), C is in the lower sand-filled half just below the centre, and D is near the bottom of the sphere.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The hollow spherical shell itself is uniform, so its centre of mass lies at the geometric centre B. Both air and sand are uniformly distributed in their respective hemispheres. Since sand is much denser than air, the mass of sand in the lower hemisphere is vastly greater than the mass of air in the upper hemisphere.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The centre of mass of a two-part system lies along the line joining their individual centres of mass and is closer to the heavier mass: \(y_{\text{CM}} = \frac{m_{\text{shell}} y_{\text{shell}} + m_{\text{air}} y_{\text{air}} + m_{\text{sand}} y_{\text{sand}}}{m_{\text{shell}} + m_{\text{air}} + m_{\text{sand}}}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For a uniform solid hemisphere of radius \(R\), the centre of mass lies at a distance \(\frac{3R}{8}\) from the flat base. Neglecting the small mass of air compared to sand, the centre of mass of the sand hemisphere lies at \(\frac{3R}{8}\) below the centre B (well inside the lower half, not at the very bottom D). Combining this with the mass of the hollow shell (whose CM is at B) pulls the overall centre of mass slightly closer to B, placing it in the lower half near C.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Because the lower half is much heavier than the upper half, the centre of mass must lie below B, yet above the bottom edge D. Hence, the likely position of the centre of mass is point C.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি ফাঁপা গোলকের উপরের অর্ধাংশ বাতাস দ্বারা এবং নিচের অর্ধাংশ বালি দ্বারা পূর্ণ। উল্লম্ব ব্যাস বরাবর চারটি বিন্দু A, B, C ও D অবস্থিত: A উপরের বাতাসপূর্ণ অর্ধাংশে, B জ্যামিতিক কেন্দ্রে (বাতাস ও বালির বিভেদতলে), C নিচের বালিপূর্ণ অর্ধাংশে কেন্দ্রের ঠিক নিচে এবং D গোলকের তলদেশের কাছাকাছি অবস্থিত।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ফাঁপা গোলকটির খোলস সুষম, তাই খোলসের ভরকেন্দ্র জ্যামিতিক কেন্দ্র B-তে অবস্থিত। বাতাস ও বালি নিজ নিজ অর্ধগোলকে সুষমভাবে বণ্টিত। যেহেতু বালির ঘনত্ব বাতাসের তুলনায় অনেক বেশি, তাই নিচের অর্ধগোলকের বালির ভর উপরের অর্ধগোলকের বাতাসের ভরের চেয়ে অনেক বেশি।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
একাধিক অংশের সমন্বয়ে গঠিত সংস্থার ভরকেন্দ্র পৃথক ভরকেন্দ্রগুলোর সংযোজক সরলরেখা বরাবর ভারী অংশের দিকে সরে যায়: \(y_{\text{CM}} = \frac{m_{\text{shell}} y_{\text{shell}} + m_{\text{air}} y_{\text{air}} + m_{\text{sand}} y_{\text{sand}}}{m_{\text{shell}} + m_{\text{air}} + m_{\text{sand}}}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
\(R\) ব্যাসার্ধের একটি সুষম নিরেট অর্ধগোলকের ভরকেন্দ্র তার সমতল ভূমি থেকে \(\frac{3R}{8}\) দূরত্বে থাকে। বালির তুলনায় বাতাসের ভর নগণ্য ধরলে, বালির অর্ধগোলকের ভরকেন্দ্র B বিন্দু থেকে \(\frac{3R}{8}\) নিচে অবস্থান করে (একদম তলদেশ D-তে নয়)। এর সাথে খোলসের ভর (যার ভরকেন্দ্র B-তে) যুক্ত হলে সম্মিলিত ভরকেন্দ্র B-এর কিছুটা কাছাকাছি নিচের অর্ধাংশে, অর্থাৎ C বিন্দুতে অবস্থান করে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
নিচের অর্ধাংশ অনেক বেশি ভারী হওয়ায় ভরকেন্দ্র অবশ্যই B-এর নিচে কিন্তু D-এর উপরে থাকবে। সুতরাং, সংস্থাটির ভরকেন্দ্রের সম্ভাব্য অবস্থান হলো C বিন্দু।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_3 - Change in angular momentum upon elastic bounce

questiontext.text:
7.3 A particle of mass \(m\) is moving in \(yz\)-plane with a uniform velocity \(v\) with its trajectory running parallel to \(+\text{ve}\) \(y\)-axis and intersecting \(z\)-axis at \(z = a\) (Fig. 7.2). The change in its angular momentum about the origin as it bounces elastically from a wall at \(y = \text{constant}\) is:

৭.৩ \(m\) ভরের একটি কণা \(yz\)-তলে \(v\) সুষম বেগে গতিশীল, যার গতিপথ ধনাত্মক \(y\)-অক্ষের সমান্তরাল এবং \(z\)-অক্ষকে \(z = a\) বিন্দুতে ছেদ করে (চিত্র ৭.২)। \(y = \text{ধ্রুবক}\) অবস্থানে থাকা একটি দেয়াল থেকে স্থিতিস্থাপকভাবে প্রতিফলিত হলে মূলবিন্দুর সাপেক্ষে কণাটির কৌণিক ভরবেগের পরিবর্তন কত হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the particle = \(m\). Initial velocity \(\mathbf{v}_i = v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\) in the \(yz\)-plane along the line \(z = a\). The particle bounces elastically off a wall at \(y = \text{constant}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\) form a right-handed Cartesian coordinate system, so \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y = \mathbf{0}\) and \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y = -\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\). Since the collision with the wall at \(y = \text{constant}\) is elastic and normal to the wall (along the \(y\)-direction), the velocity reverses direction after bouncing: \(\mathbf{v}_f = -v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\). At the wall, the position vector of the particle is \(\mathbf{r} = y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Angular momentum about the origin is \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\). The change in angular momentum is \(\Delta \mathbf{L} = \mathbf{L}_f - \mathbf{L}_i\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Initial angular momentum before the bounce: \[\mathbf{L}_i = (y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (mv\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\] Final angular momentum after the elastic bounce: \[\mathbf{L}_f = (y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (-mv\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = +mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\] Therefore, the change in angular momentum is: \[\Delta \mathbf{L} = \mathbf{L}_f - \mathbf{L}_i = mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x - (-mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x) = 2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The dimensions of \(mva\) are \([\text{M L}^2 \text{T}^{-1}]\), matching angular momentum, and \(\Delta \mathbf{L}\) is independent of \(y\) as required for motion parallel to the \(y\)-axis. Thus, the change in angular momentum is \(2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
কণাটির ভর = \(m\)। \(yz\)-তলে \(z = a\) রেখা বরাবর প্রাথমিক বেগ \(\mathbf{v}_i = v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\)। কণাটি \(y = \text{ধ্রুবক}\) অবস্থানে থাকা একটি দেয়ালে স্থিতিস্থাপক সংঘর্ষের পর ফিরে আসে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ধরি \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y, \hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\) একটি ডান-হাতি কার্তেসীয় স্থানাঙ্ক ব্যবস্থা গঠন করে, যেখানে \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y = \mathbf{0}\) এবং \(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y = -\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\)। দেয়ালটির সাথে সংঘর্ষ স্থিতিস্থাপক ও লম্বভাবে হওয়ায় প্রতিফলনের পর বেগের দিক বিপরীত হয়: \(\mathbf{v}_f = -v\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y\)। দেয়ালের কাছে কণাটির অবস্থান ভেক্টর \(\mathbf{r} = y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
মূলবিন্দুর সাপেক্ষে কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{r} \times \mathbf{p} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\)। কৌণিক ভরবেগের পরিবর্তন \(\Delta \mathbf{L} = \mathbf{L}_f - \mathbf{L}_i\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
সংঘর্ষের পূর্বে প্রাথমিক কৌণিক ভরবেগ: \[\mathbf{L}_i = (y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (mv\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\] স্থিতিস্থাপক প্রতিফলনের পর চূড়ান্ত কৌণিক ভরবেগ: \[\mathbf{L}_f = (y\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y + a\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z) \times (-mv\hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = -mva(\hat{\mathbf{e}}_z \times \hat{\mathbf{e}}_y) = +mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\] অতএব, কৌণিক ভরবেগের পরিবর্তন: \[\Delta \mathbf{L} = \mathbf{L}_f - \mathbf{L}_i = mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x - (-mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x) = 2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(mva\)-এর মাত্রা \([\text{M L}^2 \text{T}^{-1}]\), যা কৌণিক ভরবেগের মাত্রার সাথে মেলে এবং এটি \(y\)-এর ওপর নির্ভরশীল নয়। সুতরাং, কৌণিক ভরবেগের পরিবর্তন হলো \(2mva\hat{\mathbf{e}}_x\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_4 - Disc rotating with uniform angular velocity

questiontext.text:
7.4 When a disc rotates with uniform angular velocity, which of the following is not true?

৭.৪ যখন একটি চাকতি সুষম কৌণিক বেগে ঘূর্ণায়মান থাকে, তখন নিচের কোনটি সত্য নয়?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Uniform angular velocity means that the angular velocity vector \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) is constant in both magnitude and direction over time (\(\boldsymbol{\omega} = \text{constant} \neq \mathbf{0}\) for a rotating disc).

Step 2: Evaluation
Since \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) is constant in direction, both the orientation of the axis of rotation and the sense of rotation remain unchanged. Since \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) is constant in magnitude, the speed of rotation is non-zero and remains constant. Angular acceleration is defined as the time rate of change of angular velocity: \(\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \frac{d\boldsymbol{\omega}}{dt} = \mathbf{0}\). Therefore, the statement that the angular acceleration is non-zero and remains the same is false.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Hence, the statement that is not true is that the angular acceleration is non-zero and remains the same.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
সুষম কৌণিক বেগের অর্থ হলো সময়ের সাথে কৌণিক বেগ ভেক্টর \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\)-এর মান এবং দিক উভয়ই অপরিবর্তিত থাকে (ঘূর্ণায়মান চাকতির ক্ষেত্রে \(\boldsymbol{\omega} = \text{ধ্রুবক} \neq \mathbf{0}\))।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
যেহেতু \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\)-এর দিক ধ্রুবক, তাই ঘূর্ণন অক্ষের অভিমুখ এবং ঘূর্ণনের দিক একই থাকে। যেহেতু \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\)-এর মান ধ্রুবক, তাই ঘূর্ণন দ্রুতি অশূন্য ও অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। কৌণিক ত্বরণ হলো সময়ের সাপেক্ষে কৌণিক বেগের পরিবর্তনের হার: \(\boldsymbol{\alpha} = \frac{d\boldsymbol{\omega}}{dt} = \mathbf{0}\)। সুতরাং, কৌণিক ত্বরণ অশূন্য এবং একই থাকে—এই উক্তিটি মিথ্যা।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, কৌণিক ত্বরণ অশূন্য ও অপরিবর্তিত থাকে—এই উক্তিটি সত্য নয়।

answer.text: The orientation of the axis of rotation remains same.
The speed of rotation is non-zero and remains same.
The angular acceleration is non-zero and remains same.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_5 - Moment of inertia after moving piece to centre

questiontext.text:
7.5 A uniform square plate has a small piece \(Q\) of an irregular shape removed and glued to the centre of the plate leaving a hole behind (Fig. 7.3). The moment of inertia about the \(z\)-axis is then

৭.৫ একটি সুষম বর্গাকার পাত থেকে অনিয়মিত আকৃতির একটি ছোট টুকরো \(Q\) কেটে নিয়ে পাতের কেন্দ্রে আঠা দিয়ে লাগানো হলো এবং সেখানে একটি ছিদ্র তৈরি হলো (চিত্র ৭.৩)। তাহলে \(z\)-অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে জড়তার ভ্রামক

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A small piece \(Q\) of mass \(m_Q\) is removed from a point away from the centre of a uniform square plate and is glued at the centre of the plate (on the \(z\)-axis).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The \(z\)-axis passes through the centre of the square plate perpendicular to its plane. Originally, the piece \(Q\) was at some non-zero perpendicular distance \(r > 0\) from the \(z\)-axis. After gluing it at the centre, its perpendicular distance from the \(z\)-axis becomes \(r' \approx 0\) (or strictly less than \(r\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The moment of inertia of a system of particles about an axis is \(I = \sum m_i r_i^2\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Let \(I_{\text{initial}}\) be the moment of inertia of the original plate about the \(z\)-axis. When piece \(Q\) is removed from distance \(r\) and placed at the centre (\(r' = 0\)), the change in moment of inertia is: \[\Delta I = I_{\text{final}} - I_{\text{initial}} = m_Q (0)^2 - m_Q r^2 = -m_Q r^2 < 0\] Since mass has been brought closer to the axis of rotation, the moment of inertia decreases.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Moment of inertia increases when mass is distributed farther from the axis and decreases when mass is moved closer to the axis. Therefore, the moment of inertia about the \(z\)-axis is decreased.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি সুষম বর্গাকার পাতের কেন্দ্র থেকে দূরে অবস্থিত একটি ছোট \(Q\) অংশ (ভর \(m_Q\)) কেটে নিয়ে পাতের কেন্দ্রে (\(z\)-অক্ষের ওপর) লাগানো হয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
\(z\)-অক্ষটি পাতের কেন্দ্র দিয়ে তলের সাথে লম্বভাবে যায়। পূর্বে \(Q\) অংশটি \(z\)-অক্ষ থেকে অশূন্য লম্ব দূরত্ব \(r > 0\)-এ ছিল। কেন্দ্রে লাগানোর পর \(z\)-অক্ষ থেকে এর লম্ব দূরত্ব \(r' \approx 0\) (বা \(r\)-এর চেয়ে অনেক কম) হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
কোনো অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে জড়তার ভ্রামক হলো \(I = \sum m_i r_i^2\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
মূল পাতের \(z\)-অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে জড়তার ভ্রামক \(I_{\text{initial}}\) হলে, \(r\) দূরত্ব থেকে \(Q\) অংশটিকে কেন্দ্রে (\(r' = 0\)) আনলে জড়তার ভ্রামকের পরিবর্তন হয়: \[\Delta I = I_{\text{final}} - I_{\text{initial}} = m_Q (0)^2 - m_Q r^2 = -m_Q r^2 < 0\] যেহেতু ভর ঘূর্ণন অক্ষের কাছাকাছি সরে এসেছে, তাই জড়তার ভ্রামক হ্রাস পায়।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অক্ষ থেকে ভর দূরে সরালে জড়তার ভ্রামক বাড়ে এবং কাছে আনলে কমে। অতএব, \(z\)-অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে জড়তার ভ্রামক হ্রাস পেয়েছে।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_6 - Quadrant of new centre of mass

questiontext.text:
7.6 In problem 7.5, the CM of the plate is now in the following quadrant of \(x\)-\(y\) plane,

৭.৬ ৭.৫ নং সমস্যায়, পাতটির নতুন ভরকেন্দ্র এখন \(x\)-\(y\) তলের কোন পাদে (quadrant) অবস্থান করবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
In the uniform square plate of problem 7.5 (Fig. 7.3), the origin \((0,0)\) is at the centre of the plate. The small piece \(Q\) is removed from the first quadrant \((x > 0, y > 0)\) and glued at the origin \((0,0)\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(M\) be the total mass of the original uniform plate (whose CM is at \((0,0)\)), and let \(m\) be the mass of piece \(Q\) initially centred at \((x_0, y_0)\) with \(x_0 > 0, y_0 > 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Using the principle of superposition for centre of mass, removing mass \(m\) from \((x_0, y_0)\) and placing it at \((0,0)\) gives: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{M(0) - m x_0 + m(0)}{M} = -\frac{m}{M} x_0, \quad y_{\text{CM}} = \frac{M(0) - m y_0 + m(0)}{M} = -\frac{m}{M} y_0\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(x_0 > 0\) and \(y_0 > 0\), and \(m, M > 0\), we obtain: \[x_{\text{CM}} < 0 \quad \text{and} \quad y_{\text{CM}} < 0\] Points with both negative \(x\) and negative \(y\) coordinates lie in the third quadrant (III).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Removing mass from the first quadrant shifts the centre of mass in the opposite direction, into the third quadrant. Therefore, the CM of the plate is now in quadrant III.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
৭.৫ নং সমস্যার সুষম বর্গাকার পাতে (চিত্র ৭.৩) মূলবিন্দু \((0,0)\) পাতের কেন্দ্রে অবস্থিত। \(Q\) টুকরোটি প্রথম পাদ \((x > 0, y > 0)\) থেকে কেটে মূলবিন্দু \((0,0)\)-তে লাগানো হয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
ধরি মূল পাতের মোট ভর \(M\) (যার ভরকেন্দ্র \((0,0)\)-তে) এবং \(Q\) অংশের ভর \(m\), যা পূর্বে \((x_0, y_0)\) বিন্দুতে ছিল যেখানে \(x_0 > 0, y_0 > 0\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ভরকেন্দ্রের উপরিপাতন নীতি অনুযায়ী \((x_0, y_0)\) থেকে \(m\) ভর সরিয়ে \((0,0)\)-তে স্থাপন করলে নতুন ভরকেন্দ্র: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{M(0) - m x_0 + m(0)}{M} = -\frac{m}{M} x_0, \quad y_{\text{CM}} = \frac{M(0) - m y_0 + m(0)}{M} = -\frac{m}{M} y_0\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু \(x_0 > 0, y_0 > 0\) এবং \(m, M > 0\), তাই: \[x_{\text{CM}} < 0 \quad \text{এবং} \quad y_{\text{CM}} < 0\] যে বিন্দুর \(x\) ও \(y\) উভয় স্থানাঙ্ক ঋণাত্মক, সেটি তৃতীয় পাদে (III) অবস্থান করে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
প্রথম পাদ থেকে ভর অপসারণ করলে ভরকেন্দ্র বিপরীত দিকে অর্থাৎ তৃতীয় পাদে সরে যায়। অতএব, পাতের নতুন ভরকেন্দ্র তৃতীয় (III) পাদে অবস্থান করবে।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_7 - Centre of mass of non-uniform rod

questiontext.text:
7.7 The density of a non-uniform rod of length \(1\text{ m}\) is given by \(\rho(x) = a(1+bx^2)\) where \(a\) and \(b\) are constants and \(0 \leq x \leq 1\). The centre of mass of the rod will be at

৭.৭ \(1\text{ m}\) দৈর্ঘ্যের একটি অসম দণ্ডের রৈখিক ভর ঘনত্ব \(\rho(x) = a(1+bx^2)\), যেখানে \(a\) ও \(b\) ধ্রুবক এবং \(0 \leq x \leq 1\)। দণ্ডটির ভরকেন্দ্র কোথায় অবস্থিত হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Length of the rod \(L = 1\text{ m}\), extending from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 1\). Linear mass density is \(\rho(x) = a(1 + bx^2)\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The rod lies along the \(x\)-axis from \(x = 0\) to \(x = 1\) with \(a > 0\) and \(1 + bx^2 > 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The centre of mass of a continuous one-dimensional mass distribution is given by: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{\int_0^L x \rho(x)\, dx}{\int_0^L \rho(x)\, dx}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
First, compute the numerator: \[\int_0^1 x \cdot a(1 + bx^2)\, dx = a \int_0^1 (x + bx^3)\, dx = a \left[\frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{bx^4}{4}\right]_0^1 = a \left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{b}{4}\right) = \frac{a(2 + b)}{4}\] Next, compute the denominator (total mass): \[\int_0^1 a(1 + bx^2)\, dx = a \left[x + \frac{bx^3}{3}\right]_0^1 = a \left(1 + \frac{b}{3}\right) = \frac{a(3 + b)}{3}\] Dividing the numerator by the denominator: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{\frac{a(2 + b)}{4}}{\frac{a(3 + b)}{3}} = \frac{3(2 + b)}{4(3 + b)}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
As a limiting check, when \(b = 0\) (uniform rod), \(x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{3(2)}{4(3)} = \frac{1}{2} = 0.5\text{ m}\), which is the exact midpoint. Thus, the centre of mass is at \(\frac{3(2 + b)}{4(3 + b)}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
দণ্ডটির দৈর্ঘ্য \(L = 1\text{ m}\), যা \(x = 0\) থেকে \(x = 1\) পর্যন্ত বিস্তৃত। রৈখিক ভর ঘনত্ব \(\rho(x) = a(1 + bx^2)\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
দণ্ডটি \(x\)-অক্ষ বরাবর \(x = 0\) থেকে \(x = 1\) পর্যন্ত অবস্থিত এবং \(a > 0\) ও \(1 + bx^2 > 0\)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
অবিচ্ছিন্ন একমাত্রিক ভর বণ্টনের ভরকেন্দ্রের অবস্থান: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{\int_0^L x \rho(x)\, dx}{\int_0^L \rho(x)\, dx}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
প্রথমে লব নির্ণয় করি: \[\int_0^1 x \cdot a(1 + bx^2)\, dx = a \int_0^1 (x + bx^3)\, dx = a \left[\frac{x^2}{2} + \frac{bx^4}{4}\right]_0^1 = a \left(\frac{1}{2} + \frac{b}{4}\right) = \frac{a(2 + b)}{4}\] এরপর হর (মোট ভর) নির্ণয় করি: \[\int_0^1 a(1 + bx^2)\, dx = a \left[x + \frac{bx^3}{3}\right]_0^1 = a \left(1 + \frac{b}{3}\right) = \frac{a(3 + b)}{3}\] লবকে হর দিয়ে ভাগ করলে পাই: \[x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{\frac{a(2 + b)}{4}}{\frac{a(3 + b)}{3}} = \frac{3(2 + b)}{4(3 + b)}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
সীমান্ত যাচাই হিসেবে \(b = 0\) (সুষম দণ্ড) বসালে \(x_{\text{CM}} = \frac{3(2)}{4(3)} = \frac{1}{2} = 0.5\text{ m}\) পাওয়া যায়, যা দণ্ডের ঠিক মধ্যবিন্দু। অতএব, ভরকেন্দ্রের অবস্থান হলো \(\frac{3(2 + b)}{4(3 + b)}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_CH07_MCQ_Q7_8 - Angular speed of merry-go-round after person jumps

questiontext.text:
7.8 A Merry-go-round, made of a ring-like platform of radius \(R\) and mass \(M\), is revolving with angular speed \(\omega\). A person of mass \(M\) is standing on it. At one instant, the person jumps off the round, radially away from the centre of the round (as seen from the round). The speed of the round afterwards is

৭.৮ \(R\) ব্যাসার্ধ ও \(M\) ভরের একটি বলয়াকৃতি মেরি-গো-রাউন্ড \(\omega\) কৌণিক দ্রুতিতে ঘুরছে। \(M\) ভরের একজন ব্যক্তি এর ওপর দাঁড়িয়ে আছে। এক মুহূর্তে ব্যক্তিটি (রাউন্ডের সাপেক্ষে) কেন্দ্র থেকে ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর বাইরের দিকে লাফ দিয়ে নেমে যায়। এরপর রাউন্ডটির কৌণিক দ্রুতি কত হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the ring-like platform = \(M\), radius = \(R\), initial angular speed = \(\omega\). Mass of the person = \(M\), standing at radius \(R\). The person jumps off radially away from the centre as seen from the rotating round.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
No external torque acts on the (platform + person) system about the vertical axis of rotation. Because the person jumps radially as seen from the round, the impulse exerted by the person on the round is purely radial and passes through the axis of rotation.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Conservation of angular momentum about the axis of rotation: \(L_i = L_f\). Moment of inertia of a ring of mass \(M\) and radius \(R\) is \(I_{\text{ring}} = MR^2\), and of the person at the rim is \(I_{\text{person}} = MR^2\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Before jumping, the total angular momentum is: \[L_i = (I_{\text{ring}} + I_{\text{person}})\omega = (MR^2 + MR^2)\omega = 2MR^2\omega\] When the person jumps radially outward relative to the round, the person retains the same tangential velocity \(v_t = \omega R\) as the rim at the instant of leaving. Thus, the person carries away angular momentum \(L_{\text{person}} = m v_t R = M(\omega R)R = MR^2\omega\). Let \(\omega'\) be the final angular speed of the round. By conservation of angular momentum: \[L_i = L_{\text{ring, f}} + L_{\text{person}} \implies 2MR^2\omega = MR^2\omega' + MR^2\omega \implies \omega' = \omega\] Equivalently, since the jump exerts zero tangential force, no torque acts on the round, so its angular speed remains unchanged.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Zero torque on the round implies \(\Delta \omega = 0\). Therefore, the speed of the round afterwards is \(\omega\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
বলয়াকৃতি প্ল্যাটফর্মের ভর = \(M\), ব্যাসার্ধ = \(R\), প্রাথমিক কৌণিক দ্রুতি = \(\omega\)। ব্যক্তির ভর = \(M\), যিনি \(R\) ব্যাসার্ধে দাঁড়িয়ে আছেন। ব্যক্তিটি ঘূর্ণায়মান রাউন্ডের সাপেক্ষে কেন্দ্র থেকে ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর বাইরে লাফ দেন।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
উল্লম্ব ঘূর্ণন অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে (প্ল্যাটফর্ম + ব্যক্তি) সংস্থার ওপর কোনো বাহ্যিক টর্ক কাজ করে না। যেহেতু ব্যক্তিটি রাউন্ডের সাপেক্ষে ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর লাফ দেন, তাই রাউন্ডের ওপর প্রযুক্ত ঘাত সম্পূর্ণ ব্যাসার্ধীয় এবং ঘূর্ণন অক্ষ দিয়ে যায়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ঘূর্ণন অক্ষের সাপেক্ষে কৌণিক ভরবেগের সংরক্ষণ সূত্র: \(L_i = L_f\)। \(M\) ভর ও \(R\) ব্যাসার্ধের বলয়ের জড়তার ভ্রামক \(I_{\text{ring}} = MR^2\) এবং কিনারায় থাকা ব্যক্তির জড়তার ভ্রামক \(I_{\text{person}} = MR^2\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
লাফ দেওয়ার আগে মোট কৌণিক ভরবেগ: \[L_i = (I_{\text{ring}} + I_{\text{person}})\omega = (MR^2 + MR^2)\omega = 2MR^2\omega\] রাউন্ডের সাপেক্ষে ব্যাসার্ধ বরাবর বাইরে লাফ দেওয়ার মুহূর্তে ব্যক্তির স্পর্শকীয় বেগ কিনারার বেগের সমান, অর্থাৎ \(v_t = \omega R\) থাকে। ফলে ব্যক্তিটি \(L_{\text{person}} = M v_t R = MR^2\omega\) কৌণিক ভরবেগ নিয়ে বিচ্ছিন্ন হয়। ধরি রাউন্ডের পরবর্তী কৌণিক দ্রুতি \(\omega'\)। কৌণিক ভরবেগের সংরক্ষণ সূত্র অনুযায়ী: \[2MR^2\omega = MR^2\omega' + MR^2\omega \implies \omega' = \omega\] একইভাবে, কোনো স্পর্শকীয় বল না থাকায় রাউন্ডের ওপর প্রযুক্ত টর্ক শূন্য, তাই এর কৌণিক দ্রুতি অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
রাউন্ডের ওপর টর্ক শূন্য হওয়ায় \(\Delta \omega = 0\)। অতএব, এরপর রাউন্ডটির কৌণিক দ্রুতি হবে \(\omega\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_CH07_MCQ_Q7_9 - Relationship between angular momentum, momentum, and velocity

questiontext.text:
7.9 Choose the correct alternatives:

৭.৯ সঠিক বিকল্পগুলি নির্বাচন করো:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
In rotational motion, angular momentum is related to angular velocity by the inertia tensor, \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{I}\boldsymbol{\omega}\). In translational motion, linear momentum is \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\), while acceleration is \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt}\).

Step 2: Evaluation
1. For a general rotational motion, \(\mathbf{L}\) and \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel; they are parallel only when the axis of rotation is a principal axis of inertia (such as a symmetry axis). Even for rotation about a fixed axis, if the axis is not a principal axis of the body, \(\mathbf{L}\) and \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) are not parallel.
2. For a general translational motion, \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\) where mass \(m\) is a positive scalar, so \(\mathbf{p}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.
3. For a general translational motion, \(\mathbf{a}\) and \(\mathbf{v}\) need not be parallel (for example, in projectile motion or uniform circular motion, \(\mathbf{a}\) is at an angle to \(\mathbf{v}\)).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the correct statements are that for a general rotational motion, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel, and for a general translational motion, momentum \(\mathbf{p}\) and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.

ধাপ ১: মূল ধারণা
ঘূর্ণন গতিতে কৌণিক ভরবেগ ও কৌণিক বেগ জড়তার টেনসর দ্বারা সম্পর্কিত, \(\mathbf{L} = \mathbf{I}\boldsymbol{\omega}\)। চলন গতিতে রৈখিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\) এবং ত্বরণ \(\mathbf{a} = \frac{d\mathbf{v}}{dt}\)।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
১. সাধারণ ঘূর্ণন গতির ক্ষেত্রে \(\mathbf{L}\) এবং \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) সমান্তরাল হওয়া আবশ্যক নয়; ঘূর্ণন অক্ষটি কেবল জড়তার মুখ্য অক্ষ (যেমন প্রতিসাম্য অক্ষ) হলেই এরা সমান্তরাল হয়। এমনকি নির্দিষ্ট অক্ষের চারপাশে ঘূর্ণনের ক্ষেত্রেও অক্ষটি মুখ্য অক্ষ না হলে \(\mathbf{L}\) ও \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) সমান্তরাল হয় না।
২. সাধারণ চলন গতির ক্ষেত্রে \(\mathbf{p} = m\mathbf{v}\), যেখানে ভর \(m\) একটি ধনাত্মক স্কেলার রাশি, তাই \(\mathbf{p}\) ও \(\mathbf{v}\) সর্বদা সমান্তরাল।
৩. সাধারণ চলন গতির ক্ষেত্রে \(\mathbf{a}\) ও \(\mathbf{v}\) সর্বদা সমান্তরাল হয় না (যেমন প্রাস গতি বা সুষম বৃত্তাকার গতিতে \(\mathbf{a}\) ও \(\mathbf{v}\)-এর মধ্যবর্তী কোণ অশূন্য হয়)।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
অতএব, সঠিক উক্তিগুলি হলো: সাধারণ ঘূর্ণন গতির ক্ষেত্রে কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{L}\) ও কৌণিক বেগ \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) সমান্তরাল নাও হতে পারে, এবং সাধারণ চলন গতির ক্ষেত্রে ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{p}\) ও বেগ \(\mathbf{v}\) সর্বদা সমান্তরাল হয়।

answer.text: For a general rotational motion, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) need not be parallel.
For a rotational motion about a fixed axis, angular momentum \(\mathbf{L}\) and angular velocity \(\boldsymbol{\omega}\) are always parallel.
For a general translational motion, momentum \(\mathbf{p}\) and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.
For a general translational motion, acceleration \(\mathbf{a}\) and velocity \(\mathbf{v}\) are always parallel.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_CH07_MCQ_Q7_10 - Angular momentum of two particles on parallel lines

questiontext.text:
7.10 Figure 7.4 shows two identical particles 1 and 2, each of mass \(m\), moving in opposite directions with same speed \(v\) along parallel lines. At a particular instant, \(\mathbf{r}_1\) and \(\mathbf{r}_2\) are their respective position vectors drawn from point A which is in the plane of the parallel lines. Choose the correct options:

(\(\odot\) represents a unit vector coming out of the page. \(\otimes\) represents a unit vector going into the page.)

৭.১০ চিত্র ৭.৪-এ \(m\) ভরের দুটি অভিন্ন কণা ১ ও ২ সমান্তরাল রেখা বরাবর একই দ্রুতি \(v\)-তে বিপরীত দিকে গতিশীল। একটি নির্দিষ্ট মুহূর্তে সমান্তরাল রেখাগুলির তলে অবস্থিত A বিন্দু থেকে কণা দুটির অবস্থান ভেক্টর যথাক্রমে \(\mathbf{r}_1\) এবং \(\mathbf{r}_2\)। সঠিক বিকল্পগুলি নির্বাচন করো:

(\(\odot\) পৃষ্ঠা থেকে বাইরের দিকে আসা একক ভেক্টর এবং \(\otimes\) পৃষ্ঠার ভেতরের দিকে যাওয়া একক ভেক্টর নির্দেশ করে।)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two identical particles 1 and 2, each of mass \(m\), move with speed \(v\) in opposite directions along two parallel lines. Point A lies in the plane of the lines at perpendicular distances \(d_1\) from the line of particle 1 and \(d_2\) from the line of particle 2 (with \(d_2 > d_1\)).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
From the diagram, particle 1 moves to the right (\(\mathbf{v}_1 = +v\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)) and particle 2 moves to the left (\(\mathbf{v}_2 = -v\hat{\mathbf{i}}\)), while point A is above both lines. Let \(\odot\) denote the unit vector coming out of the page and \(\otimes\) denote the unit vector going into the page.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Angular momentum of a particle about point A is \(\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\), whose magnitude is \(mvd\), where \(d\) is the perpendicular distance from A to the line of motion. Total angular momentum is \(\mathbf{l}_{\text{total}} = \mathbf{l}_1 + \mathbf{l}_2\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For particle 1: \(\mathbf{r}_1\) points downward and to the right from A, and \(\mathbf{v}_1\) points to the right. By the right-hand rule, \(\mathbf{r}_1 \times \mathbf{v}_1\) points into the page (\(\otimes\)), with magnitude \(mvd_1\). Thus: \[\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \otimes\] For particle 2: \(\mathbf{r}_2\) points downward and to the right from A, and \(\mathbf{v}_2\) points to the left. By the right-hand rule, \(\mathbf{r}_2 \times \mathbf{v}_2\) points out of the page (\(\odot\)), with magnitude \(mvd_2\). Thus: \[\mathbf{l}_2 = mvd_2 \odot\] Since \(d_2 > d_1\) and the two vectors are in opposite directions, the total angular momentum about A is: \[\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{l}_1 + \mathbf{l}_2 = mv(d_2 - d_1) \odot\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The dimensions of \(mvd\) match angular momentum, whereas expressions like \(mvr_2\) do not account for the sine of the angle. Hence, \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \otimes\) and \(\mathbf{l} = mv(d_2 - d_1) \odot\) are correct.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
\(m\) ভরের দুটি অভিন্ন কণা ১ ও ২ সমান্তরাল দুটি সরলরেখা বরাবর \(v\) দ্রুতিতে পরস্পর বিপরীত দিকে গতিশীল। সরলরেখাগুলির তলে অবস্থিত A বিন্দু থেকে ১ নং ও ২ নং কণার গতির রেখার লম্ব দূরত্ব যথাক্রমে \(d_1\) ও \(d_2\) (যেখানে \(d_2 > d_1\))।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
চিত্র অনুযায়ী ১ নং কণা ডানদিকে এবং ২ নং কণা বামদিকে গতিশীল, এবং A বিন্দুটি উভয় রেখার উপরে অবস্থিত। \(\odot\) পৃষ্ঠা থেকে বাইরের দিকে আসা একক ভেক্টর এবং \(\otimes\) পৃষ্ঠার ভেতরের দিকে যাওয়া একক ভেক্টর নির্দেশ করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
A বিন্দুর সাপেক্ষে কোনো কণার কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{r} \times m\mathbf{v}\), যার মান \(mvd\), যেখানে \(d\) হলো A থেকে গতির রেখার লম্ব দূরত্ব। মোট কৌণিক ভরবেগ \(\mathbf{l}_{\text{total}} = \mathbf{l}_1 + \mathbf{l}_2\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১ নং কণার ক্ষেত্রে: A থেকে \(\mathbf{r}_1\) নিচের ডানদিকে এবং \(\mathbf{v}_1\) ডানদিকে। ডান-হাতের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী \(\mathbf{r}_1 \times \mathbf{v}_1\) পৃষ্ঠার ভেতরের দিকে (\(\otimes\)) ক্রিয়া করে এবং এর মান \(mvd_1\)। সুতরাং: \[\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \otimes\] ২ নং কণার ক্ষেত্রে: A থেকে \(\mathbf{r}_2\) নিচের ডানদিকে এবং \(\mathbf{v}_2\) বামদিকে। ডান-হাতের নিয়ম অনুযায়ী \(\mathbf{r}_2 \times \mathbf{v}_2\) পৃষ্ঠা থেকে বাইরের দিকে (\(\odot\)) ক্রিয়া করে এবং এর মান \(mvd_2\)। সুতরাং: \[\mathbf{l}_2 = mvd_2 \odot\] যেহেতু \(d_2 > d_1\) এবং ভেক্টর দুটি বিপরীতমুখী, তাই A-এর সাপেক্ষে মোট কৌণিক ভরবেগ: \[\mathbf{l} = \mathbf{l}_1 + \mathbf{l}_2 = mv(d_2 - d_1) \odot\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(mvd\)-এর মাত্রা কৌণিক ভরবেগের সাথে মিলে যায়। অতএব, \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \otimes\) এবং \(\mathbf{l} = mv(d_2 - d_1) \odot\) সঠিক।

answer.text: Angular momentum \(\mathbf{l}_1\) of particle 1 about A is \(\mathbf{l}_1 = mvd_1 \otimes\)
Angular momentum \(\mathbf{l}_2\) of particle 2 about A is \(\mathbf{l}_2 = mvr_2 \odot\)
Total angular momentum of the system about A is \(\mathbf{l} = mv(r_1 + r_2)\)
Total angular momentum of the system about A is \(\mathbf{l} = mv(d_2 - d_1) \odot\)

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_CH07_MCQ_Q7_11 - Conditions for zero net external torque

questiontext.text:
