name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_GRAVITATION_Q8_7 - Comparison of inertial mass and gravitational mass

questiontext.text:
8.7 Choose the wrong option.

8.7 गलत विकल्प का चयन कीजिए।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Inertial mass measures a body's resistance to acceleration under an external force (\(F = m_i a\)), while gravitational mass determines the gravitational force experienced by it in a gravitational field (\(F_g = m_g g\)).

Step 2: Evaluation of the Properties of Mass
Experiments (such as Eötvös experiments) have established that inertial mass and gravitational mass are equal for all bodies, which directly explains why the acceleration due to gravity \(g = \frac{m_g}{m_i} \frac{GM}{R^2}\) is the same for all falling bodies regardless of their mass or composition. Furthermore, both inertial mass and gravitational mass are intrinsic properties of a particle (like a proton) and do not depend on the presence of neighbouring heavy objects.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the statement claiming that the gravitational mass of a particle like a proton can depend on the presence of neighbouring heavy objects while the inertial mass cannot is incorrect.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
जड़त्वीय द्रव्यमान किसी बाह्य बल के अधीन त्वरित होने के प्रति किसी पिंड के प्रतिरोध की माप है (\(F = m_i a\)), जबकि गुरुत्वीय द्रव्यमान किसी गुरुत्वीय क्षेत्र में उस पर लगने वाले गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल को निर्धारित करता है (\(F_g = m_g g\))।

चरण 2: द्रव्यमान के गुणों का मूल्यांकन
प्रयोगों (जैसे इओट्वोस प्रयोग) से यह सिद्ध हुआ है कि सभी पिंडों के लिए जड़त्वीय द्रव्यमान और गुरुत्वीय द्रव्यमान बराबर होते हैं, जो सीधे तौर पर स्पष्ट करता है कि गुरुत्वीय त्वरण \(g = \frac{m_g}{m_i} \frac{GM}{R^2}\) सभी गिरते हुए पिंडों के लिए उनके द्रव्यमान या संघटन से स्वतंत्र होकर समान रहता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, जड़त्वीय द्रव्यमान और गुरुत्वीय द्रव्यमान दोनों ही किसी कण (जैसे प्रोटॉन) के आंतरिक गुण हैं और पास स्थित भारी वस्तुओं की उपस्थिति पर निर्भर नहीं करते।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
अतः यह कथन गलत है कि प्रोटॉन जैसे कण का गुरुत्वीय द्रव्यमान पास स्थित भारी वस्तुओं की उपस्थिति पर निर्भर कर सकता है जबकि जड़त्वीय द्रव्यमान नहीं।

answer.text: Inertial mass is a measure of difficulty of accelerating a body by an external force whereas the gravitational mass is relevant in determining the gravitational force on it by an external mass.
That the gravitational mass and inertial mass are equal is an experimental result.
That the acceleration due to gravity on earth is the same for all bodies is due to the equality of gravitational mass and inertial mass.
Gravitational mass of a particle like proton can depend on the presence of neighbouring heavy objects but the inertial mass cannot.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_GRAVITATION_Q8_8 - Net gravitational force on particle between 2M and M

questiontext.text:
8.8 Particles of masses \(2M\), \(m\) and \(M\) are respectively at points \(A\), \(B\) and \(C\) with \(AB = \frac{1}{2} (BC)\). \(m\) is much-much smaller than \(M\) and at time \(t = 0\), they are all at rest (Fig. 8.1).
At subsequent times before any collision takes place:

8.8 द्रव्यमान \(2M\), \(m\) तथा \(M\) के तीन कण क्रमशः बिंदुओं \(A\), \(B\) तथा \(C\) पर इस प्रकार स्थित हैं कि \(AB = \frac{1}{2} (BC)\) है। \(m\), \(M\) की तुलना में बहुत ही छोटा है तथा समय \(t = 0\) पर ये सभी विरामावस्था में हैं (चित्र 8.1)।
किसी संघट्ट के होने से पूर्व के पश्चात्वर्ती समयों में:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Three particles of masses \(2M\), \(m\), and \(M\) are located along a straight line at points \(A\), \(B\), and \(C\) respectively. The distance relation is \(AB = \frac{1}{2} BC\). Also, \(m \ll M\), and all particles are initially at rest at \(t = 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(AB = r\), so that \(BC = 2r\). Take the direction from \(B\) towards \(A\) (towards \(2M\)) as positive and towards \(C\) (towards \(M\)) as negative. Since \(m \ll M\), the motion of \(2M\) and \(M\) due to \(m\) is negligible.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Newton's law of universal gravitation, the magnitude of the gravitational force between two point masses \(m_1\) and \(m_2\) separated by distance \(d\) is \(F = \frac{G m_1 m_2}{d^2}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The gravitational force on particle \(m\) at \(B\) due to mass \(2M\) at \(A\) (directed towards \(A\)) is:
\(F_{BA} = \frac{G (2M) m}{r^2} = \frac{2GMm}{r^2}\)
The gravitational force on particle \(m\) at \(B\) due to mass \(M\) at \(C\) (directed towards \(C\)) is:
\(F_{BC} = \frac{G M m}{(2r)^2} = \frac{GMm}{4r^2}\)
Comparing the two magnitudes:
\(F_{BA} - F_{BC} = \frac{2GMm}{r^2} - \frac{GMm}{4r^2} = \frac{7GMm}{4r^2} > 0\)
Since \(F_{BA} > F_{BC}\), the net force on \(m\) is directed towards \(A\) (mass \(2M\)). Moreover, as \(m\) moves towards \(2M\), \(r\) decreases and \(BC\) increases, so the net force towards \(2M\) increases even further.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both forces have dimensions of \(\frac{GMm}{r^2}\) and the ratio \(F_{BA}/F_{BC} = 8\). Since \(m\) starts from rest under a net force towards \(2M\), \(m\) will move towards \(2M\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
द्रव्यमान \(2M\), \(m\) और \(M\) के तीन कण एक सीधी रेखा में क्रमशः बिंदुओं \(A\), \(B\) और \(C\) पर स्थित हैं। दूरी का संबंध \(AB = \frac{1}{2} BC\) है। साथ ही, \(m \ll M\) और समय \(t = 0\) पर सभी कण विरामावस्था में हैं।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
मान लीजिए \(AB = r\), तो \(BC = 2r\) होगा। \(B\) से \(A\) (\(2M\)) की ओर की दिशा को धनात्मक और \(C\) (\(M\)) की ओर की दिशा को ऋणात्मक मानें। चूँकि \(m \ll M\), इसलिए \(m\) के कारण \(2M\) और \(M\) की गति नगण्य है।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
न्यूटन के सार्वत्रिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियम के अनुसार, \(d\) दूरी पर स्थित दो बिंदु द्रव्यमानों \(m_1\) और \(m_2\) के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल का परिमाण \(F = \frac{G m_1 m_2}{d^2}\) होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
\(A\) पर स्थित द्रव्यमान \(2M\) के कारण \(B\) पर स्थित कण \(m\) पर लगने वाला गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल (\(A\) की ओर):
\(F_{BA} = \frac{G (2M) m}{r^2} = \frac{2GMm}{r^2}\)
\(C\) पर स्थित द्रव्यमान \(M\) के कारण \(B\) पर स्थित कण \(m\) पर लगने वाला गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल (\(C\) की ओर):
\(F_{BC} = \frac{G M m}{(2r)^2} = \frac{GMm}{4r^2}\)
दोनों परिमाणों की तुलना करने पर:
\(F_{BA} - F_{BC} = \frac{2GMm}{r^2} - \frac{GMm}{4r^2} = \frac{7GMm}{4r^2} > 0\)
चूँकि \(F_{BA} > F_{BC}\), अतः \(m\) पर नेट बल \(A\) (द्रव्यमान \(2M\)) की ओर निर्दिष्ट है। इसके अतिरिक्त, जैसे-जैसे \(m\) द्रव्यमान \(2M\) की ओर गति करता है, \(r\) घटता है और \(BC\) बढ़ता है, जिससे \(2M\) की ओर नेट बल और अधिक बढ़ जाता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
दोनों बलों की विमाएँ \(\frac{GMm}{r^2}\) हैं और अनुपात \(F_{BA}/F_{BC} = 8\) है। चूँकि \(m\) विरामावस्था से \(2M\) की ओर लगने वाले नेट बल के अधीन गति प्रारंभ करता है, इसलिए \(m\), \(2M\) की ओर गति करेगा।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_9 - Variation of acceleration due to gravity

questiontext.text:
8.9 Which of the following options are correct?

8.9 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से विकल्प सही हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The acceleration due to gravity \(g\) at the surface of a uniform spherical earth of mass \(M\) and radius \(R\) is \(g = \frac{GM}{R^2}\). Its value changes with altitude \(h\), depth \(d\), and latitude \(\lambda\).

Step 2: Evaluation of Altitude, Depth, Latitude, and Mass Dependence
1. With increasing altitude \(h\), \(g(h) = \frac{GM}{(R+h)^2}\), so \(g\) decreases as \(h\) increases.
2. With increasing depth \(d\) inside a uniform sphere, \(g(d) = g\left(1 - \frac{d}{R}\right)\), so \(g\) decreases (not increases) with increasing depth.
3. Due to the rotation of the earth with angular speed \(\omega\), the effective acceleration due to gravity at latitude \(\lambda\) is \(g(\lambda) = g - R\omega^2 \cos^2\lambda\). As latitude \(\lambda\) increases from \(0^\circ\) at the equator to \(90^\circ\) at the poles, \(\cos\lambda\) decreases from \(1\) to \(0\), so \(g(\lambda)\) increases.
4. From \(g = \frac{GM}{R^2}\), \(g\) is directly proportional to the mass \(M\) of the earth, so it is not independent of the mass of the earth.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Acceleration due to gravity decreases with increasing altitude and increases with increasing latitude.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
द्रव्यमान \(M\) और त्रिज्या \(R\) वाली एकसमान गोलाकार पृथ्वी की सतह पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण \(g = \frac{GM}{R^2}\) होता है। इसका मान ऊँचाई \(h\), गहराई \(d\) और अक्षांश \(\lambda\) के साथ परिवर्तित होता है।

चरण 2: ऊँचाई, गहराई, अक्षांश और द्रव्यमान पर निर्भरता का मूल्यांकन
1. बढ़ती ऊँचाई \(h\) के साथ, \(g(h) = \frac{GM}{(R+h)^2}\) होता है, अतः \(h\) बढ़ने पर \(g\) घटता है।
2. एकसमान गोले के भीतर बढ़ती गहराई \(d\) के साथ, \(g(d) = g\left(1 - \frac{d}{R}\right)\) होता है, अतः गहराई बढ़ने पर \(g\) घटता है (बढ़ता नहीं है)।
3. कोणीय चाल \(\omega\) से पृथ्वी के घूर्णन के कारण अक्षांश \(\lambda\) पर प्रभावी गुरुत्वीय त्वरण \(g(\lambda) = g - R\omega^2 \cos^2\lambda\) होता है। जैसे-जैसे अक्षांश \(\lambda\) भूमध्य रेखा पर \(0^\circ\) से ध्रुवों पर \(90^\circ\) तक बढ़ता है, \(\cos\lambda\) का मान \(1\) से \(0\) तक घटता है, इसलिए \(g(\lambda)\) बढ़ता है।
4. सूत्र \(g = \frac{GM}{R^2}\) से स्पष्ट है कि \(g\) पृथ्वी के द्रव्यमान \(M\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती है, अतः यह पृथ्वी के द्रव्यमान से स्वतंत्र नहीं है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
गुरुत्वीय त्वरण ऊँचाई बढ़ने के साथ घटता है तथा अक्षांश बढ़ने के साथ बढ़ता है।

answer.text: Acceleration due to gravity decreases with increasing altitude.
Acceleration due to gravity increases with increasing depth (assume the earth to be a sphere of uniform density).
Acceleration due to gravity increases with increasing latitude.
Acceleration due to gravity is independent of the mass of the earth.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_10 - Consequences of an inverse-cube law of gravitation

questiontext.text:
8.10 If the law of gravitation, instead of being inverse-square law, becomes an inverse-cube law-

8.10 यदि गुरुत्वाकर्षण का नियम व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग नियम के स्थान पर व्युत्क्रम-घन नियम हो जाए, तो-

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
If the gravitational force varies as \(F(r) = \frac{K}{r^3}\), we examine orbital stability/shape, near-surface projectile motion, and the shell theorem.

Step 2: Evaluation of Orbits, Projectile Motion, and Shell Theorem
1. Closed elliptical orbits occur only for inverse-square (\(1/r^2\)) or linear Hookean (\(r\)) central forces (Bertrand's theorem). With an inverse-cube law, planets will not have elliptical orbits.
2. Circular orbits are still possible because the centripetal force condition \(\frac{mv^2}{r} = \frac{K}{r^3}\) can be satisfied at \(v = \sqrt{\frac{K}{mr^2}}\) (even though such orbits are unstable).
3. Near the surface of the earth (height \(h \ll R\)), the acceleration due to gravity \(g' = \frac{GM'}{R^3}\) remains approximately constant in magnitude and downward in direction, so the trajectory of a stone thrown by hand will still be approximately parabolic.
4. Newton's shell theorem (zero gravitational force inside a uniform spherical shell) holds strictly only for the inverse-square law because the surface area of a solid angle scales as \(r^2\), cancelling \(1/r^2\). For an inverse-cube law, the force inside a uniform spherical shell will not be zero.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
If gravitation followed an inverse-cube law, planets would not have elliptic orbits, and projectile motion of a stone near the earth's surface would still be approximately parabolic.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
यदि गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल \(F(r) = \frac{K}{r^3}\) के रूप में परिवर्तित हो, तो हम कक्षीय आकार/स्थिरता, पृथ्वी की सतह के निकट प्रक्षेप्य गति तथा कोश प्रमेय का परीक्षण करते हैं।

चरण 2: कक्षाओं, प्रक्षेप्य गति और कोश प्रमेय का मूल्यांकन
1. बंद दीर्घवृत्ताकार कक्षाएँ केवल व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग (\(1/r^2\)) या रैखिक (\(r\)) केंद्रीय बलों के लिए ही संभव होती हैं (बर्ट्रेंड प्रमेय)। व्युत्क्रम-घन नियम में ग्रहों की कक्षाएँ दीर्घवृत्ताकार नहीं होंगी।
2. वृत्ताकार कक्षाएँ फिर भी संभव हैं क्योंकि अभिकेंद्रीय बल की शर्त \(\frac{mv^2}{r} = \frac{K}{r^3}\), वेग \(v = \sqrt{\frac{K}{mr^2}}\) पर संतुष्ट हो सकती है (भले ही ऐसी कक्षाएँ अस्थायी हों)।
3. पृथ्वी की सतह के निकट (ऊँचाई \(h \ll R\)), गुरुत्वीय त्वरण \(g' = \frac{GM'}{R^3}\) परिमाण में लगभग नियत और नीचे की ओर रहता है, इसलिए हाथ से फेंके गए पत्थर की प्रक्षेप्य गति अभी भी लगभग परवलयाकार होगी।
4. न्यूटन का कोश प्रमेय (एकसमान गोलीय कोश के भीतर शून्य गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल) केवल व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग नियम के लिए ही सत्य होता है। व्युत्क्रम-घन नियम के लिए गोलीय कोश के भीतर बल शून्य नहीं होगा।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
यदि गुरुत्वाकर्षण व्युत्क्रम-घन नियम का पालन करे, तो ग्रहों की कक्षाएँ दीर्घवृत्ताकार नहीं होंगी तथा पृथ्वी की सतह पर हाथ से फेंके गए पत्थर की प्रक्षेप्य गति लगभग परवलयाकार होगी।

answer.text: circular orbits of planets is not possible.
projectile motion of a stone thrown by hand on the surface of the earth will be approximately parabolic.
there will be no gravitational force inside a spherical shell of uniform density.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_11 - Effect of changing G and mass of the sun

questiontext.text:
8.11 If the mass of sun were ten times smaller and gravitational constant \(G\) were ten times larger in magnitudes-

8.11 यदि सूर्य का द्रव्यमान परिमाण में दस गुना कम होता और गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक \(G\) दस गुना बड़ा होता, तो-

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
New mass of the sun: \(M_s' = \frac{M_s}{10}\). New gravitational constant: \(G' = 10G\). Mass of the earth \(M_e\) and radius of the earth \(R_e\) remain unchanged.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Standard expressions for acceleration due to gravity on earth, terminal velocity of raindrops, and aerodynamic lift required for level flight apply.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
1. Acceleration due to gravity on earth: \(g = \frac{G M_e}{R_e^2}\)
2. Terminal velocity of a spherical raindrop of radius \(r\): \(v_t = \frac{2 r^2 (\rho - \sigma) g}{9\eta}\)
3. Aerodynamic lift balancing weight: \(L \propto \rho_{\text{air}} A v^2 = m g\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The new acceleration due to gravity on earth is:
\(g' = \frac{G' M_e}{R_e^2} = \frac{(10G) M_e}{R_e^2} = 10g\)
Since \(g' = 10g\):
- Weight \(mg'\) increases tenfold, making walking on the ground much more difficult.
- Terminal velocity \(v_t \propto g\) increases tenfold, so raindrops will fall much faster.
- To generate ten times more lift to balance the increased weight \(mg'\), airplanes will have to travel much faster (\(v \propto \sqrt{g}\)).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Although the product \(G' M_s' = G M_s\) for the sun-earth attraction remains unchanged, \(g\) on earth increases 10 times. Therefore, walking on ground becomes more difficult, raindrops fall much faster, and airplanes have to travel much faster.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
सूर्य का नया द्रव्यमान: \(M_s' = \frac{M_s}{10}\)। नया गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक: \(G' = 10G\)। पृथ्वी का द्रव्यमान \(M_e\) और पृथ्वी की त्रिज्या \(R_e\) अपरिवर्तित रहते हैं।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
पृथ्वी पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण, वर्षा की बूँदों के सीमांत वेग तथा क्षैतिज उड़ान के लिए आवश्यक वायुगतिकीय उत्थापन बल के मानक सूत्र लागू होते हैं।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
1. पृथ्वी पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण: \(g = \frac{G M_e}{R_e^2}\)
2. \(r\) त्रिज्या की गोलाकार वर्षा की बूँद का सीमांत वेग: \(v_t = \frac{2 r^2 (\rho - \sigma) g}{9\eta}\)
3. भार को संतुलित करने वाला वायुगतिकीय उत्थापन: \(L \propto \rho_{\text{air}} A v^2 = m g\)

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
पृथ्वी पर नया गुरुत्वीय त्वरण:
\(g' = \frac{G' M_e}{R_e^2} = \frac{(10G) M_e}{R_e^2} = 10g\)
चूँकि \(g' = 10g\) है:
- भार \(mg'\) दस गुना बढ़ जाता है, जिससे जमीन पर चलना अधिक कठिन हो जाएगा।
- सीमांत वेग \(v_t \propto g\) दस गुना बढ़ जाता है, अतः वर्षा की बूँदें बहुत तेजी से गिरेंगी।
- बढ़े हुए भार \(mg'\) को संतुलित करने के लिए दस गुना अधिक उत्थापन उत्पन्न करने हेतु हवाई जहाजों को बहुत अधिक तेजी से उड़ना होगा (\(v \propto \sqrt{g}\))।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
यद्यपि सूर्य-पृथ्वी आकर्षण के लिए गुणनफल \(G' M_s' = G M_s\) अपरिवर्तित रहता है, फिर भी पृथ्वी पर \(g\) का मान 10 गुना बढ़ जाता है। अतः जमीन पर चलना अधिक कठिन हो जाएगा, वर्षा की बूँदें बहुत तेजी से गिरेंगी, और हवाई जहाजों को बहुत तेजी से उड़ना होगा।

answer.text: walking on ground would become more difficult.
the acceleration due to gravity on earth will not change.
airplanes will have to travel much faster.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_12 - Kepler laws if sun and planets carried opposite charges

questiontext.text:
8.12 If the sun and the planets carried huge amounts of opposite charges,

8.12 यदि सूर्य और ग्रहों पर विपरीत प्रकार के भारी आवेश होते, तो

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Both Newton's law of gravitation and Coulomb's law of electrostatics between opposite charges are attractive, central, and follow the inverse-square law (\(1/r^2\)).

Step 2: Evaluation of Kepler's Three Laws
Let the sun (mass \(M_s\), charge \(+Q\)) attract a planet (mass \(m\), charge \(-q\)) at distance \(r\). The net attractive central force is:
\(F = \frac{G M_s m + k Q q}{r^2} = \frac{m \left(G M_s + k Q \frac{q}{m}\right)}{r^2}\)
1. First Law: Since the net force is attractive and proportional to \(1/r^2\), the orbit of each planet will still be an ellipse with the sun at one focus.
2. Second Law: Because the net force is purely central (directed towards the sun), angular momentum is conserved and areal velocity \(\frac{dA}{dt} = \frac{L}{2m}\) remains constant. Thus, the second law does not change.
3. Third Law: The time period satisfies \(T^2 = \frac{4\pi^2}{G M_s + k Q (q/m)} a^3\). Since the charge-to-mass ratio \(q/m\) can differ from planet to planet, the ratio \(T^2/a^3\) is not the same constant for all planets, so the third law is no longer valid in general.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Both the first law and the second law will still remain valid, whereas the third law will not hold universally.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
विपरीत आवेशों के बीच कूलॉम का स्थिरवैद्युत नियम और न्यूटन का गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियम दोनों ही आकर्षक, केंद्रीय और व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग नियम (\(1/r^2\)) का पालन करते हैं।

चरण 2: केपलर के तीनों नियमों का मूल्यांकन
मान लीजिए \(r\) दूरी पर सूर्य (द्रव्यमान \(M_s\), आवेश \(+Q\)) एक ग्रह (द्रव्यमान \(m\), आवेश \(-q\)) को आकर्षित करता है। नेट आकर्षक केंद्रीय बल है:
\(F = \frac{G M_s m + k Q q}{r^2} = \frac{m \left(G M_s + k Q \frac{q}{m}\right)}{r^2}\)
1. प्रथम नियम: चूँकि नेट बल आकर्षक है और \(1/r^2\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती है, अतः प्रत्येक ग्रह की कक्षा अभी भी दीर्घवृत्ताकार होगी जिसके एक फोकस पर सूर्य स्थित होगा।
2. द्वितीय नियम: चूँकि नेट बल पूर्णतः केंद्रीय (सूर्य की ओर निर्दिष्ट) है, इसलिए कोणीय संवेग संरक्षित रहता है और क्षेत्रीय वेग \(\frac{dA}{dt} = \frac{L}{2m}\) नियत रहता है। अतः द्वितीय नियम में कोई परिवर्तन नहीं होगा।
3. तृतीय नियम: आवर्तकाल का संबंध \(T^2 = \frac{4\pi^2}{G M_s + k Q (q/m)} a^3\) होता है। चूँकि आवेश-द्रव्यमान अनुपात \(q/m\) विभिन्न ग्रहों के लिए भिन्न हो सकता है, अतः सभी ग्रहों के लिए \(T^2/a^3\) एक समान नियतांक नहीं रहेगा। इसलिए तृतीय नियम सामान्य रूप से वैध नहीं रहेगा।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
प्रथम नियम तथा द्वितीय नियम दोनों ही अभी भी वैध रहेंगे, जबकि तृतीय नियम सार्वत्रिक रूप से वैध नहीं रहेगा।

answer.text: all three of Kepler's laws would still be valid.
only the third law will be valid.
the first law will still be valid.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_13 - Effect of gravitational constant G decreasing over billions of years

questiontext.text:
8.13 There have been suggestions that the value of the gravitational constant \(G\) becomes smaller when considered over very large time period (in billions of years) in the future. If that happens, for our earth,

8.13 ऐसे सुझाव दिए गए हैं कि भविष्य में बहुत लंबे समय अंतराल (अरबों वर्षों) में विचार करने पर गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियतांक \(G\) का मान कम हो जाता है। यदि ऐसा होता है, तो हमारी पृथ्वी के लिए,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The gravitational force between the sun and the earth is \(F = \frac{G M_s M_e}{r^2}\). Since the force is central, the earth's angular momentum \(L = M_e v r = M_e \sqrt{G M_s r}\) (for a nearly circular orbit) remains conserved.

Step 2: Evaluation of Orbital Radius and Trajectory
As \(G\) slowly decreases over billions of years, for \(L = M_e \sqrt{G M_s r}\) to remain constant, the orbital radius \(r\) must continuously increase. Consequently:
1. The earth will move in a slowly expanding spiral rather than a strictly closed orbit.
2. As the earth moves farther away from the sun, the solar radiation received decreases, so the earth will become colder (not hotter).
3. After a sufficiently long time as \(G\) becomes very small, the gravitational attraction will be too weak to keep the earth bound, and we will leave the solar system.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
We will be going around the sun but not strictly in closed orbits, and after a sufficiently long time we will leave the solar system.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
सूर्य और पृथ्वी के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल \(F = \frac{G M_s M_e}{r^2}\) है। चूँकि यह बल केंद्रीय है, इसलिए पृथ्वी का कोणीय संवेग \(L = M_e v r = M_e \sqrt{G M_s r}\) (लगभग वृत्ताकार कक्षा के लिए) संरक्षित रहता है।

चरण 2: कक्षीय त्रिज्या और पथ का मूल्यांकन
जैसे-जैसे अरबों वर्षों में \(G\) धीरे-धीरे घटता है, \(L = M_e \sqrt{G M_s r}\) को नियत रखने के लिए कक्षीय त्रिज्या \(r\) का निरंतर बढ़ना आवश्यक है। परिणामस्वरूप:
1. पृथ्वी एक ठीक बंद कक्षा के बजाय धीरे-धीरे फैलते हुए सर्पिलाकार पथ पर गति करेगी।
2. सूर्य से दूर जाने पर प्राप्त सौर विकिरण कम हो जाएगा, जिससे पृथ्वी अधिक ठंडी होगी (गर्म नहीं)।
3. पर्याप्त लंबे समय के बाद जब \(G\) अत्यंत कम हो जाएगा, तो गुरुत्वाकर्षण आकर्षण पृथ्वी को बांधे रखने के लिए अपर्याप्त होगा और हम सौर मंडल से बाहर निकल जाएँगे।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
हम परिक्रमा तो करते रहेंगे परंतु ठीक बंद कक्षाओं में नहीं, और पर्याप्त लंबे समय के बाद हम सौर मंडल को छोड़ देंगे।

answer.text: we will become hotter after billions of years.
we will be going around but not strictly in closed orbits.
after sufficiently long time we will leave the solar system.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_14 - Modified power-law mass dependence in gravitation

questiontext.text:
8.14 Supposing Newton's law of gravitation for gravitation forces \(\mathbf{F}_1\) and \(\mathbf{F}_2\) between two masses \(m_1\) and \(m_2\) at positions \(\mathbf{r}_1\) and \(\mathbf{r}_2\) read

\[\mathbf{F}_1 = -\mathbf{F}_2 = -\frac{\mathbf{r}_{12}}{r_{12}^3} G M_0^2 \left( \frac{m_1 m_2}{M_0^2} \right)^n\]

where \(M_0\) is a constant of dimension of mass, \(\mathbf{r}_{12} = \mathbf{r}_1 - \mathbf{r}_2\) and \(n\) is a number. In such a case,

8.14 मान लीजिए दो द्रव्यमानों \(m_1\) तथा \(m_2\), जिनकी स्थितियाँ \(\mathbf{r}_1\) तथा \(\mathbf{r}_2\) हैं, के बीच गुरुत्वाकर्षण बलों \(\mathbf{F}_1\) तथा \(\mathbf{F}_2\) के लिए न्यूटन का गुरुत्वाकर्षण नियम इस प्रकार पढ़ा जाता है

\[\mathbf{F}_1 = -\mathbf{F}_2 = -\frac{\mathbf{r}_{12}}{r_{12}^3} G M_0^2 \left( \frac{m_1 m_2}{M_0^2} \right)^n\]

जहाँ \(M_0\) द्रव्यमान की विमा वाला एक नियतांक है, \(\mathbf{r}_{12} = \mathbf{r}_1 - \mathbf{r}_2\) तथा \(n\) एक संख्या है। ऐसी स्थिति में,

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The modified gravitational force between masses \(m_1\) and \(m_2\) is:
\(\mathbf{F}_1 = -\mathbf{F}_2 = -\frac{\mathbf{r}_{12}}{r_{12}^3} G M_0^2 \left( \frac{m_1 m_2}{M_0^2} \right)^n\)

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Inertial mass remains \(m\) in Newton's second law \(\mathbf{F} = m\mathbf{a}\). For a planet of mass \(m\) around the sun (mass \(M_s\)), \(m \ll M_s\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
1. Acceleration due to gravity on earth (mass \(M_e\), radius \(R_e\)) for an object of mass \(m\): \(g = \frac{F}{m}\)
2. Kepler's laws for a central inverse-square force \(F(r) = -\frac{C}{r^2}\hat{r}\)
3. Archimedes' principle: buoyant force equals the weight of displaced fluid.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Acceleration due to gravity: For an object of mass \(m\) on the earth's surface:
\(g = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{G M_0^2}{R_e^2 m} \left(\frac{M_e m}{M_0^2}\right)^n = \frac{G M_0^{2(1-n)} M_e^n}{R_e^2} m^{n-1}\)
Thus, for \(n \neq 1\), \(g\) depends on \(m\) and is different for different objects.
2. Kepler's Laws: For any single planet of mass \(m\), the force is still central and inverse-square (\(\propto 1/r^2\)), so Kepler's first law (elliptical orbits) and second law (equal areas in equal times) remain valid. However, the third law gives \(T^2 = \frac{4\pi^2}{G M_0^{2(1-n)} M_s^n m^{n-1}} a^3\), which depends on the planet's mass \(m\). Hence, only the third law becomes invalid.
3. Floating/Sinking for \(n < 0\): Consider an object of volume \(V\) and density \(\rho < \rho_w\) (lighter than water, so \(m = \rho V < m_w = \rho_w V\)). Its downward weight is \(W \propto m^n = (\rho V)^n\), while the upward buoyant force (weight of displaced water) is \(F_B \propto m_w^n = (\rho_w V)^n\). Since \(n < 0\) and \(\rho < \rho_w\), we have \((\rho V)^n > (\rho_w V)^n\), meaning \(W > F_B\). Thus, an object lighter than water will sink in water.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
For this modified law, \(g\) differs for different objects, only Kepler's third law becomes invalid, and for negative \(n\), an object lighter than water will sink in water.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
द्रव्यमानों \(m_1\) और \(m_2\) के बीच संशोधित गुरुत्वाकर्षण बल है:
\(\mathbf{F}_1 = -\mathbf{F}_2 = -\frac{\mathbf{r}_{12}}{r_{12}^3} G M_0^2 \left( \frac{m_1 m_2}{M_0^2} \right)^n\)

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
न्यूटन के द्वितीय नियम \(\mathbf{F} = m\mathbf{a}\) में जड़त्वीय द्रव्यमान \(m\) ही रहता है। सूर्य (द्रव्यमान \(M_s\)) के चारों ओर \(m\) द्रव्यमान के ग्रह के लिए \(m \ll M_s\)।

चरण 3: प्रासंगिक सूत्र और सिद्धांत
1. \(m\) द्रव्यमान की वस्तु के लिए पृथ्वी (द्रव्यमान \(M_e\), त्रिज्या \(R_e\)) पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण: \(g = \frac{F}{m}\)
2. केंद्रीय व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग बल \(F(r) = -\frac{C}{r^2}\hat{r}\) के लिए केपलर के नियम
3. आर्किमिडीज का सिद्धांत: उत्प्लावन बल विस्थापित द्रव के भार के बराबर होता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
1. गुरुत्वीय त्वरण: पृथ्वी की सतह पर \(m\) द्रव्यमान की वस्तु के लिए:
\(g = \frac{F}{m} = \frac{G M_0^2}{R_e^2 m} \left(\frac{M_e m}{M_0^2}\right)^n = \frac{G M_0^{2(1-n)} M_e^n}{R_e^2} m^{n-1}\)
अतः \(n \neq 1\) के लिए, \(g\) द्रव्यमान \(m\) पर निर्भर करता है और विभिन्न वस्तुओं के लिए भिन्न होगा।
2. केपलर के नियम: किसी एक ग्रह (द्रव्यमान \(m\)) के लिए बल अभी भी केंद्रीय और व्युत्क्रम-वर्ग (\(\propto 1/r^2\)) है, इसलिए केपलर का प्रथम नियम (दीर्घवृत्ताकार कक्षा) और द्वितीय नियम (समान समय में समान क्षेत्रफल) वैध रहते हैं। किंतु तृतीय नियम \(T^2 = \frac{4\pi^2}{G M_0^{2(1-n)} M_s^n m^{n-1}} a^3\) ग्रह के द्रव्यमान \(m\) पर निर्भर करता है। अतः केवल तृतीय नियम अमान्य हो जाएगा।
3. \(n < 0\) के लिए तैरना/डूबना: \(V\) आयतन और \(\rho < \rho_w\) घनत्व वाली वस्तु (जल से हल्की, अर्थात \(m = \rho V < m_w = \rho_w V\)) पर विचार करें। इसका नीचे की ओर भार \(W \propto m^n = (\rho V)^n\) है, जबकि ऊपर की ओर उत्प्लावन बल (विस्थापित जल का भार) \(F_B \propto m_w^n = (\rho_w V)^n\) है। चूँकि \(n < 0\) और \(\rho < \rho_w\), इसलिए \((\rho V)^n > (\rho_w V)^n\), अर्थात \(W > F_B\)। अतः जल से हल्की वस्तु जल में डूब जाएगी।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
इस संशोधित नियम के लिए, पृथ्वी पर गुरुत्वीय त्वरण विभिन्न वस्तुओं के लिए भिन्न होगा, केवल केपलर का तृतीय नियम अमान्य होगा, तथा ऋणात्मक \(n\) के लिए जल से हल्की वस्तु जल में डूब जाएगी।

answer.text: the acceleration due to gravity on earth will be different for different objects.
none of the three laws of Kepler will be valid.
only the third law will become invalid.
for \(n\) negative, an object lighter than water will sink in water.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_15 - Orbital directions of polar and geostationary satellites

questiontext.text:
8.15 Which of the following are true?

8.15 निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से कथन सत्य हैं?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Artificial satellites are placed in specific orbital planes and directions depending on their intended function (earth observation vs. communication).

Step 2: Evaluation of Satellite Orbits
1. Polar satellite: A polar satellite orbits in a plane passing through the earth's north and south poles, so it travels around the earth in the north-south direction.
2. Geostationary satellite: A geostationary satellite must remain stationary relative to a point on the earth's equator. Since the earth rotates about its axis from west to east, a geostationary satellite must also revolve in the equatorial plane from west to east with the same 24-hour time period.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
A polar satellite goes around the earth's pole in the north-south direction, and a geostationary satellite goes around the earth in the west-east direction.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
कृत्रिम उपग्रहों को उनके उद्देश्य (पृथ्वी अवलोकन बनाम संचार) के आधार पर विशिष्ट कक्षीय तलों और दिशाओं में स्थापित किया जाता है।

चरण 2: उपग्रह कक्षाओं का मूल्यांकन
1. ध्रुवीय उपग्रह: एक ध्रुवीय उपग्रह पृथ्वी के उत्तरी और दक्षिणी ध्रुवों से गुजरने वाले तल में परिक्रमा करता है, अतः यह पृथ्वी के चारों ओर उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशा में गति करता है।
2. भू-स्थिर उपग्रह: एक भू-स्थिर उपग्रह को पृथ्वी की विषुवत रेखा पर स्थित किसी बिंदु के सापेक्ष स्थिर रहना होता है। चूँकि पृथ्वी अपने अक्ष पर पश्चिम से पूर्व दिशा में घूर्णन करती है, इसलिए भू-स्थिर उपग्रह को भी 24 घंटे के समान आवर्तकाल के साथ विषुवतीय तल में पश्चिम से पूर्व दिशा में परिक्रमा करनी होती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
ध्रुवीय उपग्रह पृथ्वी के ध्रुवों के चारों ओर उत्तर-दक्षिण दिशा में जाता है, तथा भू-स्थिर उपग्रह पृथ्वी के चारों ओर पश्चिम-पूर्व दिशा में जाता है।

answer.text: A polar satellite goes around the earth's pole in north-south direction.
A geostationary satellite goes around the earth in east-west direction.
A geostationary satellite goes around the earth in west-east direction.
A polar satellite goes around the earth in east-west direction.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_GRAVITATION_Q8_16 - Centre of mass and centre of gravity of an extended body

questiontext.text:
8.16 The centre of mass of an extended body on the surface of the earth and its centre of gravity

8.16 पृथ्वी की सतह पर स्थित किसी विस्तृत पिंड का द्रव्यमान केंद्र तथा उसका गुरुत्व केंद्र

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The centre of mass (CM) of a body depends solely on its mass distribution, whereas the centre of gravity (CG) is the point where the resultant gravitational torque vanishes and depends on the variation of the gravitational field \(\vec{g}\) over the body's volume.

Step 2: Evaluation of CM and CG Separation
1. For very large extended bodies (such as mountains or tall skyscrapers), the acceleration due to gravity decreases noticeably with height and changes slightly in direction, so the CM and CG do not coincide.
2. For everyday objects of sizes less than \(100\text{ m}\), the variation in \(g\) across the object is \(\frac{\Delta g}{g} \approx \frac{2h}{R_e} < 3 \times 10^{-5}\), which is negligible. Hence, the gravitational field is practically uniform over the body, making the CM and CG very close to each other.
3. If the body is taken deep inside the earth, the gravitational field changes, so the CG can shift slightly, but the CM is an intrinsic property of the body's mass distribution and does not change.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The centre of mass and centre of gravity of an extended body on the surface of the earth are close to each other for objects of sizes less than \(100\text{ m}\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
किसी पिंड का द्रव्यमान केंद्र (CM) केवल उसके द्रव्यमान वितरण पर निर्भर करता है, जबकि गुरुत्व केंद्र (CG) वह बिंदु है जहाँ परिणामी गुरुत्वीय बलाघूर्ण शून्य होता है और यह पिंड के आयतन पर गुरुत्वीय क्षेत्र \(\vec{g}\) के परिवर्तन पर निर्भर करता है।

चरण 2: CM और CG के बीच अंतर का मूल्यांकन
1. बहुत बड़े विस्तृत पिंडों (जैसे पर्वत या ऊँची गगनचुंबी इमारतें) के लिए ऊँचाई के साथ गुरुत्वीय त्वरण में उल्लेखनीय कमी आती है और दिशा में भी थोड़ा परिवर्तन होता है, इसलिए CM और CG संपाती नहीं होते।
2. \(100\text{ m}\) से कम आकार की सामान्य वस्तुओं के लिए, वस्तु के आर-पार \(g\) में परिवर्तन \(\frac{\Delta g}{g} \approx \frac{2h}{R_e} < 3 \times 10^{-5}\) होता है, जो नगण्य है। अतः पिंड पर गुरुत्वीय क्षेत्र व्यावहारिक रूप से एकसमान होता है, जिससे CM और CG एक-दूसरे के बहुत निकट होते हैं।
3. यदि पिंड को पृथ्वी के भीतर गहराई में ले जाया जाए, तो गुरुत्वीय क्षेत्र बदलने से CG थोड़ा बदल सकता है, परंतु CM पिंड के द्रव्यमान वितरण का आंतरिक गुण है और वह नहीं बदलता।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
पृथ्वी की सतह पर किसी विस्तृत पिंड का द्रव्यमान केंद्र और गुरुत्व केंद्र \(100\text{ m}\) से कम आकार की वस्तुओं के लिए एक-दूसरे के निकट होते हैं।

answer.text: are always at the same point for any size of the body.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0901 - Modulus of rigidity of ideal liquids

questiontext.text: Modulus of rigidity of ideal liquids is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Modulus of rigidity (shear modulus, \(\eta\)) is defined as the ratio of tangential (shearing) stress to shearing strain: \(\eta = \frac{\text{Shearing stress}}{\text{Shearing strain}}\).

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
An ideal liquid has zero viscosity and offers no resistance to tangential or shearing forces. Consequently, it cannot sustain any shearing stress in equilibrium, meaning the shearing stress is zero for any shear deformation.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Since the shearing stress is zero, the modulus of rigidity of an ideal liquid is zero.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0902 - Maximum load a wire can withstand when length halved

questiontext.text: The maximum load a wire can withstand without breaking, when its length is reduced to half of its original length, will

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The breaking stress (ultimate tensile strength) of a wire is an intensive property that depends only on the material of the wire and temperature, not on its dimensions.

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
The maximum load (breaking force) a wire can withstand is given by \(F_{\text{max}} = \text{Breaking stress} \times A\), where \(A\) is the cross-sectional area of the wire. Neither the breaking stress nor the cross-sectional area depends on the length of the wire.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
When the length of the wire is reduced to half of its original length, the maximum load it can withstand without breaking will remain the same.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0903 - Effect of doubling temperature on Youngs modulus

questiontext.text: The temperature of a wire is doubled. The Young's modulus of elasticity

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Elasticity of a solid arises from the restoring interatomic forces between its constituent atoms. Young's modulus of elasticity is directly proportional to the strength of these interatomic binding forces.

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
When the temperature of a wire is increased (doubled), the thermal agitation of the atoms increases and the average interatomic separation increases due to thermal expansion. This weakens the interatomic restoring forces, making the material easier to deform under a given stress.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Because the interatomic forces weaken with rising temperature, the Young's modulus of elasticity of the wire will decrease.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0904 - Strain produced in a stretched spring

questiontext.text: A spring is stretched by applying a load to its free end. The strain produced in the spring is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Longitudinal strain is associated with a change in length along the axis of loading, whereas shear strain is associated with a change in shape or twisting of the cross-section of a wire.

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
When a helical spring is stretched by applying an axial load at its free end, the overall length of the spring increases, producing longitudinal strain. At the same time, the wire forming the coils of the spring undergoes twisting (torsion), which produces shear strain in the material of the wire.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the strain produced in a stretched spring is both longitudinal and shear.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0905 - Ratio of diameters of copper and iron wires

questiontext.text: A rigid bar of mass \(M\) is supported symmetrically by three wires each of length \(l\). Those at each end are of copper and the middle one is of iron. The ratio of their diameters, if each is to have the same tension, is equal to

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the rigid bar \(= M\). Three vertical wires each of length \(l\) support the bar symmetrically: two outer wires of copper (Young's modulus \(Y_{\text{copper}}\)) and one middle wire of iron (Young's modulus \(Y_{\text{iron}}\)). Each wire has the same tension \(T\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Because the bar is rigid and supported symmetrically, it remains horizontal, so all three wires undergo the same elongation \(\Delta l\) and hence the same longitudinal strain \(\frac{\Delta l}{l}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Young's modulus is given by:
\[Y = \frac{\text{Stress}}{\text{Strain}} = \frac{T / A}{\Delta l / l}\]
where the cross-sectional area of a wire of diameter \(d\) is \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Rearranging the Young's modulus formula for the area \(A\):
\[A = \frac{T l}{Y \Delta l}\]
Substituting \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\):
\[\frac{\pi d^2}{4} = \frac{T l}{Y \Delta l}\]
Since \(T\), \(l\), and \(\Delta l\) are identical for all three wires, \(d^2 \propto \frac{1}{Y}\), or \(d \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{Y}}\).
Taking the ratio of the diameter of the copper wire to that of the iron wire:
\[\frac{d_{\text{copper}}}{d_{\text{iron}}} = \sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The ratio is dimensionless, as required for a ratio of diameters. Since copper has a smaller Young's modulus than iron, the copper wire needs a larger diameter to carry the same tension at the same strain. Thus, the ratio of their diameters is \(\sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0906 - Strain in a wire stretched horizontally between pillars

questiontext.text: A mild steel wire of length \(2L\) and cross-sectional area \(A\) is stretched, well within elastic limit, horizontally between two pillars (Fig. 9.1). A mass \(m\) is suspended from the mid point of the wire. Strain in the wire is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Original length of the wire \(= 2L\), cross-sectional area \(= A\). A mass \(m\) suspended at the midpoint depresses the midpoint vertically downward by a distance \(x\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since the deformation is well within the elastic limit of mild steel, the depression is small compared to the half-length, i.e., \(x \ll L\). Each half of the wire forms the hypotenuse of a right-angled triangle with horizontal base \(L\) and vertical side \(x\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Longitudinal strain is defined as:
\[\text{Strain} = \frac{\Delta l}{l_0}\]
where \(\Delta l\) is the change in length and \(l_0 = 2L\) is the original length. For \(u \ll 1\), the binomial approximation gives \((1 + u)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \frac{u}{2}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
The stretched length of each half of the wire is:
\[L' = \sqrt{L^2 + x^2} = L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{L^2}\right)^{1/2}\]
Applying the binomial approximation for \(x \ll L\):
\[L' \approx L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\right) = L + \frac{x^2}{2L}\]
The total stretched length of the wire is \(2L' = 2L + \frac{x^2}{L}\).
Hence, the increase in length is:
\[\Delta l = 2L' - 2L = \frac{x^2}{L}\]
Dividing by the original length \(2L\) gives the strain:
\text{Strain} = \frac{\Delta l}{2L} = \frac{x^2 / L}{2L} = \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The expression \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\) is dimensionless and positive, and it vanishes when \(x = 0\), as expected. Therefore, the strain in the wire is \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0907 - Tension in strings suspending a rectangular frame

questiontext.text:
A rectangular frame is to be suspended symmetrically by two strings of equal length on two supports (Fig. 9.2). It can be done in one of the following three ways;

The tension in the strings will be

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A rectangular frame of weight \(mg\) is suspended symmetrically by two strings of equal length in three configurations: strings inclined outward, strings vertical, and strings inclined inward.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(\theta\) be the angle that each string makes with the vertical, and \(T\) be the tension in each string (equal by symmetry). Upward forces are taken as positive.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For static vertical equilibrium of the frame, the sum of the vertical components of tension must balance the weight:
\[2T \cos\theta = mg \implies T = \frac{mg}{2\cos\theta}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
When the two strings are vertical, \(\theta = 0^\circ\), so \(\cos\theta = \cos 0^\circ = 1\), which is the maximum possible value of \(\cos\theta\). This gives the minimum tension:
\[T_{\text{min}} = \frac{mg}{2}\]
When the strings are inclined outward or inward, \(\theta > 0^\circ\), so \(\cos\theta < 1\), which makes \(T > \frac{mg}{2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
As \(\theta\) increases from \(0^\circ\), \(\cos\theta\) decreases and tension \(T\) increases. Therefore, the tension in the strings is least in the vertical suspension configuration, which corresponds to configuration (b).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0908 - Elongation and shape change of rubber and steel rods

questiontext.text: Consider two cylindrical rods of identical dimensions, one of rubber and the other of steel. Both the rods are fixed rigidly at one end to the roof. A mass \(M\) is attached to each of the free ends at the centre of the rods.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The elongation and local deformation of a rod under a central point load depend on its Young's modulus \(Y\) and shear rigidity. A material with a very high Young's modulus resists both stretching and local shear deformation, whereas a material with a very low Young's modulus deforms appreciably.

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
Steel has a very large Young's modulus (\(Y \approx 2 \times 10^{11}\text{ N m}^{-2}\)), so under the weight \(Mg\) attached at the centre of its free end, it elongates slightly without any perceptible change in the shape of its bottom face. In contrast, rubber has a very small Young's modulus. Because the mass \(M\) is attached at the centre of the free end, the central region experiences greater downward pull and stretches much more than the outer edges, causing the bottom edge of the rubber rod to taper to a tip at the centre.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The steel rod will elongate without any perceptible change in shape, while the rubber rod will elongate with the shape of the bottom edge tapered to a tip at the centre.

answer.text: Both the rods will elongate but there shall be no perceptible change in shape.
The steel rod will elongate and change shape but the rubber rod will only elongate.
The steel rod will elongate without any perceptible change in shape, but the rubber rod will elongate and the shape of the bottom edge will change to an ellipse.
The steel rod will elongate, without any perceptible change in shape, but the rubber rod will elongate with the shape of the bottom edge tapered to a tip at the centre.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0909 - Stress-strain graphs for two materials

questiontext.text: The stress-strain graphs for two materials are shown in Fig. 9.3 (assume same scale).

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two stress-strain curves for Material (i) and Material (ii) are plotted on the same scale, showing the linear limit, ultimate tension strength, and fracture point for each.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The elastic region is the region up to the linear (proportional) limit on the strain axis. Brittleness is indicated by how close the fracture point is to the ultimate tension strength (a small plastic region between ultimate tension strength and fracture point indicates greater brittleness).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Young's modulus \(Y\) is the slope of the linear portion of the stress-strain graph. A material with a larger linear strain range is elastic over a larger region of strain, while a material with a smaller plastic deformation range before fracture is more brittle.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Comparing the two graphs:
1. The linear limit in Material (ii) extends to a larger value of strain than in Material (i), so Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain compared to Material (i).
2. In Material (ii), the fracture point lies very close to the ultimate tension strength, leaving a much smaller plastic region than in Material (i). Hence, Material (ii) is more brittle than Material (i).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both conclusions follow directly from the relative positions of the linear limit, ultimate tension strength, and fracture point on the two curves. Therefore, Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain as compared to Material (i), and Material (ii) is more brittle than Material (i).

answer.text: Material (ii) is more elastic than material (i) and hence material (ii) is more brittle.
Material (i) and (ii) have the same elasticity and the same brittleness.
Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain as compared to (i).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0910 - Tensile stress and tension in a suspended wire

questiontext.text: A wire is suspended from the ceiling and stretched under the action of a weight \(F\) suspended from its other end. The force exerted by the ceiling on it is equal and opposite to the weight.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A wire of cross-sectional area \(A\) is suspended vertically from a ceiling and pulled downward by a weight \(F\) at its lower end. The ceiling exerts an equal and opposite upward force \(F\) at the upper end.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The weight of the wire itself is negligible compared to the suspended weight \(F\), and the wire is in static equilibrium.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Tensile stress at any cross-section of area \(A\) is defined as the internal restoring force (tension \(T\)) acting perpendicular to the cross-section divided by the cross-sectional area:
\[\text{Tensile stress} = \frac{T}{A}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Consider any cross-section of the wire. For the lower portion of the wire below this cross-section to be in equilibrium under the downward weight \(F\), the upper portion must exert an upward internal force (tension) \(T = F\) at that cross-section.
Therefore, the tension at any cross-section of the wire is \(F\).
Dividing this tension by the cross-sectional area \(A\) gives the tensile stress at any cross-section:
\[\text{Tensile stress} = \frac{F}{A}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The tension is \(F\) (not \(2F\) or \(0\)), and the tensile stress has units of force per unit area, \(\frac{F}{A}\). Thus, both the tensile stress at any cross-section \(A\) of the wire is \(\frac{F}{A}\) and the tension at any cross-section \(A\) of the wire is \(F\).

answer.text: Tensile stress at any cross section \(A\) of the wire is \(F / A\).
Tensile stress at any cross section is zero.
Tensile stress at any cross section \(A\) of the wire is \(2F / A\).
Tension at any cross section \(A\) of the wire is \(F\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0911 - Rod suspended by steel and aluminium wires

questiontext.text:
A rod of length \(l\) and negligible mass is suspended at its two ends by two wires of steel (wire A) and aluminium (wire B) of equal lengths (Fig. 9.4). The cross-sectional areas of wires A and B are \(1.0\text{ mm}^2\) and \(2.0\text{ mm}^2\), respectively.

\[Y_{\text{Al}} = 70 \times 10^9\text{ Nm}^{-2} \text{ and } Y_{\text{steel}} = 200 \times 10^9\text{ Nm}^{-2}\]

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Length of rod \(= l\) (negligible mass). Wire A (steel): \(A_A = 1.0\text{ mm}^2\), \(Y_A = 200 \times 10^9\text{ N m}^{-2}\). Wire B (aluminium): \(A_B = 2.0\text{ mm}^2\), \(Y_B = 70 \times 10^9\text{ N m}^{-2}\). Both wires have equal length.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let mass \(m\) be suspended at a distance \(x\) from wire A and \((l - x)\) from wire B. Let \(T_A\) and \(T_B\) be the tensions in wires A and B, respectively.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For rotational equilibrium about the point of suspension of mass \(m\):
\[T_A x = T_B (l - x) \implies \frac{x}{l - x} = \frac{T_B}{T_A}\]
Stress is \(\sigma = \frac{T}{A}\), and strain is \(\varepsilon = \frac{\sigma}{Y} = \frac{T}{A Y}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Case 1 (Equal stresses, \(\sigma_A = \sigma_B\)):
\[\frac{T_A}{A_A} = \frac{T_B}{A_B} \implies \frac{T_B}{T_A} = \frac{A_B}{A_A} = \frac{2.0}{1.0} = 2\]
Using rotational equilibrium:
\[\frac{x}{l - x} = 2 \implies x = \frac{2l}{3}\]
Since \(x = \frac{2l}{3} > \frac{l}{2}\), mass \(m\) is closer to wire B.

Case 2 (Equal strains, \(\varepsilon_A = \varepsilon_B\)):
\[\frac{T_A}{A_A Y_A} = \frac{T_B}{A_B Y_B} \implies \frac{T_B}{T_A} = \frac{A_B Y_B}{A_A Y_A} = \frac{2.0 \times 70 \times 10^9}{1.0 \times 200 \times 10^9} = \frac{140}{200} = 0.7\]
Using rotational equilibrium:
\[\frac{x}{l - x} = 0.7 \implies x = \frac{0.7}{1.7} l < \frac{l}{2}\]
Since \(x < \frac{l}{2}\), mass \(m\) is closer to wire A.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
For equal stresses, the thicker wire (wire B) must carry double the tension, placing \(m\) closer to B. For equal strains, the stiffer product \(AY\) belongs to wire A (\(200 > 140\)), so wire A must carry more tension, placing \(m\) closer to wire A. Thus, mass \(m\) should be suspended close to B for equal stresses, and close to wire A for equal strain.

answer.text: Mass \(m\) should be suspended close to wire A to have equal stresses in both the wires.
Mass \(m\) should be suspended close to B to have equal stresses in both the wires.
Mass \(m\) should be suspended at the middle of the wires to have equal stresses in both the wires.
Mass \(m\) should be suspended close to wire A to have equal strain in both wires.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0912 - Bulk modulus and shear modulus of an ideal liquid

questiontext.text: For an ideal liquid

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
An ideal liquid is defined as one that is completely incompressible and has zero viscosity (cannot sustain any tangential or shearing stress). Bulk modulus is \(B = -V \frac{\Delta P}{\Delta V}\), and shear modulus is \(\eta = \frac{\text{Shearing stress}}{\text{Shearing strain}}\).

Step 2: Evaluation and Application
1. Since an ideal liquid is incompressible, \(\Delta V = 0\) for any finite change in pressure \(\Delta P\), which makes the bulk modulus \(B = \infty\) (infinite).
2. Since an ideal liquid offers no resistance to tangential forces, it cannot sustain any shearing stress, which makes the shear modulus \(\eta = 0\) (zero).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
For an ideal liquid, the bulk modulus is infinite and the shear modulus is zero.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQ_Q0913 - Stress and strain in copper and steel wires in series

questiontext.text: A copper and a steel wire of the same diameter are connected end to end. A deforming force \(F\) is applied to this composite wire which causes a total elongation of \(1\text{ cm}\). The two wires will have

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A copper wire and a steel wire of the same diameter \(d\) (hence equal cross-sectional area \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\)) are connected end to end (in series) and subjected to a deforming force \(F\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The wires are of negligible mass compared to the applied force \(F\), so the tension throughout the composite wire is uniform and equal to \(F\). The deformation is within the elastic limit of both materials.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Tensile stress is \(\sigma = \frac{F}{A}\).
By Hooke's law, longitudinal strain is \(\varepsilon = \frac{\sigma}{Y} = \frac{F}{A Y}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Since both wires carry the same tension \(F\) and have the same cross-sectional area \(A\), the tensile stress \(\sigma = \frac{F}{A}\) is identical in both wires.
2. Since Young's modulus of steel is greater than that of copper (\(Y_{\text{steel}} \neq Y_{\text{copper}}\)), the strains \(\varepsilon_{\text{copper}} = \frac{\sigma}{Y_{\text{copper}}}\) and \(\varepsilon_{\text{steel}} = \frac{\sigma}{Y_{\text{steel}}}\) are different.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The two wires experience the same stress because \(F\) and \(A\) are identical, and they experience different strains because their Young's moduli are different.

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_1 - Modulus of rigidity of ideal liquids

questiontext.text:
Modulus of rigidity of ideal liquids is

আদর্শ তরলের দৃঢ়তা গুণাঙ্ক (Modulus of rigidity) হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Modulus of rigidity (shear modulus, \(\eta\)) is defined as the ratio of tangential (shearing) stress to shearing strain: \(\eta = \frac{\text{Shearing stress}}{\text{Shearing strain}}\). It measures a material's resistance to a change in shape under a tangential force.

Step 2: Evaluation
An ideal liquid is incompressible and non-viscous, meaning it has zero internal friction and cannot sustain any tangential or shearing stress at rest. Even an infinitesimally small tangential force causes an ideal liquid to flow continuously.

Step 3: Application and Final Conclusion
Because an ideal liquid cannot support any shearing stress (\(\text{Shearing stress} = 0\)) for a non-zero shearing deformation, its modulus of rigidity is zero. Therefore, the modulus of rigidity of ideal liquids is zero.

ধাপ ১: মৌলিক নীতি
দৃঢ়তা গুণাঙ্ক (Shear modulus, \(\eta\)) হলো স্পর্শকীয় (কৃন্তন) পীড়ন এবং কৃন্তন বিকৃতির অনুপাত: \(\eta = \frac{\text{Shearing stress}}{\text{Shearing strain}}\)। এটি স্পর্শকীয় বলের প্রভাবে কোনো পদার্থের আকৃতি পরিবর্তনের বিরুদ্ধে প্রতিরোধ ক্ষমতা পরিমাপ করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
একটি আদর্শ তরল অসংকোচনীয় এবং সান্দ্রতাবিহীন, অর্থাৎ এর অভ্যন্তরীণ ঘর্ষণ শূন্য এবং এটি স্থির অবস্থায় কোনো স্পর্শকীয় বা কৃন্তন পীড়ন সহ্য করতে পারে না। অতি ক্ষুদ্র স্পর্শকীয় বল প্রয়োগ করলেও আদর্শ তরল অবিরাম প্রবাহিত হতে থাকে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ ও চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু আদর্শ তরল কোনো কৃন্তন বিকৃতির জন্য কোনো কৃন্তন পীড়ন (\(\text{Shearing stress} = 0\)) বজায় রাখতে পারে না, তাই এর দৃঢ়তা গুণাঙ্ক শূন্য। সুতরাং, আদর্শ তরলের দৃঢ়তা গুণাঙ্ক শূন্য।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_2 - Maximum load a wire can withstand

questiontext.text:
The maximum load a wire can withstand without breaking, when its length is reduced to half of its original length, will

কোনো তারের দৈর্ঘ্য কমিয়ে তার প্রাথমিক দৈর্ঘ্যের অর্ধেক করা হলে, তারটি না ছিঁড়ে সর্বোচ্চ যে ভার সহ্য করতে পারবে তা

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The breaking stress (ultimate tensile strength) of a wire is an intensive property that depends only on the material of the wire and its temperature, not on its dimensions such as length or cross-sectional area.

Step 2: Evaluation
The maximum load (breaking force) a wire can withstand without breaking is given by \(F_{\max} = \text{Breaking stress} \times A\), where \(A\) is the cross-sectional area of the wire.

Step 3: Application and Final Conclusion
When the length of the wire is reduced to half of its original length while keeping the material and cross-sectional area \(A\) unchanged, neither the breaking stress nor the area \(A\) changes. Consequently, the maximum load \(F_{\max}\) remains the same.

ধাপ ১: মৌলিক নীতি
কোনো তারের অসহ পীড়ন (Breaking stress) একটি উপাদানগত ধর্ম, যা কেবল তারের উপাদান এবং তাপমাত্রার ওপর নির্ভর করে; এটি তারের দৈর্ঘ্য বা প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফলের মতো মাত্রার ওপর নির্ভর করে না।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
একটি তার না ছিঁড়ে সর্বোচ্চ যে ভার (অসহ বল) সহ্য করতে পারে তা হলো \(F_{\max} = \text{Breaking stress} \times A\), যেখানে \(A\) হলো তারের প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ ও চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
তারের উপাদান এবং প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল \(A\) অপরিবর্তিত রেখে দৈর্ঘ্য অর্ধেক করা হলে, অসহ পীড়ন বা ক্ষেত্রফল \(A\) কোনোটিরই পরিবর্তন হয় না। ফলে, সর্বোচ্চ সহ্যযোগ্য ভার \(F_{\max}\) একই থাকে।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_3 - Effect of temperature on Young modulus

questiontext.text:
The temperature of a wire is doubled. The Young's modulus of elasticity

একটি তারের তাপমাত্রা দ্বিগুণ করা হলো। তারটির ইয়ং-এর স্থিতিস্থাপক গুণাঙ্ক

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Young's modulus of elasticity \(Y\) is a measure of the stiffness of a solid and arises from the interatomic restoring forces that oppose deformation.

Step 2: Evaluation
When the temperature of a wire increases (here, doubled), the thermal energy of the atoms increases, causing greater amplitude of thermal vibrations and an increase in the average interatomic separation. As interatomic spacing increases, the interatomic binding forces weaken.

Step 3: Application and Final Conclusion
Due to the weakening of interatomic restoring forces at higher temperatures, the wire becomes easier to stretch for a given stress. Therefore, the Young's modulus of elasticity will decrease.

ধাপ ১: মৌলিক নীতি
ইয়ং-এর স্থিতিস্থাপক গুণাঙ্ক \(Y\) কোনো কঠিন পদার্থের দৃঢ়তার পরিমাপ এবং এটি বিকৃতির বিরোধিতাকারী আন্তঃপারমাণবিক প্রত্যয়নী বলের কারণে সৃষ্টি হয়।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
তারের তাপমাত্রা বৃদ্ধি পেলে (এখানে দ্বিগুণ হলে) পরমাণুগুলোর তাপীয় শক্তি বৃদ্ধি পায়, যার ফলে তাপীয় কম্পনের বিস্তার বাড়ে এবং গড় আন্তঃপারমাণবিক দূরত্ব বৃদ্ধি পায়। আন্তঃপারমাণবিক দূরত্ব বাড়ার সাথে সাথে আন্তঃপারমাণবিক বন্ধন বল দুর্বল হয়ে পড়ে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ ও চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
উচ্চ তাপমাত্রায় আন্তঃপারমাণবিক প্রত্যয়নী বল দুর্বল হয়ে যাওয়ার কারণে নির্দিষ্ট পীড়নের জন্য তারটিকে প্রসারিত করা সহজ হয়। সুতরাং, ইয়ং-এর স্থিতিস্থাপক গুণাঙ্ক হ্রাস পাবে।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_4 - Strain produced in a stretched spring

questiontext.text:
A spring is stretched by applying a load to its free end. The strain produced in the spring is

একটি স্প্রিং-এর মুক্ত প্রান্তে ভার প্রয়োগ করে সেটিকে প্রসারিত করা হলো। স্প্রিংটিতে উৎপন্ন বিকৃতি হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Strain is the fractional deformation produced in a body under stress. Stretching a helical spring involves both an overall change in its length and a twisting of the wire forming its coils.

Step 2: Evaluation
When a load is suspended from the free end of a helical spring, the overall length of the spring increases along the axis of the load, which corresponds to longitudinal strain. Simultaneously, each turn of the spring wire experiences a torsional (twisting) deformation, which is a shear strain.

Step 3: Application and Final Conclusion
Since both an axial extension and a twisting of the coil wire occur when a spring is stretched, the strain produced in the spring is both longitudinal and shear.

ধাপ ১: মৌলিক নীতি
পীড়নের প্রভাবে কোনো বস্তুতে যে আপেক্ষিক বিকৃতি সৃষ্টি হয়, তাকে বিকৃতি (Strain) বলে। একটি হেলিক্যাল স্প্রিংকে প্রসারিত করলে তার সামগ্রিক দৈর্ঘ্যের পরিবর্তন এবং কুণ্ডলীর তারে মোচড়—উভয়ই ঘটে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
একটি হেলিক্যাল স্প্রিং-এর মুক্ত প্রান্তে ভার ঝোলানো হলে বলের অভিমুখে স্প্রিংটির সামগ্রিক দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি পায়, যা অনুদৈর্ঘ্য বিকৃতি নির্দেশ করে। একইসাথে, স্প্রিং-এর তারের প্রতিটি প্যাঁচে মোচড় (twisting) সৃষ্টি হয়, যা এক ধরনের কৃন্তন বিকৃতি (shear strain)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ ও চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু স্প্রিং প্রসারিত করার সময় অক্ষ বরাবর দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি এবং তারের মোচড় উভয়ই ঘটে, তাই স্প্রিংটিতে উৎপন্ন বিকৃতি হলো অনুদৈর্ঘ্য এবং কৃন্তন (longitudinal and shear)।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_5 - Ratio of diameters of copper and iron wires

questiontext.text:
A rigid bar of mass \(M\) is supported symmetrically by three wires each of length \(l\). Those at each end are of copper and the middle one is of iron. The ratio of their diameters, if each is to have the same tension, is equal to

\(M\) ভরের একটি দৃঢ় দণ্ডকে \(l\) দৈর্ঘ্যের তিনটি তার দ্বারা প্রতিসমভাবে ঝোলানো হয়েছে। দুই প্রান্তের তার দুটি তামার এবং মাঝের তারটি লোহার। প্রতিটি তারে টান সমান হলে, তাদের ব্যাসের অনুপাত কত হবে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of the rigid bar \(= M\); length of each wire \(= l\); outer wires are made of copper (Young's modulus \(Y_{\text{copper}}\)) and the middle wire is made of iron (Young's modulus \(Y_{\text{iron}}\)). Each wire experiences the same tension \(T\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Because the bar is rigid and supported symmetrically, all three wires remain vertical and undergo the exact same elongation \(\Delta l\), and hence the same longitudinal strain \(\Delta l / l\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Young's modulus is given by \(Y = \frac{\text{Stress}}{\text{Strain}} = \frac{T / A}{\Delta l / l}\), where \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\) is the cross-sectional area of a wire of diameter \(d\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Rearranging the Young's modulus formula for area \(A\):
\(A = \frac{T l}{Y \Delta l}\)
Since \(T\), \(l\), and \(\Delta l\) are identical for both the copper and iron wires:
\(A \propto \frac{1}{Y}\)
Substituting \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\):
\(\frac{\pi d^2}{4} \propto \frac{1}{Y} \implies d^2 \propto \frac{1}{Y} \implies d \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{Y}}\)
Taking the ratio of the diameter of the copper wire to that of the iron wire:
\(\frac{d_{\text{copper}}}{d_{\text{iron}}} = \sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The ratio is dimensionless as expected for a ratio of two diameters, and the wire with the smaller Young's modulus requires a larger diameter to sustain the same tension at the same strain. Thus, the ratio of their diameters is \(\sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
দৃঢ় দণ্ডের ভর \(= M\); প্রতিটি তারের দৈর্ঘ্য \(= l\); দুই প্রান্তের তার দুটি তামার (ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক \(Y_{\text{copper}}\)) এবং মাঝের তারটি লোহার (ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক \(Y_{\text{iron}}\))। প্রতিটি তারে টান \(T\) সমান।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন-প্রথা
যেহেতু দণ্ডটি দৃঢ় এবং প্রতিসমভাবে ঝোলানো আছে, তাই তিনটি তারই উল্লম্ব থাকে এবং তাদের প্রত্যেকের দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি \(\Delta l\) সমান হয়, অর্থাৎ অনুদৈর্ঘ্য বিকৃতি \(\Delta l / l\) সমান।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক, \(Y = \frac{\text{Stress}}{\text{Strain}} = \frac{T / A}{\Delta l / l}\), যেখানে \(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\) হলো \(d\) ব্যাসবিশিষ্ট তারের প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
ক্ষেত্রফল \(A\)-এর জন্য সূত্রটি সাজিয়ে পাই:
\(A = \frac{T l}{Y \Delta l}\)
যেহেতু তামা ও লোহা উভয় তারের জন্যই \(T\), \(l\), এবং \(\Delta l\) অভিন্ন:
\(A \propto \frac{1}{Y}\)
\(A = \frac{\pi d^2}{4}\) বসিয়ে পাই:
\(\frac{\pi d^2}{4} \propto \frac{1}{Y} \implies d^2 \propto \frac{1}{Y} \implies d \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{Y}}\)
তামা ও লোহার তারের ব্যাসের অনুপাত নিয়ে পাই:
\(\frac{d_{\text{copper}}}{d_{\text{iron}}} = \sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\)

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
দুটি ব্যাসের অনুপাত মাত্রাহীন, এবং সমান বিকৃতিতে সমান টান বজায় রাখতে কম ইয়ং গুণাঙ্কযুক্ত তারের ব্যাস বেশি হওয়া প্রয়োজন। সুতরাং, তাদের ব্যাসের অনুপাত হলো \(\sqrt{\frac{Y_{\text{iron}}}{Y_{\text{copper}}}}\)।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_6 - Strain in horizontally stretched mild steel wire

questiontext.text:
A mild steel wire of length \(2L\) and cross-sectional area \(A\) is stretched, well within elastic limit, horizontally between two pillars (Fig. 9.1). A mass \(m\) is suspended from the mid point of the wire. Strain in the wire is

\(2L\) দৈর্ঘ্য এবং \(A\) প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল বিশিষ্ট একটি মৃদু ইস্পাতের তারকে স্থিতিস্থাপক সীমার মধ্যে রেখে দুটি স্তম্ভের মাঝে অনুভূমিকভাবে টানটান করে বাঁধা হয়েছে (চিত্র ৯.১)। তারটির মধ্যবিন্দু থেকে \(m\) ভর ঝোলানো হলো। তারটিতে সৃষ্ট বিকৃতি হলো

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Original unstretched horizontal length of the wire between the two pillars \(= 2L\), cross-sectional area \(= A\). A mass \(m\) is suspended at the midpoint, depressing it vertically downward by a small distance \(x\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Since the wire is stretched well within the elastic limit, the vertical deflection \(x\) is very small compared to the half-length \(L\) (\(x \ll L\)). The wire forms two symmetric straight segments meeting at the depressed midpoint.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Longitudinal strain is defined as \(\text{Strain} = \frac{\Delta l}{l_0}\), where \(\Delta l\) is the increase in length and \(l_0 = 2L\) is the original length. For small \(u \ll 1\), the binomial approximation gives \((1 + u)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \frac{u}{2}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Each half of the wire originally has length \(L\). After the midpoint is depressed by \(x\), each half forms the hypotenuse of a right triangle with sides \(L\) and \(x\).
New length of each half \(= \sqrt{L^2 + x^2} = L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{L^2}\right)^{1/2}\).
Using the binomial approximation for \(x \ll L\):
\(\sqrt{L^2 + x^2} \approx L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\right) = L + \frac{x^2}{2L}\)
Total new length of the wire:
\(l = 2 \left(L + \frac{x^2}{2L}\right) = 2L + \frac{x^2}{L}\)
Increase in length:
\(\Delta l = l - 2L = \frac{x^2}{L}\)
Therefore, the strain in the wire is:
\(= \frac{\Delta l}{2L} = \frac{x^2 / L}{2L} = \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both \(x\) and \(L\) have dimensions of length, so \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\) is dimensionless as required for strain, and it vanishes when \(x = 0\). Thus, the strain in the wire is \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
দুটি স্তম্ভের মাঝে অনুভূমিকভাবে বাঁধা তারের প্রাথমিক দৈর্ঘ্য \(= 2L\), প্রস্থচ্ছেদের ক্ষেত্রফল \(= A\)। মধ্যবিন্দুতে \(m\) ভর ঝোলানোর ফলে মধ্যবিন্দুটি উল্লম্বভাবে নিচে \(x\) দূরত্ব নেমে যায়।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন-প্রথা
যেহেতু তারটি স্থিতিস্থাপক সীমার মধ্যেই প্রসারিত হয়েছে, তাই উল্লম্ব সরণ \(x\) অর্ধ-দৈর্ঘ্য \(L\)-এর তুলনায় খুবই ক্ষুদ্র (\(x \ll L\))। তারটি অবনত মধ্যবিন্দুতে মিলিত দুটি প্রতিসম সরল অংশ গঠন করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
অনুদৈর্ঘ্য বিকৃতি হলো \(\text{Strain} = \frac{\Delta l}{l_0}\), যেখানে \(\Delta l\) হলো দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি এবং \(l_0 = 2L\) হলো প্রাথমিক দৈর্ঘ্য। ক্ষুদ্র \(u \ll 1\)-এর জন্য দ্বিপদ আসন্নীকরণ অনুযায়ী \((1 + u)^{1/2} \approx 1 + \frac{u}{2}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
তারের প্রতিটি অর্ধাংশের প্রাথমিক দৈর্ঘ্য \(L\)। মধ্যবিন্দু \(x\) পরিমাণ নিচে নামার পর প্রতিটি অর্ধাংশ \(L\) এবং \(x\) বাহুবিশিষ্ট একটি সমকোণী ত্রিভুজের অতিভুজ গঠন করে।
প্রতিটি অর্ধাংশের নতুন দৈর্ঘ্য \(= \sqrt{L^2 + x^2} = L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{L^2}\right)^{1/2}\)।
\(x \ll L\) ধরে দ্বিপদ আসন্নীকরণ ব্যবহার করে পাই:
\(\sqrt{L^2 + x^2} \approx L \left(1 + \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\right) = L + \frac{x^2}{2L}\)
তারের মোট নতুন দৈর্ঘ্য:
\(l = 2 \left(L + \frac{x^2}{2L}\right) = 2L + \frac{x^2}{L}\)
দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি:
\(\Delta l = l - 2L = \frac{x^2}{L}\)
সুতরাং, তারটিতে সৃষ্ট বিকৃতি:
\(= \frac{\Delta l}{2L} = \frac{x^2 / L}{2L} = \frac{x^2}{2L^2}\)

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(x\) এবং \(L\) উভয়েরই মাত্রা দৈর্ঘ্যের, তাই বিকৃতির জন্য প্রয়োজনীয় মাত্রাহীন রাশি \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\) পাওয়া যায় এবং \(x = 0\) হলে এটি শূন্য হয়। সুতরাং, তারটিতে সৃষ্ট বিকৃতি হলো \(\frac{x^2}{2L^2}\)।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_7 - Tension in strings suspending rectangular frame

questiontext.text:
A rectangular frame is to be suspended symmetrically by two strings of equal length on two supports (Fig. 9.2). It can be done in one of the following three ways;

The tension in the strings will be

একটি আয়তাকার ফ্রেমকে সমান দৈর্ঘ্যের দুটি সুতার সাহায্যে দুটি অবলম্বন থেকে প্রতিসমভাবে ঝোলাতে হবে (চিত্র ৯.২)। এটি নিচের তিনটি উপায়ের যেকোনো একটিতে করা যেতে পারে;

সুতাগুলোতে টান হবে

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A rectangular frame of mass \(M\) (weight \(Mg\)) is suspended symmetrically by two strings of equal length in three different configurations: strings diverging outward, strings hanging vertically, and strings converging inward.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The frame is in static equilibrium. By symmetry, both strings carry equal tension \(T\), and each makes an angle \(\theta\) with the vertical.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Resolving the tension \(T\) of each string into vertical and horizontal components, the horizontal components \(T \sin\theta\) cancel each other, while the vertical components balance the weight:
\(2T \cos\theta = Mg \implies T = \frac{Mg}{2\cos\theta}\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(Mg\) is constant, the tension \(T\) is inversely proportional to \(\cos\theta\).
For the configuration where both strings hang vertically, the angle with the vertical is \(\theta = 0^\circ\), so \(\cos\theta = \cos 0^\circ = 1\), which is the maximum possible value of \(\cos\theta\).
Hence, \(T = \frac{Mg}{2}\) is the minimum possible tension.
In the configurations where the strings are inclined outward or inward, \(\theta > 0^\circ\), so \(\cos\theta < 1\), resulting in \(T > \frac{Mg}{2}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
As \(\theta\) increases from \(0^\circ\), \(\cos\theta\) decreases and \(T\) increases. Therefore, the tension in the strings is least in the configuration where the strings are vertical.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
\(M\) ভরের (ওজন \(Mg\)) একটি আয়তাকার ফ্রেমকে সমান দৈর্ঘ্যের দুটি সুতার সাহায্যে তিনটি ভিন্ন বিন্যাসে প্রতিসমভাবে ঝোলানো হয়েছে: সুতা দুটি বাইরের দিকে প্রসারিত, সুতা দুটি উল্লম্ব এবং সুতা দুটি ভেতরের দিকে হেলানো।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন-প্রথা
ফ্রেমটি স্থির সাম্যাবস্থায় রয়েছে। প্রতিসাম্যের কারণে উভয় সুতায় টান \(T\) সমান এবং প্রতিটি সুতা উল্লম্বের সাথে \(\theta\) কোণ উৎপন্ন করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
প্রতিটি সুতার টান \(T\)-কে উল্লম্ব ও অনুভূমিক উপাংশে বিভাজিত করলে, অনুভূমিক উপাংশ \(T \sin\theta\) পরস্পরকে প্রশমিত করে এবং উল্লম্ব উপাংশগুলো ওজনকে প্রশমিত করে:
\(2T \cos\theta = Mg \implies T = \frac{Mg}{2\cos\theta}\)

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু \(Mg\) ধ্রুবক, তাই টান \(T\) হলো \(\cos\theta\)-এর ব্যস্তানুপাতিক।
যে বিন্যাসে সুতা দুটি উল্লম্বভাবে ঝোলে, সেখানে উল্লম্বের সাথে কোণ \(\theta = 0^\circ\), ফলে \(\cos\theta = \cos 0^\circ = 1\), যা \(\cos\theta\)-এর সর্বোচ্চ মান।
সুতরাং, এক্ষেত্রে \(T = \frac{Mg}{2}\) হলো সর্বনিম্ন সম্ভাব্য টান।
সুতা দুটি বাইরের দিকে বা ভেতরের দিকে হেলানো থাকলে \(\theta > 0^\circ\) হয়, ফলে \(\cos\theta < 1\) এবং \(T > \frac{Mg}{2}\) হয়।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
\(\theta\) শূন্য ডিগ্রি থেকে বাড়লে \(\cos\theta\) কমে এবং \(T\) বাড়ে। সুতরাং, যে বিন্যাসে সুতা দুটি উল্লম্বভাবে থাকে, সেই বিন্যাসে সুতাগুলোতে টান সর্বনিম্ন হবে।

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQI_Q9_8 - Elongation and shape change of rubber vs steel rod

questiontext.text:
Consider two cylindrical rods of identical dimensions, one of rubber and the other of steel. Both the rods are fixed rigidly at one end to the roof. A mass \(M\) is attached to each of the free ends at the centre of the rods.

অভিন্ন মাত্রার দুটি চোঙাকৃতি দণ্ড বিবেচনা করো, যার একটি রাবারের এবং অন্যটি ইস্পাতের। উভয় দণ্ডের এক প্রান্ত ছাদের সাথে দৃঢ়ভাবে আটকানো আছে। দণ্ড দুটির মুক্ত প্রান্তের কেন্দ্রে একটি করে \(M\) ভর যুক্ত করা হলো।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a load is attached at the centre of the free circular end of a cylindrical rod, the deformation depends on the Young's modulus \(Y\) of the material and the local distribution of stress across the end face.

Step 2: Evaluation
Steel has a very high Young's modulus (\(Y_{\text{steel}} \approx 2 \times 10^{11}\text{ N m}^{-2}\)), so for a given mass \(M\), its elongation is extremely small and its high stiffness prevents any perceptible distortion of the bottom circular face. In contrast, rubber has a very small Young's modulus (\(Y_{\text{rubber}} \sim 10^6\text{ to }10^7\text{ N m}^{-2}\)), making it highly deformable.

Step 3: Application and Final Conclusion
Because the mass \(M\) is attached specifically at the centre of the bottom face, the central region of the rubber rod stretches significantly more than the outer perimeter. Consequently, the steel rod elongates without any perceptible change in shape, whereas the rubber rod elongates with its bottom edge tapered to a tip at the centre.

ধাপ ১: মৌলিক নীতি
কোনো চোঙাকৃতি দণ্ডের মুক্ত বৃত্তাকার প্রান্তের কেন্দ্রে ভার যুক্ত করলে তার বিকৃতি পদার্থের ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক \(Y\) এবং প্রান্ততলে পীড়নের স্থানীয় বণ্টনের ওপর নির্ভর করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
ইস্পাতের ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক অত্যন্ত বেশি (\(Y_{\text{steel}} \approx 2 \times 10^{11}\text{ N m}^{-2}\)), তাই নির্দিষ্ট ভর \(M\)-এর জন্য এর দৈর্ঘ্য বৃদ্ধি খুবই সামান্য হয় এবং এর উচ্চ দৃঢ়তার কারণে নিচের বৃত্তাকার তলের আকৃতির কোনো লক্ষণীয় পরিবর্তন ঘটে না। পক্ষান্তরে, রাবারের ইয়ং গুণাঙ্ক খুবই কম (\(Y_{\text{rubber}} \sim 10^6\text{ থেকে }10^7\text{ N m}^{-2}\)), ফলে এটি সহজেই বিকৃত হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রয়োগ ও চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
যেহেতু ভর \(M\) নিচের তলের কেন্দ্রে যুক্ত করা হয়েছে, তাই রাবার দণ্ডের কেন্দ্রীয় অংশ বাইরের পরিধির তুলনায় অনেক বেশি প্রসারিত হয়। ফলে, ইস্পাতের দণ্ডটি আকৃতির কোনো লক্ষণীয় পরিবর্তন ছাড়াই প্রসারিত হবে, কিন্তু রাবারের দণ্ডটি প্রসারিত হওয়ার সাথে সাথে তার নিচের প্রান্তটি কেন্দ্রের দিকে সরু হয়ে একটি সূচালো অগ্রভাগের মতো আকার ধারণ করবে।

answer.text: Both the rods will elongate but there shall be no perceptible change in shape.
The steel rod will elongate and change shape but the rubber rod will only elongate.
The steel rod will elongate without any perceptible change in shape, but the rubber rod will elongate and the shape of the bottom edge will change to an ellipse.
The steel rod will elongate, without any perceptible change in shape, but the rubber rod will elongate with the shape of the bottom edge tapered to a tip at the centre.

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQII_Q9_9 - Stress strain graphs for two materials

questiontext.text:
The stress-strain graphs for two materials are shown in Fig. 9.3 (assume same scale).

দুটি পদার্থের জন্য পীড়ন-বিকৃতি লেখচিত্র চিত্র ৯.৩-এ দেখানো হয়েছে (একই স্কেল ধরে নাও)।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Two stress-strain graphs plotted to the same scale are provided for Material (i) and Material (ii), showing the linear limit, ultimate tension strength, and fracture point for each.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
On a stress-strain curve, the linear region up to the linear limit represents elastic behaviour, while the distance along the strain axis between the ultimate tension strength and the fracture point indicates ductility versus brittleness.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
A material that obeys Hooke's law over a wider range of strain has a larger elastic region. A material whose fracture point lies very close to its ultimate tension strength (minimal plastic deformation before breaking) is more brittle.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
1. Comparing the linear limits along the horizontal strain axis, Material (ii) exhibits a linear stress-strain relationship up to a much larger strain value than Material (i). Thus, Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain compared to Material (i).
2. Comparing the region between the ultimate tension strength and the fracture point, the fracture point for Material (ii) is much closer to its ultimate tension strength than for Material (i). This indicates a smaller plastic region before fracture, meaning Material (ii) is more brittle than Material (i).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both conclusions follow directly from the relative positions of the linear limit, ultimate tension strength, and fracture point on the same-scale graphs. Therefore, Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain as compared to Material (i), and Material (ii) is more brittle than Material (i).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্ত
একই স্কেলে অঙ্কিত দুটি পদার্থ Material (i) এবং Material (ii)-এর পীড়ন-বিকৃতি লেখচিত্র দেওয়া আছে, যেখানে প্রতিটির রৈখিক সীমা (Linear limit), চরম টান সহনশীলতা (Ultimate Tension Strength) এবং ভঙ্গুর বিন্দু (Fracture Point) চিহ্নিত রয়েছে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন-প্রথা
পীড়ন-বিকৃতি লেখচিত্রে রৈখিক সীমা পর্যন্ত সরলরৈখিক অংশটি স্থিতিস্থাপক আচরণ নির্দেশ করে এবং চরম টান সহনশীলতা ও ভঙ্গুর বিন্দুর মধ্যবর্তী বিকৃতি অক্ষের ব্যবধান পদার্থের নমনীয়তা বনাম ভঙ্গুরতা নির্দেশ করে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
যে পদার্থ বিকৃতির বৃহত্তর পরিসর জুড়ে হুকের সূত্র মেনে চলে, তার স্থিতিস্থাপক অঞ্চল তত বড় হয়। যে পদার্থের ভঙ্গুর বিন্দু তার চরম টান সহনশীলতার খুব কাছাকাছি থাকে (অর্থাৎ ভেঙে যাওয়ার আগে প্লাস্টিক বিকৃতি খুব কম হয়), সেটি তত বেশি ভঙ্গুর হয়।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
১. অনুভূমিক বিকৃতি অক্ষ বরাবর রৈখিক সীমা তুলনা করলে দেখা যায়, Material (i)-এর তুলনায় Material (ii)-তে অনেক বেশি বিকৃতি পর্যন্ত রৈখিক পীড়ন-বিকৃতি সম্পর্ক বজায় থাকে। অর্থাৎ, Material (i)-এর তুলনায় Material (ii) বিকৃতির একটি বৃহত্তর অঞ্চল জুড়ে স্থিতিস্থাপক।
২. চরম টান সহনশীলতা এবং ভঙ্গুর বিন্দুর মধ্যবর্তী অঞ্চল তুলনা করলে দেখা যায়, Material (i)-এর তুলনায় Material (ii)-এর ভঙ্গুর বিন্দু চরম টান সহনশীলতার অনেক বেশি কাছে অবস্থিত। এটি ভেঙে যাওয়ার আগে ক্ষুদ্রতর প্লাস্টিক অঞ্চল নির্দেশ করে, অর্থাৎ Material (i)-এর তুলনায় Material (ii) বেশি ভঙ্গুর।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
উভয় সিদ্ধান্তই একই স্কেলে অঙ্কিত লেখচিত্রগুলোর রৈখিক সীমা, চরম টান সহনশীলতা এবং ভঙ্গুর বিন্দুর আপেক্ষিক অবস্থান থেকে সরাসরি পাওয়া যায়। সুতরাং, Material (ii) বিকৃতির বৃহত্তর অঞ্চল জুড়ে স্থিতিস্থাপক এবং Material (i)-এর তুলনায় বেশি ভঙ্গুর।

answer.text: Material (ii) is more elastic than material (i) and hence material (ii) is more brittle.
Material (i) and (ii) have the same elasticity and the same brittleness.
Material (ii) is elastic over a larger region of strain as compared to (i).

name.text: PHYSICS_MECHANICALPROPERTIESOFSOLIDS_MCQII_Q9_10 - Tensile stress and tension in suspended wire

questiontext.text:
A wire is suspended from the ceiling and stretched under the action of a weight \(F\) suspended from its other end. The force exerted by the ceiling on it is equal and opposite to the weight.

একটি তারকে ছাদ থেকে ঝোলানো হয়েছে এবং এর অপর প্রান্তে \(F\) ওজন ঝুলিয়ে সেটিকে প্রসারিত করা হয়েছে। ছাদ তারটির ওপর ওজনের সমান ও বিপরীতমুখী বল প্রয়োগ করে।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
A wire of cross-sectional area \(A\) is suspended vertically from a ceiling and pulled downward at its lower end by a weight \(F\). The ceiling exerts an equal and opposite upward force \(F\) at the upper end.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The mass of the wire itself is neglected compared to the suspended weight \(F\), and the wire is in static equilibrium.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For any cross section of a light wire in equilibrium under equal and opposite axial forces \(F\), the internal restoring force (tension) at that cross section is \(T = F\).
Tensile stress is defined as \(\sigma = \frac{\text{Internal restoring force}}{\text{Cross-sectional area}} = \frac{T}{A}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Considering a free-body diagram of the lower portion of the wire below any arbitrary cross section of area \(A\), the downward weight \(F\) must be balanced by the upward tension \(T\) acting across that cross section. Thus, \(T = F\).
