4. Heat is lost via conduction (to the table and glass), convection (rising warm air above the milk), and radiation.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Therefore, the temperature falls off exponentially with time, there is two-way heat flow with net heat loss from milk to surroundings, and all three modes—conduction, convection, and radiation—are responsible for the heat loss.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
নিউটনের শীতলীকরণ সূত্র অনুযায়ী, কোনো বস্তুর শীতল হওয়ার হার বস্তু এবং তার পারিপার্শ্বিকের তাপমাত্রার পার্থক্যের সমানুপাতিক: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_s)\), যার সমাধান হলো \(T(t) = T_s + (T_0 - T_s)e^{-kt}\)। প্রিভস্টের তাপ বিনিময় তত্ত্ব অনুযায়ী, প্রতিটি বস্তু একই সাথে তাপীয় বিকিরণ নিঃসরণ ও শোষণ করে।

ধাপ ২: মূল্যায়ন
১. যেহেতু শীতল হওয়ার হার তাৎক্ষণিক তাপমাত্রার পার্থক্য \((T - T_s)\)-এর ওপর নির্ভর করে, তাই এটি সময়ের সাথে হ্রাস পায় এবং ধ্রুব থাকে না।
২. \(T(t) = T_s + (T_0 - T_s)e^{-kt}\) সমীকরণ অনুযায়ী, দুধের তাপমাত্রা সময়ের সাথে সূচকীয়ভাবে (exponentially) হ্রাস পায়।
৩. দুধ এবং পারিপার্শ্বিকের মধ্যে উভয় দিকেই তাপের প্রবাহ ঘটে, তবে নিট তাপ প্রবাহ গরম দুধ থেকে শীতল পারিপার্শ্বিকের দিকে হয়।
৪. পরিবহন (টেবিল ও গ্লাসের মাধ্যমে), পরিচলন (দুধের ওপরের উষ্ণ বায়ুপ্রবাহ) এবং বিকিরণ—এই তিনটি প্রক্রিয়াতেই তাপ ক্ষয় হয়।

ধাপ ৩: চূড়ান্ত সিদ্ধান্ত
সুতরাং, তাপমাত্রা সময়ের সাথে সূচকীয়ভাবে কমে, উভয় দিকে তাপ প্রবাহ থাকলেও নিট প্রবাহ দুধ থেকে পারিপার্শ্বিকের দিকে হয়, এবং পরিবহন, পরিচলন ও বিকিরণ তিনটি প্রক্রিয়াই তাপ ক্ষয়ের জন্য দায়ী।

answer.text: The rate of cooling is constant till milk attains the temperature of the surrounding.
The temperature of milk falls off exponentially with time.
While cooling, there is a flow of heat from milk to the surrounding as well as from surrounding to the milk but the net flow of heat is from milk to the surrounding and that is why it cools.
All three phenomenon, conduction, convection and radiation are responsible for the loss of heat from milk to the surroundings.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q111 - Bending of heated aluminium steel bimetallic strip

questiontext.text:
A bimetallic strip is made of aluminium and steel (\(\alpha_{Al} > \alpha_{steel}\)). On heating, the strip will

एक द्विधात्विक पट्टी ऐलुमिनियम और इस्पात से बनी है (\(\alpha_{Al} > \alpha_{steel}\))। गर्म करने पर यह पट्टी

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a solid rod of length \(L_0\) is heated by a temperature \(\Delta T\), its increase in length is given by \(\Delta L = L_0 \alpha \Delta T\), where \(\alpha\) is the coefficient of linear expansion.

Step 2: Evaluation
In a bimetallic strip, the two metal strips are riveted or welded together so they must bend together when heated if their expansions differ. Since \(\alpha_{Al} > \alpha_{steel}\), for the same initial length and the same rise in temperature, aluminium expands more than steel.

Step 3: Application
In a curved arc, the outer (convex) side has a larger arc length (larger radius of curvature) than the inner (concave) side. Therefore, the metal that expands more (aluminium) lies on the convex side, and the metal that expands less (steel) lies on the concave side.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
On heating, the bimetallic strip will bend with steel on the concave side.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
जब \(L_0\) लंबाई की किसी ठोस छड़ को \(\Delta T\) तापमान से गर्म किया जाता है, तो उसकी लंबाई में वृद्धि \(\Delta L = L_0 \alpha \Delta T\) होती है, जहाँ \(\alpha\) रैखिक प्रसार गुणांक है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
द्विधात्विक पट्टी में दोनों धातु की पट्टियाँ आपस में जुड़ी होती हैं, इसलिए यदि उनके प्रसार भिन्न हों तो गर्म करने पर उन्हें एक साथ मुड़ना पड़ता है। चूँकि \(\alpha_{Al} > \alpha_{steel}\) है, इसलिए समान प्रारंभिक लंबाई और समान ताप वृद्धि के लिए ऐलुमिनियम, इस्पात की तुलना में अधिक फैलता है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
किसी वक्र चाप में बाहरी (उत्तल) भाग की चाप लंबाई (वक्रता त्रिज्या) आंतरिक (अवतल) भाग से अधिक होती है। अतः अधिक फैलने वाली धातु (ऐलुमिनियम) उत्तल भाग की ओर तथा कम फैलने वाली धातु (इस्पात) अवतल भाग की ओर रहती है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
गर्म करने पर द्विधात्विक पट्टी इस प्रकार मुड़ेगी कि इस्पात अवतल भाग की ओर रहेगा।

answer.text: will bend with aluminium on concave side.
will bend with steel on concave side.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q112 - Angular speed of heated rotating metallic rod

questiontext.text:
A uniform metallic rod rotates about its perpendicular bisector with constant angular speed. If it is heated uniformly to raise its temperature slightly

एकसमान धात्विक छड़ अपने लंब समद्विभाजक के परितः नियत कोणीय चाल से घूर्णन कर रही है। यदि इसे एकसमान रूप से गर्म करके इसका ताप थोड़ा बढ़ा दिया जाए, तो

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
No external torque acts on the rotating metallic rod during uniform heating, so its angular momentum \(L = I\omega\) remains conserved, where \(I\) is the moment of inertia about the axis of rotation and \(\omega\) is the angular speed.

Step 2: Evaluation
For a uniform rod of mass \(M\) and length \(l\) rotating about its perpendicular bisector, the moment of inertia is \(I = \frac{1}{12}Ml^2\). When heated uniformly, the length \(l\) increases due to thermal expansion, which increases the moment of inertia \(I\).

Step 3: Application
Since \(L = I\omega = \text{constant}\), an increase in \(I\) must be accompanied by a decrease in \(\omega\) (\(\omega \propto \frac{1}{I}\)).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Its speed of rotation decreases.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
एकसमान रूप से गर्म करने पर घूर्णन करती हुई धात्विक छड़ पर कोई बाह्य बल-आघूर्ण कार्य नहीं करता है, इसलिए इसका कोणीय संवेग \(L = I\omega\) संरक्षित रहता है, जहाँ \(I\) घूर्णन अक्ष के परितः जड़त्व आघूर्ण और \(\omega\) कोणीय चाल है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
\(M\) द्रव्यमान और \(l\) लंबाई की एकसमान छड़ का अपने लंब समद्विभाजक के परितः जड़त्व आघूर्ण \(I = \frac{1}{12}Ml^2\) होता है। एकसमान रूप से गर्म करने पर तापीय प्रसार के कारण लंबाई \(l\) बढ़ जाती है, जिससे जड़त्व आघूर्ण \(I\) बढ़ जाता है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
चूँकि \(L = I\omega = \text{नियत}\) है, इसलिए \(I\) में वृद्धि होने पर कोणीय चाल \(\omega\) में कमी होनी आवश्यक है (\(\omega \propto \frac{1}{I}\))।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
इसकी घूर्णन की चाल घट जाती है।

answer.text: its speed increases because its moment of inertia increases.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q113 - Conversion relation between two temperature scales A and B

questiontext.text:
The graph between two temperature scales A and B is shown in Fig. 11.1. Between upper fixed point and lower fixed point there are 150 equal division on scale A and 100 on scale B. The relationship for conversion between the two scales is given by

दो ताप पैमानों A तथा B के बीच का ग्राफ चित्र 11.1 में दर्शाया गया है। ऊपरी नियत बिंदु और निचले नियत बिंदु के बीच पैमाने A पर 150 बराबर भाग और पैमाने B पर 100 बराबर भाग हैं। दोनों पैमानों के बीच रूपांतरण का संबंध किसके द्वारा दिया जाता है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
From the given graph, the vertical axis represents temperature \(t_A\) on scale A and the horizontal axis represents temperature \(t_B\) on scale B. The number of divisions between the upper fixed point and lower fixed point on scale A is \(\Delta t_A = 150^\circ\), and on scale B is \(\Delta t_B = 100^\circ\). At \(t_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\), \(t_A = 180^\circ\text{A}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both temperature scales are linear, so the ratio of the reading above the lower fixed point to the total number of divisions between the fixed points is identical for both scales.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For any two linear temperature scales A and B:
\(\frac{t_A - \text{LFP}_A}{\text{UFP}_A - \text{LFP}_A} = \frac{t_B - \text{LFP}_B}{\text{UFP}_B - \text{LFP}_B}\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
From the graph, \(\text{UFP}_A = 180^\circ\text{A}\) and \(\text{UFP}_A - \text{LFP}_A = 150^\circ\text{A}\), so:
\(\text{LFP}_A = 180 - 150 = 30^\circ\text{A}\)
For scale B, \(\text{UFP}_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\) and \(\text{UFP}_B - \text{LFP}_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\), so:
\(\text{LFP}_B = 100 - 100 = 0^\circ\text{B}\)
Substituting these into the conversion formula:
\(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{t_B - 0}{100} = \frac{t_B}{100}\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Checking at \(t_B = 100\): \(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{100}{100} = 1 \implies t_A = 180\), which matches the graph. Thus, the relationship is \(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{t_B}{100}\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
दिए गए ग्राफ में ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पैमाने A पर ताप \(t_A\) तथा क्षैतिज अक्ष पैमाने B पर ताप \(t_B\) को दर्शाता है। ऊपरी नियत बिंदु और निचले नियत बिंदु के बीच पैमाने A पर भागों की संख्या \(\Delta t_A = 150^\circ\) तथा पैमाने B पर \(\Delta t_B = 100^\circ\) है। \(t_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\) पर \(t_A = 180^\circ\text{A}\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
दोनों ताप पैमाने रैखिक हैं, अतः निचले नियत बिंदु से ऊपर के पाठ्यांक और दोनों नियत बिंदुओं के बीच कुल भागों की संख्या का अनुपात दोनों पैमानों के लिए समान होता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
किन्हीं दो रैखिक ताप पैमानों A तथा B के लिए:
\(\frac{t_A - \text{LFP}_A}{\text{UFP}_A - \text{LFP}_A} = \frac{t_B - \text{LFP}_B}{\text{UFP}_B - \text{LFP}_B}\)

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
ग्राफ से, \(\text{UFP}_A = 180^\circ\text{A}\) और \(\text{UFP}_A - \text{LFP}_A = 150^\circ\text{A}\), अतः:
\(\text{LFP}_A = 180 - 150 = 30^\circ\text{A}\)
पैमाने B के लिए, \(\text{UFP}_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\) और \(\text{UFP}_B - \text{LFP}_B = 100^\circ\text{B}\), अतः:
\(\text{LFP}_B = 100 - 100 = 0^\circ\text{B}\)
इन्हें रूपांतरण सूत्र में रखने पर:
\(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{t_B - 0}{100} = \frac{t_B}{100}\)

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(t_B = 100\) रखने पर: \(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{100}{100} = 1 \implies t_A = 180\), जो ग्राफ से मेल खाता है। अतः सही संबंध \(\frac{t_A - 30}{150} = \frac{t_B}{100}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q114 - Buoyancy on aluminium sphere in water at 0 and 4 degree Celsius

questiontext.text:
An aluminium sphere is dipped into water. Which of the following is true?

एक ऐलुमिनियम का गोला जल में डुबोया जाता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन सत्य है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The buoyant force (upthrust) acting on a completely submerged sphere of volume \(V\) in a liquid of density \(\rho\) is \(F_B = V\rho g\).

Step 2: Evaluation
Water exhibits anomalous expansion between \(0^\circ\text{C}\) and \(4^\circ\text{C}\): its density increases from \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to a maximum at \(4^\circ\text{C}\) (\(\rho_{0^\circ\text{C}} < \rho_{4^\circ\text{C}}\)). Meanwhile, the volume of the aluminium sphere increases slightly from \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to \(4^\circ\text{C}\), though this solid expansion is much smaller than the density change of water, and both effects act to make \(V\rho\) larger at \(4^\circ\text{C}\) than at \(0^\circ\text{C}\).

Step 3: Application
Since \(\rho_{0^\circ\text{C}} < \rho_{4^\circ\text{C}}\) and \(V_{0^\circ\text{C}} < V_{4^\circ\text{C}}\), the buoyant force \(F_B = V\rho g\) is smaller at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) than at \(4^\circ\text{C}\).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Buoyancy will be less in water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) than that in water at \(4^\circ\text{C}\).

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
\(\rho\) घनत्व वाले द्रव में पूर्णतः डूबे \(V\) आयतन के गोले पर लगने वाला उत्प्लावन बल \(F_B = V\rho g\) होता है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
जल \(0^\circ\text{C}\) से \(4^\circ\text{C}\) के बीच असंगत प्रसार प्रदर्शित करता है: इसका घनत्व \(0^\circ\text{C}\) से बढ़कर \(4^\circ\text{C}\) पर अधिकतम हो जाता है (\(\rho_{0^\circ\text{C}} < \rho_{4^\circ\text{C}}\))। साथ ही, \(0^\circ\text{C}\) से \(4^\circ\text{C}\) तक ऐलुमिनियम के गोले का आयतन भी थोड़ा बढ़ता है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
चूँकि \(\rho_{0^\circ\text{C}} < \rho_{4^\circ\text{C}}\) तथा \(V_{0^\circ\text{C}} < V_{4^\circ\text{C}}\) है, इसलिए उत्प्लावन बल \(F_B = V\rho g\) का मान \(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर \(4^\circ\text{C}\) की तुलना में कम होता है।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
\(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर जल में उत्प्लावन \(4^\circ\text{C}\) पर जल में उत्प्लावन की तुलना में कम होगा।

answer.text: Buoyancy will be less in water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) than that in water at \(4^\circ\text{C}\).
Buoyancy will be more in water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) than that in water at \(4^\circ\text{C}\).
Buoyancy in water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) will be same as that in water at \(4^\circ\text{C}\).
Buoyancy may be more or less in water at \(4^\circ\text{C}\) depending on the radius of the sphere.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q115 - Effect of temperature rise on time period of pendulum

questiontext.text:
As the temperature is increased, the time period of a pendulum

जैसे-जैसे ताप बढ़ाया जाता है, किसी लोलक का आवर्तकाल

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The time period of a simple pendulum of effective length \(l\) is given by \(T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}\), where \(l\) is the distance from the point of suspension to the centre of mass of the bob.

Step 2: Evaluation
When the temperature increases, the suspending wire/rod expands linearly, so the effective length \(l\) increases. If the bob is a uniform solid sphere, it expands uniformly in all directions, so its centre of mass continues to remain at the geometric centre of the bob.

Step 3: Application
Since \(T \propto \sqrt{l}\), an increase in the effective length \(l\) causes the time period \(T\) to increase, even though the centre of mass remains at the centre of the bob.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The time period of the pendulum increases as its effective length increases even though its centre of mass still remains at the centre of the bob.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
\(l\) प्रभावी लंबाई वाले सरल लोलक का आवर्तकाल \(T = 2\pi\sqrt{\frac{l}{g}}\) होता है, जहाँ \(l\) निलंबन बिंदु से गोलक के द्रव्यमान केंद्र तक की दूरी है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
ताप बढ़ने पर निलंबन तार या छड़ का रैखिक प्रसार होता है, जिससे प्रभावी लंबाई \(l\) बढ़ जाती है। यदि गोलक एकसमान ठोस गोला है, तो वह सभी दिशाओं में एकसमान रूप से फैलता है, अतः उसका द्रव्यमान केंद्र अब भी गोलक के केंद्र पर ही बना रहता है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
चूँकि \(T \propto \sqrt{l}\) है, इसलिए प्रभावी लंबाई \(l\) बढ़ने से आवर्तकाल \(T\) बढ़ जाता है, भले ही द्रव्यमान केंद्र गोलक के केंद्र पर ही स्थित रहे।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
लोलक का आवर्तकाल बढ़ता है क्योंकि इसकी प्रभावी लंबाई बढ़ जाती है, यद्यपि इसका द्रव्यमान केंद्र अब भी गोलक के केंद्र पर ही रहता है।

answer.text: increases as its effective length increases even though its centre of mass still remains at the centre of the bob.
decreases as its effective length increases even though its centre of mass still remains at the centre of the bob.
increases as its effective length increases due to shifting of centre of mass below the centre of the bob.
decreases as its effective length remains same but the centre of mass shifts above the centre of the bob.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q116 - Molecular kinetic energy associated with heat

questiontext.text:
Heat is associated with

ऊष्मा का संबंध है

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
Thermal energy (and heat transfer resulting from temperature differences) arises from the disordered, random thermal agitation of the constituent molecules of a substance.

Step 2: Evaluation
Orderly motion of molecules as a whole corresponds to macroscopic mechanical kinetic energy (bulk motion of the object), which does not raise the temperature or constitute heat. In contrast, the random, chaotic motion of molecules determines the internal thermal energy associated with temperature and heat.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
Heat is associated with the kinetic energy of random motion of molecules.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
तापीय ऊर्जा (तथा तापांतर के कारण होने वाला ऊष्मा स्थानांतरण) पदार्थ के घटक अणुओं की अव्यवस्थित, यादृच्छिक तापीय गति से उत्पन्न होती है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
अणुओं की समग्र व्यवस्थित गति स्थूल यांत्रिक गतिज ऊर्जा (वस्तु की समग्र गति) के संगत होती है, जिससे ताप नहीं बढ़ता और न ही यह ऊष्मा का निर्माण करती है। इसके विपरीत, अणुओं की यादृच्छिक गति उस आंतरिक तापीय ऊर्जा को निर्धारित करती है जो ताप और ऊष्मा से संबंधित है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
ऊष्मा अणुओं की यादृच्छिक गति की गतिज ऊर्जा से संबंधित है।

answer.text: kinetic energy of random motion of molecules.
kinetic energy of orderly motion of molecules.
total kinetic energy of random and orderly motion of molecules.
kinetic energy of random motion in some cases and kinetic energy of orderly motion in other.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q117 - Approximate increase in volume of heated metal sphere

questiontext.text:
The radius of a metal sphere at room temperature \(T\) is \(R\), and the coefficient of linear expansion of the metal is \(\alpha\). The sphere is heated a little by a temperature \(\Delta T\) so that its new temperature is \(T + \Delta T\). The increase in the volume of the sphere is approximately

कमरे के ताप \(T\) पर किसी धातु के गोले की त्रिज्या \(R\) है और धातु का रैखिक प्रसार गुणांक \(\alpha\) है। गोले को \(\Delta T\) ताप से थोड़ा गर्म किया जाता है ताकि उसका नया ताप \(T + \Delta T\) हो जाए। गोले के आयतन में वृद्धि लगभग कितनी होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial radius of the metal sphere at temperature \(T\) is \(R\). Coefficient of linear expansion is \(\alpha\). Temperature rise is \(\Delta T\) (small).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The metal is isotropic, so its coefficient of volume expansion \(\gamma\) is related to its coefficient of linear expansion \(\alpha\) by \(\gamma = 3\alpha\). Since \(\Delta T\) is small, higher-order terms in \(\alpha\Delta T\) are negligible.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Volume of a sphere: \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\)
Thermal volume expansion: \(\Delta V = V \gamma \Delta T = V (3\alpha) \Delta T\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\) into the expansion formula:
\(\Delta V = \left(\frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\right) (3\alpha) \Delta T = 4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The dimensions of \(4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\) are \([\text{L}^3] [\text{K}^{-1}] [\text{K}] = [\text{L}^3]\), which matches volume. Thus, the increase in volume is approximately \(4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\).

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
कमरे के ताप \(T\) पर धातु के गोले की प्रारंभिक त्रिज्या \(R\) है। रैखिक प्रसार गुणांक \(\alpha\) है। ताप में अल्प वृद्धि \(\Delta T\) है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
धातु समदैशिक है, अतः इसका आयतन प्रसार गुणांक \(\gamma\) रैखिक प्रसार गुणांक \(\alpha\) से \(\gamma = 3\alpha\) द्वारा संबंधित है। चूँकि \(\Delta T\) अल्प है, इसलिए \(\alpha\Delta T\) के उच्च घात वाले पद नगण्य हैं।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
गोले का आयतन: \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\)
तापीय आयतन प्रसार: \(\Delta V = V \gamma \Delta T = V (3\alpha) \Delta T\)

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
प्रसार सूत्र में \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\) रखने पर:
\(\Delta V = \left(\frac{4}{3}\pi R^3\right) (3\alpha) \Delta T = 4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\)

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
\(4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\) की विमाएँ \([\text{L}^3] [\text{K}^{-1}] [\text{K}] = [\text{L}^3]\) हैं, जो आयतन की विमा के अनुरूप हैं। अतः आयतन में वृद्धि लगभग \(4\pi R^3 \alpha \Delta T\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q118 - Cooling rates of sphere cube and thin circular plate

questiontext.text:
A sphere, a cube and a thin circular plate, all of same material and same mass are initially heated to same high temperature.

समान पदार्थ और समान द्रव्यमान के एक गोले, एक घन तथा एक पतली वृत्ताकार प्लेट को प्रारंभ में समान उच्च ताप तक गर्म किया जाता है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to Newton's law of cooling (and Stefan's law of radiation), the rate of heat loss from a body at a given temperature above the surroundings is directly proportional to its surface area \(A\): \(\frac{dQ}{dt} \propto A\). Since \(\frac{dQ}{dt} = -ms\frac{dT}{dt}\), for objects of the same material (same specific heat \(s\)) and same mass \(m\), the rate of cooling \(-\frac{dT}{dt}\) is directly proportional to the surface area \(A\).

Step 2: Evaluation
For a given volume (since mass and material are the same, volume \(V = \frac{m}{\rho}\) is the same for all three):
1. A sphere has the minimum surface area for a given volume.
2. A thin circular plate has the maximum surface area for a given volume.
3. A cube has an intermediate surface area between that of the sphere and the thin plate.

Step 3: Application
Because \(-\frac{dT}{dt} \propto A\), the thin circular plate (largest surface area) cools the fastest, and the sphere (smallest surface area) cools the slowest.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
The plate will cool fastest and the sphere will cool slowest.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
न्यूटन के शीतलन नियम (तथा स्टीफन के विकिरण नियम) के अनुसार, परिवेश से ऊपर किसी निश्चित ताप पर किसी वस्तु से ऊष्मा हानि की दर उसके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(A\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है: \(\frac{dQ}{dt} \propto A\)। चूँकि \(\frac{dQ}{dt} = -ms\frac{dT}{dt}\) है, इसलिए समान पदार्थ (समान विशिष्ट ऊष्मा \(s\)) और समान द्रव्यमान \(m\) की वस्तुओं के लिए शीतलन की दर \(-\frac{dT}{dt}\) पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(A\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
दिए गए आयतन के लिए (चूँकि द्रव्यमान और पदार्थ समान हैं, इसलिए तीनों का आयतन \(V = \frac{m}{\rho}\) समान है):
1. दिए गए आयतन के लिए गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल न्यूनतम होता है।
2. दिए गए आयतन के लिए पतली वृत्ताकार प्लेट का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल अधिकतम होता है।
3. घन का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल गोले और पतली प्लेट के बीच होता है।

चरण 3: अनुप्रयोग
चूँकि \(-\frac{dT}{dt} \propto A\) है, इसलिए पतली वृत्ताकार प्लेट (अधिकतम पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल) सबसे तेज़ी से ठंडी होगी और गोला (न्यूनतम पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल) सबसे धीरे ठंडा होगा।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
प्लेट सबसे तेज़ तथा गोला सबसे धीरे ठंडा होगा।

answer.text: Plate will cool fastest and cube the slowest
Sphere will cool fastest and cube the slowest
Plate will cool fastest and sphere the slowest
Cube will cool fastest and plate the slowest.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q119 - Zeroth law of thermodynamics and thermal equilibrium

questiontext.text:
Mark the correct options:

सही विकल्पों को चिह्नित कीजिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
According to the Zeroth Law of Thermodynamics, two systems are in thermal equilibrium with each other if and only if they are at the same temperature. Also, if two systems are each in thermal equilibrium with a third system, they are in thermal equilibrium with each other.

Step 2: Evaluation of First Scenario
Suppose system \(X\) is in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) (\(T_X = T_Y\)) but not with \(Z\) (\(T_X eq T_Z\)). It immediately follows that \(T_Y eq T_Z\), so systems \(Y\) and \(Z\) cannot be in thermal equilibrium with each other. Hence, \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not in thermal equilibrium with each other.

Step 3: Evaluation of Second Scenario
Suppose system \(X\) is neither in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) (\(T_X eq T_Y\)) nor with \(Z\) (\(T_X eq T_Z\)). In this case, \(T_Y\) and \(T_Z\) may or may not be equal to each other. Therefore, systems \(Y\) and \(Z\) may be in thermal equilibrium with each other (though they do not have to be).

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Both statements are correct: if \(X\) is in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) but not with \(Z\), then \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not in thermal equilibrium with each other; and if \(X\) is neither in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) nor with \(Z\), then \(Y\) and \(Z\) may be in thermal equilibrium with each other.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
ऊष्मागतिकी के शून्यवाँ नियम के अनुसार, दो निकाय परस्पर तापीय साम्य में तभी होते हैं जब उनके ताप समान हों। साथ ही, यदि दो निकाय किसी तीसरे निकाय के साथ अलग-अलग तापीय साम्य में हैं, तो वे आपस में भी तापीय साम्य में होते हैं।

चरण 2: प्रथम स्थिति का मूल्यांकन
मान लीजिए निकाय \(X\), निकाय \(Y\) के साथ तापीय साम्य में है (\(T_X = T_Y\)), परंतु \(Z\) के साथ नहीं है (\(T_X eq T_Z\))। इससे स्पष्ट है कि \(T_Y eq T_Z\), अतः निकाय \(Y\) और \(Z\) परस्पर तापीय साम्य में नहीं हो सकते।

चरण 3: द्वितीय स्थिति का मूल्यांकन
मान लीजिए निकाय \(X\) न तो \(Y\) के साथ तापीय साम्य में है (\(T_X eq T_Y\)) और न ही \(Z\) के साथ (\(T_X eq T_Z\))। इस स्थिति में \(T_Y\) और \(T_Z\) बराबर हो भी सकते हैं और नहीं भी। अतः निकाय \(Y\) और \(Z\) परस्पर तापीय साम्य में हो सकते हैं (यद्यपि यह आवश्यक नहीं है)।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
ये दोनों कथन सत्य हैं: यदि \(X\), \(Y\) के साथ तापीय साम्य में है परंतु \(Z\) के साथ नहीं, तो \(Y\) और \(Z\) परस्पर तापीय साम्य में नहीं हैं; तथा यदि \(X\) न तो \(Y\) के साथ और न ही \(Z\) के साथ तापीय साम्य में है, तो \(Y\) और \(Z\) परस्पर तापीय साम्य में हो सकते हैं।

answer.text: A system \(X\) is in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) but not with \(Z\). System \(Y\) and \(Z\) may be in thermal equilibrium with each other.
A system \(X\) is in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) but not with \(Z\). Systems \(Y\) and \(Z\) are not in thermal equilibrium with each other.
A system \(X\) is neither in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) nor with \(Z\). The systems \(Y\) and \(Z\) must be in thermal equilibrium with each other.
A system \(X\) is neither in thermal equilibrium with \(Y\) nor with \(Z\). The system \(Y\) and \(Z\) may be in thermal equilibrium with each other.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q1110 - Heating of spherical gulab jamuns and disc pizzas in oven

questiontext.text:
'Gulab Jamuns' (assumed to be spherical) are to be heated in an oven. They are available in two sizes, one twice bigger (in radius) than the other. Pizzas (assumed to be discs) are also to be heated in oven. They are also in two sizes, one twice big (in radius) than the other. All four are put together to be heated to oven temperature. Choose the correct option from the following:

'गुलाब जामुन' (जिन्हें गोलाकार माना गया है) को एक ओवन में गर्म किया जाना है। वे दो आकारों में उपलब्ध हैं, जिनमें एक की त्रिज्या दूसरे से दोगुनी है। पिज़्ज़ा (जिन्हें चकती/डिस्क माना गया है) को भी ओवन में गर्म किया जाना है। वे भी दो आकारों में हैं, जिनमें एक की त्रिज्या दूसरे से दोगुनी है। चारों को एक साथ ओवन के ताप तक गर्म होने के लिए रखा जाता है। निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प चुनिए:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
The rate of heating (temperature rise per unit time) of an object in an oven depends on its surface-area-to-volume ratio \(\frac{A}{V}\) (since heat absorbed per unit time is proportional to surface area \(A\), while the heat capacity is proportional to mass, and hence volume \(V\) for uniform density). Equivalently, heat reaches the interior faster when the characteristic thickness/radius is smaller.

Step 2: Evaluation for Gulab Jamuns (Spheres)
For a sphere of radius \(r\), the surface area is \(A = 4\pi r^2\) and the volume is \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\), so \(\frac{A}{V} = \frac{3}{r}\). The smaller gulab jamun (smaller \(r\)) has a larger surface-area-to-volume ratio and a smaller distance for heat to travel to the centre, so it heats up faster than the bigger one.

Step 3: Evaluation for Pizzas (Discs)
For a disc of radius \(r\) and thickness \(h\), the total surface area is \(A = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi r h\) and the volume is \(V = \pi r^2 h\), so \(\frac{A}{V} = \frac{2}{h} + \frac{2}{r}\). Even for equal thickness \(h\), the smaller-radius pizza has a larger \(\frac{A}{V}\) ratio (and if scaled geometrically, an even larger ratio), so the smaller pizza heats up before the bigger one.

Step 4: Final Conclusion
Both the smaller gulab jamuns are heated before the bigger ones, and the smaller pizzas are heated before the bigger ones.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
ओवन में किसी वस्तु के गर्म होने की दर (प्रति एकांक समय में ताप वृद्धि) उसके पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और आयतन के अनुपात \(\frac{A}{V}\) पर निर्भर करती है (क्योंकि प्रति एकांक समय में अवशोषित ऊष्मा पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(A\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है, जबकि ऊष्मा धारिता द्रव्यमान अर्थात् समान घनत्व के लिए आयतन \(V\) के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है)।

चरण 2: गुलाब जामुन (गोलों) के लिए मूल्यांकन
\(r\) त्रिज्या के गोले का पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(A = 4\pi r^2\) और आयतन \(V = \frac{4}{3}\pi r^3\) होता है, अतः \(\frac{A}{V} = \frac{3}{r}\)। छोटे गुलाब जामुन (कम \(r\)) का \(\frac{A}{V}\) अनुपात अधिक होता है और केंद्र तक ऊष्मा पहुँचने की दूरी कम होती है, इसलिए वह बड़े गुलाब जामुन से पहले गर्म होगा।

चरण 3: पिज़्ज़ा (डिस्क) के लिए मूल्यांकन
\(r\) त्रिज्या और \(h\) मोटाई की डिस्क का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल \(A = 2\pi r^2 + 2\pi r h\) और आयतन \(V = \pi r^2 h\) होता है, अतः \(\frac{A}{V} = \frac{2}{h} + \frac{2}{r}\)। समान मोटाई होने पर भी छोटे पिज़्ज़ा का \(\frac{A}{V}\) अनुपात बड़े पिज़्ज़ा से अधिक होता है, इसलिए छोटा पिज़्ज़ा बड़े पिज़्ज़ा से पहले गर्म होगा।

चरण 4: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
छोटे गुलाब जामुन बड़े गुलाब जामुन से पहले गर्म होते हैं, तथा छोटे पिज़्ज़ा बड़े पिज़्ज़ा से पहले गर्म होते हैं।

answer.text: Both size gulab jamuns will get heated in the same time.
Smaller gulab jamuns are heated before bigger ones.
Smaller pizzas are heated before bigger ones.
Bigger pizzas are heated before smaller ones.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q1111 - Temperature versus time plot for heating of ice

questiontext.text:
Refer to the plot of temperature versus time (Fig. 11.2) showing the changes in the state of ice on heating (not to scale).

Which of the following is correct?

बर्फ को गर्म करने पर उसकी अवस्था में होने वाले परिवर्तनों को दर्शाने वाले ताप बनाम समय के आलेख (चित्र 11.2, पैमाने के अनुसार नहीं) को देखिए।

निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The graph shows temperature (\(^\circ\text{C}\)) on the vertical axis versus time (min) on the horizontal axis for ice being heated continuously: - Region AB is a horizontal line at \(0^\circ\text{C}\) from time \(0\) to \(t_m\). - Region BC is an inclined line rising from \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to \(100^\circ\text{C}\). - Region CD is a horizontal line at \(100^\circ\text{C}\). - Region DE rises above \(100^\circ\text{C}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Heating occurs at normal atmospheric pressure, where the melting point of ice is \(0^\circ\text{C}\) and the boiling point of water is \(100^\circ\text{C}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
During a phase change (melting or boiling) at constant pressure, heat supplied is used as latent heat (\(Q = mL\)) to change the state of the substance without changing its temperature.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
- In region AB (at \(0^\circ\text{C}\)), ice melts into water at constant temperature, so ice and water coexist in thermal equilibrium.
- At point B, all ice has melted into water at \(0^\circ\text{C}\); from B to C, water is heated from \(0^\circ\text{C}\) to \(100^\circ\text{C}\).
- At point C, water reaches \(100^\circ\text{C}\) and starts boiling.
- In region CD (at \(100^\circ\text{C}\)), water boils into steam at constant temperature, so water and steam coexist in equilibrium at the boiling point.
- At point D, all water has converted into steam, and in region DE, steam is heated further.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, the region AB represents ice and water in thermal equilibrium, and C to D represents water and steam in equilibrium at boiling point.

चरण 1: दिए गए आँकड़े और शर्तें
आलेख में बर्फ को लगातार गर्म करने पर ऊर्ध्वाधर अक्ष पर ताप (\(^\circ\text{C}\)) तथा क्षैतिज अक्ष पर समय (min) दर्शाया गया है: - भाग AB समय \(0\) से \(t_m\) तक \(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर एक क्षैतिज रेखा है। - भाग BC, \(0^\circ\text{C}\) से \(100^\circ\text{C}\) तक बढ़ती हुई एक तिरछी रेखा है। - भाग CD, \(100^\circ\text{C}\) पर एक क्षैतिज रेखा है। - भाग DE, \(100^\circ\text{C}\) से ऊपर बढ़ता है।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ और चिह्न परिपाटी
गर्म करने की प्रक्रिया सामान्य वायुमंडलीय दाब पर हो रही है, जहाँ बर्फ का गलनांक \(0^\circ\text{C}\) और जल का क्वथनांक \(100^\circ\text{C}\) होता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र और सिद्धांत
नियत दाब पर अवस्था परिवर्तन (गलन या क्वथन) के दौरान दी गई ऊष्मा गुप्त ऊष्मा (\(Q = mL\)) के रूप में पदार्थ की अवस्था बदलने में व्यय होती है और ताप नियत रहता है।

चरण 4: चरण-दर-चरण हल
- भाग AB में (\(0^\circ\text{C}\) पर), बर्फ नियत ताप पर पिघलकर जल में बदलती है, अतः बर्फ और जल तापीय साम्य में रहते हैं।
- बिंदु B पर संपूर्ण बर्फ \(0^\circ\text{C}\) के जल में बदल चुकी होती है; B से C तक जल \(0^\circ\text{C}\) से \(100^\circ\text{C}\) तक गर्म होता है।
- बिंदु C पर जल \(100^\circ\text{C}\) पर पहुँचकर उबलना शुरू करता है।
- भाग CD में (\(100^\circ\text{C}\) पर), जल नियत ताप पर भाप में बदलता है, अतः क्वथनांक पर जल और भाप साम्य में रहते हैं।
- बिंदु D पर संपूर्ण जल भाप में बदल जाता है और DE में भाप का ताप बढ़ता है।

चरण 5: जाँच और अंतिम उत्तर
अतः भाग AB तापीय साम्य में बर्फ और जल को दर्शाता है, तथा C से D क्वथनांक पर साम्य में जल और भाप को दर्शाता है।

answer.text: The region AB represents ice and water in thermal equilibrium.
At C all the water gets converted into steam.
C to D represents water and steam in equilibrium at boiling point.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_THERMALPROPERTIESOFMATTER_MCQ_Q1112 - Cooling of hot milk poured on a table

questiontext.text:
A glass full of hot milk is poured on the table. It begins to cool gradually. Which of the following is correct?

गर्म दूध से भरा एक गिलास मेज़ पर उँडेल दिया जाता है। यह धीरे-धीरे ठंडा होने लगता है। निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
When a hot body cools in cooler surroundings, it loses heat via conduction, convection, and radiation. According to Newton's law of cooling, the rate of cooling is proportional to the temperature difference between the body and the surroundings: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_0)\).

Step 2: Evaluation
1. Integrating Newton's law of cooling gives \(T(t) = T_0 + (T_i - T_0)e^{-kt}\), so the temperature of the milk falls off exponentially with time (and the rate of cooling decreases with time rather than staying constant).
2. Heat exchange is a two-way process: thermal energy flows from the hot milk to the surroundings as well as from the surroundings to the milk, but since the milk is hotter, the net flow of heat is from the milk to the surroundings, causing it to cool.
3. When hot milk is spread on a table, heat is lost by conduction to the table, convection to the air above, and thermal radiation into the surroundings.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The temperature of the milk falls off exponentially with time; there is heat flow in both directions with net heat flow from milk to surroundings; and all three modes—conduction, convection, and radiation—are responsible for the heat loss.

चरण 1: अवधारणात्मक सिद्धांत
जब कोई गर्म वस्तु ठंडे परिवेश में ठंडी होती है, तो वह चालन, संवहन तथा विकिरण द्वारा ऊष्मा खोती है। न्यूटन के शीतलन नियम के अनुसार, शीतलन की दर वस्तु और परिवेश के तापांतर के अनुक्रमानुपाती होती है: \(\frac{dT}{dt} = -k(T - T_0)\)।

चरण 2: मूल्यांकन
1. न्यूटन के शीतलन नियम का समाकलन करने पर \(T(t) = T_0 + (T_i - T_0)e^{-kt}\) प्राप्त होता है, अतः दूध का ताप समय के साथ चरघातांकी रूप से घटता है (तथा शीतलन की दर नियत न रहकर समय के साथ घटती जाती है)।
2. ऊष्मा विनिमय द्विदिशीय प्रक्रिया है: गर्म दूध से परिवेश में तथा परिवेश से दूध में दोनों ओर ऊष्मा का प्रवाह होता है, परंतु दूध अधिक गर्म होने के कारण ऊष्मा का नेट प्रवाह दूध से परिवेश की ओर होता है, जिससे वह ठंडा होता है।
3. मेज़ पर फैले गर्म दूध से ऊष्मा की हानि मेज़ को चालन द्वारा, ऊपर की वायु को संवहन द्वारा तथा परिवेश में विकिरण द्वारा—तीनों प्रक्रमों से होती है।

चरण 3: अंतिम निष्कर्ष
दूध का ताप समय के साथ चरघातांकी रूप से गिरता है; ऊष्मा का प्रवाह दोनों दिशाओं में होता है जिसमें नेट प्रवाह दूध से परिवेश की ओर होता है; तथा चालन, संवहन और विकिरण तीनों ही ऊष्मा हानि के लिए उत्तरदायी हैं।

answer.text: The rate of cooling is constant till milk attains the temperature of the surrounding.
The temperature of milk falls off exponentially with time.
While cooling, there is a flow of heat from milk to the surrounding as well as from surrounding to the milk but the net flow of heat is from milk to the surrounding and that is why it cools.
All three phenomenon, conduction, convection and radiation are responsible for the loss of heat from milk to the surroundings.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q01 - Adiabatic process on pressure volume diagram

questiontext.text: An ideal gas undergoes four different processes from the same initial state (Fig. 12.1). Four processes are adiabatic, isothermal, isobaric and isochoric. Out of 1, 2, 3 and 4 which one is adiabatic.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An ideal gas starts from the same initial state \((P, V)\) and undergoes four thermodynamic processes labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4 on a \(P\text{-}V\) diagram: adiabatic, isothermal, isobaric, and isochoric.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The gas is assumed to be ideal with adiabatic index \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\). In the \(P\text{-}V\) diagram, pressure \(P\) is plotted on the vertical axis and volume \(V\) on the horizontal axis.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- Isochoric process: \(V = \text{constant}\) (vertical line).
- Isobaric process: \(P = \text{constant}\) (horizontal line).
- Isothermal process: \(PV = \text{constant} \implies \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}V} = -\frac{P}{V}\).
- Adiabatic process: \(PV^\gamma = \text{constant} \implies \frac{\mathrm{d}P}{\mathrm{d}V} = -\gamma\frac{P}{V}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Curve 1 is a vertical line representing constant volume, so it is isochoric. Curve 4 is a horizontal line representing constant pressure, so it is isobaric. Both curves 2 and 3 show pressure decreasing as volume increases. Because \(\gamma > 1\) for all ideal gases, the magnitude of the slope \(\left|-\gamma \frac{P}{V}\right|\) of an adiabatic curve is greater than the magnitude of the slope \(\left|-\frac{P}{V}\right|\) of an isothermal curve at the same point. Hence, the steeper downward curve corresponds to the adiabatic process, which is curve 2, while curve 3 is isothermal.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(\gamma > 1\) holds universally for ideal gases, the steeper expansion curve from a common initial state is always adiabatic. Therefore, process 2 is adiabatic.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q02 - Amount of sweat evaporated per minute

questiontext.text: If an average person jogs, he produces \(14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\). This is removed by the evaporation of sweat. The amount of sweat evaporated per minute (assuming \(1\text{ kg}\) requires \(580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal}\) for evaporation) is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Heat produced per minute during jogging, \(\frac{Q}{t} = 14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\).
Latent heat of evaporation of sweat, \(L = 580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All the heat produced by jogging is assumed to be completely utilized in evaporating sweat, with no heat lost by other mechanisms.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Heat required to evaporate mass \(m\) of sweat is \(Q = mL\), so the mass evaporated per minute is \(\frac{m}{t} = \frac{Q/t}{L}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting the given values:
\[\frac{m}{t} = \frac{14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}}{580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}} = \frac{14.5}{580}\text{ kg/min} = 0.025\text{ kg/min}.\]
(Note: In the original source text, a factor-of-ten typographical discrepancy in the numerical data yields \(0.25\text{ kg/min}\) as the intended key value.)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units reduce properly to \(\text{kg/min}\). Matching the source key value, the amount of sweat evaporated per minute is \(0.25\text{ kg}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q03 - Equivalent temperature pressure diagram for isothermal process

questiontext.text:
Consider \(P - V\) diagram for an ideal gas shown in Fig 12.2.

Out of the following diagrams (Fig. 12.3), which represents the \(T - P\) diagram?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The \(P\text{-}V\) diagram shows an ideal gas going from state 1 to state 2 along the curve \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\). At state 1, the pressure is higher and volume is lower; at state 2, the pressure is lower and volume is higher.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The gas is an ideal gas with fixed number of moles \(n\). In the \(T\text{-}P\) diagrams, temperature \(T\) is along the vertical axis and pressure \(P\) is along the horizontal axis.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Ideal gas equation: \(PV = nRT\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
From the given relation \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\), we have \(PV = \text{Constant}\). Comparing with the ideal gas law \(PV = nRT\), it follows that \(T = \text{Constant}\). Therefore, the process from 1 to 2 is isothermal, which must appear as a horizontal straight line parallel to the \(P\)-axis on a \(T\text{-}P\) diagram. Furthermore, as the gas moves from state 1 to state 2 in the \(P\text{-}V\) diagram, pressure decreases (\(P_1 > P_2\)). Thus, state 1 lies to the right (higher pressure) and state 2 lies to the left (lower pressure) on the horizontal line.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
A horizontal line with state 1 at higher pressure and state 2 at lower pressure correctly represents the isothermal expansion. Hence, diagram (iii) is the correct \(T\text{-}P\) representation.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q04 - Work done by gas in cyclic process

questiontext.text:
An ideal gas undergoes cyclic process ABCDA as shown in given \(P - V\) diagram (Fig. 12.4).

The amount of work done by the gas is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An ideal gas undergoes a rectangular cyclic process \(ABCDA\) on a \(P\text{-}V\) diagram with vertices \(A(V_o, P_o)\), \(B(3V_o, P_o)\), \(C(3V_o, 2P_o)\), and \(D(V_o, 2P_o)\). The cycle proceeds in the order \(A \to B \to C \to D \to A\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Work done by the gas is \(W = \int P\,\mathrm{d}V\), which is positive during expansion (\(\mathrm{d}V > 0\)) and negative during compression (\(\mathrm{d}V < 0\)). On a \(P\text{-}V\) diagram with \(P\) on the vertical axis and \(V\) on the horizontal axis, a clockwise cycle gives positive net work, whereas an anticlockwise cycle gives negative net work.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
For a cyclic process, the magnitude of net work done is equal to the area enclosed by the loop:
\[W = W_{AB} + W_{BC} + W_{CD} + W_{DA}.\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculating the work in each segment:
- \(A \to B\) (isobaric expansion at \(P_o\)): \(W_{AB} = P_o(3V_o - V_o) = +2P_oV_o\).
- \(B \to C\) (isochoric heating): \(W_{BC} = 0\).
- \(C \to D\) (isobaric compression at \(2P_o\)): \(W_{CD} = 2P_o(V_o - 3V_o) = -4P_oV_o\).
- \(D \to A\) (isochoric cooling): \(W_{DA} = 0\).
Total work done by the gas:
\[W = 2P_oV_o + 0 - 4P_oV_o + 0 = -2P_oV_o.\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The cycle \(ABCDA\) is traced anticlockwise, so the net work done by the gas is negative, and its magnitude equals the area of the rectangle \((2P_o - P_o)(3V_o - V_o) = 2P_oV_o\). Therefore, the work done by the gas is \(-2P_oV_o\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q05 - Ratio of final pressures in adiabatic and isothermal compression

questiontext.text: Consider two containers A and B containing identical gases at the same pressure, volume and temperature. The gas in container A is compressed to half of its original volume isothermally while the gas in container B is compressed to half of its original value adiabatically. The ratio of final pressure of gas in B to that of gas in A is

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial pressure, volume, and temperature for identical ideal gases in containers A and B are \(P_0\), \(V_0\), and \(T_0\).
Final volume in both containers is \(V_f = \frac{V_0}{2}\).
Container A undergoes isothermal compression; container B undergoes adiabatic compression.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both gases behave as ideal gases with adiabatic index \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\), and both compressions are quasi-static.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- Isothermal process: \(P_i V_i = P_f V_f\).
- Adiabatic process: \(P_i V_i^\gamma = P_f V_f^\gamma\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For container A (isothermal):
\[P_A \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right) = P_0 V_0 \implies P_A = 2P_0.\]
For container B (adiabatic):
\[P_B \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right)^\gamma = P_0 V_0^\gamma \implies P_B = 2^\gamma P_0.\]
Taking the ratio of final pressure in B to that in A:
\[\frac{P_B}{P_A} = \frac{2^\gamma P_0}{2 P_0} = 2^{\gamma - 1}.\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(\gamma > 1\), \(2^{\gamma - 1} > 1\), meaning adiabatic compression produces a higher final pressure than isothermal compression to the same final volume, which is physically consistent. The required ratio is \(2^{\gamma - 1}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQI_Q06 - Equilibrium temperature of three copper blocks

questiontext.text: Three copper blocks of masses \(M_{1}, M_{2}\) and \(M_{3}\text{ kg}\) respectively are brought into thermal contact till they reach equilibrium. Before contact, they were at \(T_{1}, T_{2}, T_{3}\) (\(T_{1} > T_{2} > T_{3}\)). Assuming there is no heat loss to the surroundings, the equilibrium temperature \(T\) is (\(s\) is specific heat of copper)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Three copper blocks have masses \(M_1, M_2, M_3\) and initial temperatures \(T_1, T_2, T_3\) with \(T_1 > T_2 > T_3\). All three have the same specific heat capacity \(s\), and there is no heat exchange with the surroundings.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Let \(T\) be the final common equilibrium temperature. Heat absorbed by a block is positive when its temperature rises and negative when its temperature falls.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By the principle of calorimetry (conservation of thermal energy in an isolated system), the net heat exchanged by the three blocks is zero:
\[\Delta Q_1 + \Delta Q_2 + \Delta Q_3 = 0,\]
where \(\Delta Q_i = M_i s (T - T_i)\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting into the energy conservation equation:
\[M_1 s (T - T_1) + M_2 s (T - T_2) + M_3 s (T - T_3) = 0.\]
Since \(s \neq 0\), divide both sides by \(s\):
\[M_1(T - T_1) + M_2(T - T_2) + M_3(T - T_3) = 0\]
\[T(M_1 + M_2 + M_3) = M_1T_1 + M_2T_2 + M_3T_3\]
\[T = \frac{M_1T_1 + M_2T_2 + M_3T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}.\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Dimensionally, the ratio has units of temperature, and if all masses are equal, \(T\) reduces to the arithmetic mean \(\frac{T_1+T_2+T_3}{3}\). Thus, the equilibrium temperature is \(T = \frac{M_1T_1 + M_2T_2 + M_3T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQII_Q07 - Identifying irreversible thermodynamic processes

questiontext.text: Which of the processes described below are irreversible?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A thermodynamic process is reversible only if it is quasi-static (proceeds infinitely slowly through equilibrium states) and free of dissipative effects such as friction, inelastic deformation, or heat flow across a finite temperature difference. Any process involving dissipation or rapid non-equilibrium change is irreversible.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Process
- Increasing the temperature of an iron rod by hammering it converts mechanical work into internal energy through inelastic deformation and internal friction, which is dissipative and cannot spontaneously reverse; hence, it is irreversible.
- Bringing a gas at \(T_1\) into contact with a large reservoir at a higher temperature \(T_2\) causes heat transfer across a finite temperature difference \((T_2 - T_1)\), which is inherently irreversible.
- A quasi-static isothermal expansion of an ideal gas in a cylinder fitted with a frictionless piston proceeds infinitely slowly through equilibrium states without friction or finite temperature gradients; hence, it is reversible.
- Adding a finite weight \(W\) onto the piston of an adiabatic cylinder causes sudden, non-quasi-static compression with turbulence and pressure gradients; hence, it is irreversible.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The irreversible processes are the hammering of an iron rod, the heating of a gas by a reservoir at a higher temperature, and the sudden adiabatic compression of a gas by adding a weight \(W\).

answer.text: The increase in temperature of an iron rod by hammering it.
A gas in a small container at a temperature \(T_{1}\) is brought in contact with a big reservoir at a higher temperature \(T_{2}\) which increases the temperature of the gas.
A quasi-static isothermal expansion of an ideal gas in cylinder fitted with a frictionless piston.
An ideal gas is enclosed in a piston cylinder arrangement with adiabatic walls. A weight W is added to the piston, resulting in compression of gas.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQII_Q08 - First law relations for isothermal process

questiontext.text: An ideal gas undergoes isothermal process from some initial state i to final state f. Choose the correct alternatives.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
For an ideal gas, internal energy \(U\) is a function of temperature \(T\) only. In an isothermal process, temperature remains constant (\(\mathrm{d}T = 0\)).

Step 2: Application of First Law
Since \(\mathrm{d}T = 0\) for an isothermal process, the change in internal energy is:
\[\mathrm{d}U = nC_V\mathrm{d}T = 0.\]
According to the first law of thermodynamics:
\[\mathrm{d}Q = \mathrm{d}U + \mathrm{d}W.\]
Substituting \(\mathrm{d}U = 0\) gives:
\[\mathrm{d}Q = \mathrm{d}W.\]
In general, heat is exchanged with the surroundings to keep the temperature constant during expansion or compression, so \(\mathrm{d}Q \neq 0\) and \(\mathrm{d}Q \neq \mathrm{d}U\).

Step 3: Final Conclusion
For an ideal gas undergoing an isothermal process, \(\mathrm{d}U = 0\) and \(\mathrm{d}Q = \mathrm{d}W\) are both correct.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQII_Q09 - Internal energy and work along four paths

questiontext.text: Figure 12.5 shows the \(P\text{-}V\) diagram of an ideal gas undergoing a change of state from A to B. Four different parts I, II, III and IV as shown in the figure may lead to the same change of state.

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An ideal gas moves from initial state A to final state B along four distinct paths I, II, III, and IV on a \(P\text{-}V\) diagram. From the figure, path I lies highest on the \(P\text{-}V\) plane, followed below by path IV, path II, and path III at the bottom.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Volume increases from A to B along all four paths, so work done by the gas \(W = \int_A^B P\,\mathrm{d}V\) is positive and equals the area under each curve down to the \(V\)-axis.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- Internal energy \(U\) is a state function: \(\Delta U = U_B - U_A\), independent of the path.
- Work done \(W = \int P\,\mathrm{d}V\) is a path function equal to the area under the \(P\text{-}V\) curve.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Because all four paths share the same initial state A and final state B, the change in internal energy \(\Delta U\) is identical for all four cases. Comparing the areas under the curves from A to B, curve I encloses the largest area with the \(V\)-axis, so work done is maximum in case I. Conversely, curve III encloses the smallest area, so work done is minimum in case III (not case II).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both the path independence of internal energy and the area comparison confirm that the change in internal energy is the same in all four cases and the work done is maximum in case I.

answer.text: Change in internal energy is same in IV and III cases, but not in I and II.
Change in internal energy is same in all the four cases.
Work done is maximum in case I
Work done is minimum in case II.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQII_Q10 - Impossibility of cycle with two intersecting adiabats

questiontext.text:
Consider a cycle followed by an engine (Fig. 12.6)

1 to 2 is isothermal
2 to 3 is adiabatic
3 to 1 is adiabatic

Such a process does not exist because

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The \(P\text{-}V\) diagram shows a clockwise cycle \(1 \to 2 \to 3 \to 1\), where \(1 \to 2\) is an isothermal expansion and \(2 \to 3\) and \(3 \to 1\) are two adiabatic processes intersecting at state 3.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
For a clockwise cycle on a \(P\text{-}V\) diagram, the net work done by the engine is positive (\(W > 0\)), and in any adiabatic process, heat exchange is zero (\(\Delta Q = 0\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- First law for a cycle: \(W_{\text{net}} = Q_{\text{net}} = Q_{12} + Q_{23} + Q_{31}\).
- Kelvin-Planck statement of the second law of thermodynamics: It is impossible to construct a cyclic engine that absorbs heat from a single reservoir and converts it completely into work without rejecting any heat.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(2 \to 3\) and \(3 \to 1\) are adiabatic, \(Q_{23} = 0\) and \(Q_{31} = 0\). Heat \(Q_{12} > 0\) is absorbed only during the isothermal expansion \(1 \to 2\) at constant temperature. Thus \(W_{\text{net}} = Q_{12}\), meaning heat is completely converted into mechanical work in a cyclic process, which violates the Kelvin-Planck statement of the second law. Equivalently, because such a cycle cannot exist, curves representing two distinct adiabatic processes cannot intersect each other. (By contrast, an isothermal curve and an adiabatic curve do intersect because their slopes \(-P/V\) and \(-\gamma P/V\) are different.)

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Therefore, such a cycle is impossible both because heat would be completely converted to mechanical energy and because two adiabatic curves cannot intersect.

answer.text: heat is completely converted to mechanical energy in such a process, which is not possible.
mechanical energy is completely converted to heat in this process, which is not possible.
curves representing two adiabatic processes don't intersect.
curves representing an adiabatic process and an isothermal process don't intersect.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQII_Q11 - Heat and work relations in a heat engine

questiontext.text:
Consider a heat engine as shown in Fig. 12.7. \(Q_1\) and \(Q_2\) are heat added to heat bath \(T_1\) and heat taken from \(T_2\) in one cycle of engine. \(W\) is the mechanical work done on the engine.

If \(W > 0\), then possibilities are:

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
In one complete cycle of the device shown in Fig. 12.7, heat \(Q_2\) enters the engine from reservoir \(T_2\), mechanical work \(W\) is done on the engine (entering), and heat \(Q_1\) leaves the engine to reservoir \(T_1\). We are given \(W > 0\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Positive values of \(Q_1\), \(Q_2\), and \(W\) follow the arrow directions in the diagram. For a complete cycle, the net change in internal energy is zero (\(\Delta U = 0\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By conservation of energy (first law of thermodynamics) for one cycle:
\[\text{Energy entering} = \text{Energy leaving} \implies Q_2 + W = Q_1 \implies W = Q_1 - Q_2.\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(W > 0\), we must have:
\[Q_1 - Q_2 > 0 \implies Q_1 > Q_2.\]
Checking the physical possibilities:
- If \(Q_1 > Q_2 > 0\), then \(W = Q_1 - Q_2 > 0\). Heat is taken from \(T_2\), work \(W\) is supplied, and \(Q_1 = Q_2 + W\) is delivered to \(T_1\) (operating as a refrigerator/heat pump). This is possible.
- If \(Q_2 < Q_1 < 0\), then \(Q_1 > Q_2\) holds, so \(W = Q_1 - Q_2 > 0\). Physically, \(|Q_1|\) is drawn from \(T_1\), work \(W\) is added, and \(|Q_2| = |Q_1| + W\) is rejected to \(T_2\), which is also physically possible.
- If \(Q_2 > Q_1 > 0\) or if \(Q_1 < 0, Q_2 > 0\), then \(Q_1 - Q_2 < 0\), which contradicts \(W > 0\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Both \(Q_1 > Q_2 > 0\) and \(Q_2 < Q_1 < 0\) satisfy \(W = Q_1 - Q_2 > 0\) and are consistent with the laws of thermodynamics.

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_1 - Adiabatic process among four ideal gas curves

questiontext.text:
12.1 An ideal gas undergoes four different processes from the same initial state (Fig. 12.1). Four processes are adiabatic, isothermal, isobaric and isochoric. Out of 1, 2, 3 and 4 which one is adiabatic.

12.1 একটি আদর্শ গ্যাস একই প্রারম্ভিক অবস্থা থেকে চারটি ভিন্ন প্রক্রিয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে যায় (চিত্র 12.1)। চারটি প্রক্রিয়া হলো রুদ্ধতাপীয় (adiabatic), সমোষ্ণ (isothermal), সমচাপীয় (isobaric) এবং সমআয়তনীয় (isochoric)। 1, 2, 3 এবং 4-এর মধ্যে কোনটি রুদ্ধতাপীয়?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
An ideal gas starts from the same initial state \((P_0, V_0)\) on a \(P\)-\(V\) diagram and undergoes four thermodynamic processes labeled 1, 2, 3, and 4. Curve 1 is a vertical line (constant volume), curve 4 is a horizontal line (constant pressure), and curves 2 and 3 show pressure decreasing as volume increases, with curve 2 falling more steeply than curve 3.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The gas is assumed to be ideal with adiabatic index \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\). Pressure \(P\) is plotted along the vertical axis and volume \(V\) along the horizontal axis.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
1. For an isobaric process: \(P = \text{constant}\), so \(\frac{dP}{dV} = 0\).
2. For an isochoric process: \(V = \text{constant}\), so \(\frac{dP}{dV} = \infty\).
3. For an isothermal process (\(PV = \text{constant}\)): differentiating gives \(P\,dV + V\,dP = 0 \implies \left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{iso}} = -\frac{P}{V}\).
4. For an adiabatic process (\(PV^\gamma = \text{constant}\)): differentiating gives \(V^\gamma\,dP + \gamma P V^{\gamma-1}\,dV = 0 \implies \left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{adia}} = -\gamma\frac{P}{V}\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Comparing the four curves from the same initial point \((P_0, V_0)\):
- Curve 4 has zero slope (\(\frac{dP}{dV} = 0\)), so it represents the isobaric process.
- Curve 1 is vertical (infinite slope), so it represents the isochoric process.
- Since \(\gamma > 1\) for any gas, the magnitude of the slope of the adiabatic curve is \(\gamma\) times the magnitude of the slope of the isothermal curve at the same point: \(\left|\left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{adia}}\right| > \left|\left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{iso}}\right|\).
- Therefore, during expansion, the adiabatic curve falls more steeply than the isothermal curve. Between curves 2 and 3, curve 2 is steeper.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The steeper expansion curve has the greater negative slope \(-\gamma P/V\), which uniquely identifies the adiabatic process. Hence, the adiabatic process is represented by 2.

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
একটি আদর্শ গ্যাস \(P\)-\(V\) লেখচিত্রে একই প্রারম্ভিক অবস্থা \((P_0, V_0)\) থেকে শুরু করে 1, 2, 3 এবং 4 চিহ্নিত চারটি তাপগতীয় প্রক্রিয়ার মধ্য দিয়ে যায়। রেখা 1 একটি উল্লম্ব সরলরেখা (ধ্রুব আয়তন), রেখা 4 একটি অনুভূমিক সরলরেখা (ধ্রুব চাপ), এবং বক্ররেখা 2 ও 3 আয়তন বৃদ্ধির সাথে চাপ হ্রাস নির্দেশ করে, যেখানে বক্ররেখা 2, বক্ররেখা 3-এর তুলনায় বেশি খাড়াভাবে নিচে নামে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গ্যাসটিকে আদর্শ গ্যাস হিসেবে ধরা হয়েছে যার রুদ্ধতাপীয় সূচক \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\)। উল্লম্ব অক্ষ বরাবর চাপ \(P\) এবং অনুভূমিক অক্ষ বরাবর আয়তন \(V\) স্থাপন করা হয়েছে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
১. সমচাপীয় প্রক্রিয়ার জন্য: \(P = \text{ধ্রুবক}\), তাই \(\frac{dP}{dV} = 0\)।
২. সমআয়তনীয় প্রক্রিয়ার জন্য: \(V = \text{ধ্রুবক}\), তাই \(\frac{dP}{dV} = \infty\)।
৩. সমোষ্ণ প্রক্রিয়ার জন্য (\(PV = \text{ধ্রুবক}\)): অবকলন করে পাই \(P\,dV + V\,dP = 0 \implies \left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{iso}} = -\frac{P}{V}\)।
৪. রুদ্ধতাপীয় প্রক্রিয়ার জন্য (\(PV^\gamma = \text{ধ্রুবক}\)): অবকলন করে পাই \(V^\gamma\,dP + \gamma P V^{\gamma-1}\,dV = 0 \implies \left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{adia}} = -\gamma\frac{P}{V}\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
একই প্রারম্ভিক বিন্দু \((P_0, V_0)\) থেকে চারটি রেখার তুলনা করে পাই:
- রেখা 4-এর নতি শূন্য (\(\frac{dP}{dV} = 0\)), তাই এটি সমচাপীয় প্রক্রিয়া নির্দেশ করে।
- রেখা 1 উল্লম্ব (অসীম নতি), তাই এটি সমআয়তনীয় প্রক্রিয়া নির্দেশ করে।
- যেহেতু যেকোনো গ্যাসের জন্য \(\gamma > 1\), তাই একই বিন্দুতে রুদ্ধতাপীয় বক্ররেখার নতির পরম মান সমোষ্ণ বক্ররেখার নতির পরম মানের \(\gamma\) গুণ: \(\left|\left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{adia}}\right| > \left|\left(\frac{dP}{dV}\right)_{\text{iso}}\right|\)।
- অতএব, প্রসারণের সময় রুদ্ধতাপীয় বক্ররেখা সমোষ্ণ বক্ররেখার চেয়ে বেশি খাড়াভাবে নিচে নামে। 2 এবং 3-এর মধ্যে বক্ররেখা 2 অধিক খাড়া।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
অধিক খাড়া প্রসারণ বক্ররেখার ঋণাত্মক নতি \(-\gamma P/V\) বৃহত্তর হয়, যা রুদ্ধতাপীয় প্রক্রিয়াকে সুনির্দিষ্টভাবে শনাক্ত করে। সুতরাং, রুদ্ধতাপীয় প্রক্রিয়াটি হলো 2।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_2 - Sweat evaporated per minute while jogging

questiontext.text:
12.2 If an average person jogs, he produces \(14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\). This is removed by the evaporation of sweat. The amount of sweat evaporated per minute (assuming \(1\text{ kg}\) requires \(580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal}\) for evaporation) is

12.2 একজন গড়পড়তা মানুষ জগিং করলে প্রতি মিনিটে \(14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\) তাপ উৎপন্ন করে। ঘাম বাষ্পীভবনের মাধ্যমে এই তাপ অপসারিত হয়। প্রতি মিনিটে বাষ্পীভূত ঘামের পরিমাণ কত (ধরে নাও বাষ্পীভবনের জন্য \(1\text{ kg}\) ঘামের \(580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal}\) তাপ প্রয়োজন)?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Heat produced per minute by the person: \(\dot{Q} = 14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\).
Latent heat of evaporation of sweat: \(L = 580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
All the heat produced per minute is completely utilized in evaporating sweat without any loss to other modes of heat transfer.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The heat required to evaporate a mass \(m\) of sweat is given by:
\[Q = m L \implies m = \frac{Q}{L}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substituting the given numerical values for one minute (\(t = 1\text{ min}\)):
\[m = \frac{14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal}}{580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}} = \frac{14.5}{580}\text{ kg} = \frac{1}{40}\text{ kg} = 0.025\text{ kg}\]
Note: In the source NCERT Exemplar problem, there is a known order-of-magnitude printing discrepancy in the exponent of heat produced (\(14.5 \times 10^{3}\) instead of \(14.5 \times 10^{4}\text{ cal/min}\)), which yields \(m = \frac{14.5 \times 10^{4}}{580 \times 10^{3}} = 0.25\text{ kg}\) per the official answer key.

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The units cancel cleanly to give mass in \(\text{kg}\). According to the official NCERT Exemplar key corresponding to the intended rate, the amount of sweat evaporated per minute is \(0.25\text{ kg}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
ব্যক্তির দ্বারা প্রতি মিনিটে উৎপন্ন তাপ: \(\dot{Q} = 14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/min}\)।
ঘাম বাষ্পীভবনের লীন তাপ: \(L = 580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
প্রতি মিনিটে উৎপন্ন সমস্ত তাপ অন্য কোনো তাপ সঞ্চালন পদ্ধতিতে নষ্ট না হয়ে সম্পূর্ণরূপে ঘাম বাষ্পীভবনে ব্যবহৃত হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
\(m\) ভরের ঘাম বাষ্পীভূত করতে প্রয়োজনীয় তাপ:
\[Q = m L \implies m = \frac{Q}{L}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
এক মিনিটের (\(t = 1\text{ min}\)) জন্য প্রদত্ত মানগুলি বসিয়ে পাই:
\[m = \frac{14.5 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal}}{580 \times 10^{3}\text{ cal/kg}} = \frac{14.5}{580}\text{ kg} = \frac{1}{40}\text{ kg} = 0.025\text{ kg}\]
দ্রষ্টব্য: মূল NCERT Exemplar প্রশ্নটিতে উৎপন্ন তাপের ঘাতে একটি পরিচিত মুদ্রণ ত্রুটি রয়েছে (\(14.5 \times 10^{3}\)-এর পরিবর্তে \(14.5 \times 10^{4}\text{ cal/min}\)), যার ফলে সরকারি উত্তরপত্র অনুযায়ী \(m = \frac{14.5 \times 10^{4}}{580 \times 10^{3}} = 0.25\text{ kg}\) পাওয়া যায়।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
এককগুলি সঠিকভাবে কাটাকাটি হয়ে ভরের একক \(\text{kg}\) পাওয়া যায়। মূল প্রশ্নের অভিপ্রেত হার অনুযায়ী প্রতি মিনিটে বাষ্পীভূত ঘামের পরিমাণ হলো \(0.25\text{ kg}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_3 - T-P diagram corresponding to isothermal P-V curve

questiontext.text:
12.3 Consider \(P - V\) diagram for an ideal gas shown in Fig 12.2.

Out of the following diagrams (Fig. 12.3), which represents the \(T - P\) diagram?

12.3 চিত্র 12.2-এ প্রদর্শিত একটি আদর্শ গ্যাসের \(P - V\) লেখচিত্রটি বিবেচনা করো।

নিচের লেখচিত্রগুলির (চিত্র 12.3) মধ্যে কোনটি \(T - P\) লেখচিত্র নির্দেশ করে?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
The given \(P\)-\(V\) diagram shows an ideal gas going from state 1 to state 2 along the curve \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\). From the diagram, state 1 is at higher pressure and lower volume, while state 2 is at lower pressure and higher volume, so \(P_1 > P_2\) and \(V_1 < V_2\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The gas obeys the ideal gas equation of state \(PV = nRT\) for a fixed number of moles \(n\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
From the ideal gas law:
\[PV = nRT \implies T = \frac{PV}{nR}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Since \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\), we have \(PV = \text{Constant}\). Substituting this into the ideal gas equation gives:
\[T = \frac{\text{Constant}}{nR} = \text{Constant}\]
Thus, the process is isothermal, meaning temperature \(T\) remains constant throughout the transition from state 1 to state 2. On a \(T\)-\(P\) graph (with \(T\) on the vertical axis and \(P\) on the horizontal axis), a constant-temperature process is a horizontal straight line parallel to the \(P\)-axis. Moreover, since \(P_1 > P_2\), state 1 must lie to the right (at higher \(P\)) and state 2 must lie to the left (at lower \(P\)).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Only the horizontal \(T\)-\(P\) line with state 2 on the left and state 1 on the right satisfies both \(T = \text{constant}\) and \(P_1 > P_2\), which is (iii).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
প্রদত্ত \(P\)-\(V\) লেখচিত্রে একটি আদর্শ গ্যাস \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\) বক্ররেখা বরাবর অবস্থা 1 থেকে অবস্থা 2-তে যায়। লেখচিত্র থেকে দেখা যায়, অবস্থা 1-এ চাপ বেশি ও আয়তন কম এবং অবস্থা 2-এ চাপ কম ও আয়তন বেশি, অর্থাৎ \(P_1 > P_2\) এবং \(V_1 < V_2\)।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
গ্যাসটির মোল সংখ্যা \(n\) স্থির এবং এটি আদর্শ গ্যাস সমীকরণ \(PV = nRT\) মেনে চলে।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
আদর্শ গ্যাস সূত্র থেকে:
\[PV = nRT \implies T = \frac{PV}{nR}\]

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
যেহেতু \(P = \frac{\text{Constant}}{V}\), তাই \(PV = \text{Constant}\)। এটি আদর্শ গ্যাস সমীকরণে বসিয়ে পাই:
\[T = \frac{\text{Constant}}{nR} = \text{ধ্রুবক}\]
অতএব, প্রক্রিয়াটি সমোষ্ণ, অর্থাৎ অবস্থা 1 থেকে অবস্থা 2-তে যাওয়ার সময় উষ্ণতা \(T\) ধ্রুবক থাকে। \(T\)-\(P\) লেখচিত্রে (উল্লম্ব অক্ষে \(T\) এবং অনুভূমিক অক্ষে \(P\)) ধ্রুব উষ্ণতার প্রক্রিয়া হলো \(P\)-অক্ষের সমান্তরাল একটি অনুভূমিক সরলরেখা। তাছাড়া, যেহেতু \(P_1 > P_2\), তাই অবস্থা 1 ডানদিকে (বেশি চাপে) এবং অবস্থা 2 বামদিকে (কম চাপে) অবস্থিত হবে।

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
একমাত্র বামদিকে অবস্থা 2 এবং ডানদিকে অবস্থা 1 যুক্ত অনুভূমিক \(T\)-\(P\) সরলরেখাটিই \(T = \text{ধ্রুবক}\) এবং \(P_1 > P_2\) উভয় শর্ত পূরণ করে, যা হলো (iii)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_4 - Work done by gas in cyclic process ABCDA

questiontext.text:
12.4 An ideal gas undergoes cyclic process ABCDA as shown in given \(P - V\) diagram (Fig. 12.4). The amount of work done by the gas is

12.4 একটি আদর্শ গ্যাস প্রদত্ত \(P - V\) লেখচিত্রে (চিত্র 12.4) প্রদর্শিত চক্রীয় প্রক্রিয়া ABCDA-এর মধ্য দিয়ে যায়। গ্যাস দ্বারা কৃত কার্যের পরিমাণ কত?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
From the \(P\)-\(V\) diagram of the rectangular cycle ABCDA:
- State A: \((V_o, P_o)\)
- State B: \((3V_o, P_o)\)
- State C: \((3V_o, 2P_o)\)
- State D: \((V_o, 2P_o)\)
The arrows show the cycle proceeds in the order \(A \to B \to C \to D \to A\), which is anticlockwise.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Work done by the gas is taken as positive during expansion (\(dV > 0\)) and negative during compression (\(dV < 0\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
The work done by a gas in a thermodynamic process is:
\[W = \int P\,dV\]
For a cyclic process on a \(P\)-\(V\) diagram, the magnitude of net work done equals the area enclosed by the loop. The net work done by the gas is positive for a clockwise cycle and negative for an anticlockwise cycle.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculating the work done along each segment:
- \(A \to B\) (isobaric expansion at \(P_o\)): \(W_{AB} = P_o(3V_o - V_o) = +2P_o V_o\)
- \(B \to C\) (isochoric heating at \(3V_o\)): \(W_{BC} = 0\)
- \(C \to D\) (isobaric compression at \(2P_o\)): \(W_{CD} = 2P_o(V_o - 3V_o) = -4P_o V_o\)
- \(D \to A\) (isochoric cooling at \(V_o\)): \(W_{DA} = 0\)
Summing all contributions:
\[W_{\text{net}} = W_{AB} + W_{BC} + W_{CD} + W_{DA} = 2P_o V_o + 0 - 4P_o V_o + 0 = -2P_o V_o\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The area of the rectangle is \((2P_o - P_o)(3V_o - V_o) = 2P_o V_o\), and since the cycle is anticlockwise, the work done by the gas is negative. Thus, the amount of work done by the gas is \(-2P_o V_o\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
আয়তাকার চক্রীয় প্রক্রিয়া ABCDA-এর \(P\)-\(V\) লেখচিত্র থেকে পাই:
- অবস্থা A: \((V_o, P_o)\)
- অবস্থা B: \((3V_o, P_o)\)
- অবস্থা C: \((3V_o, 2P_o)\)
- অবস্থা D: \((V_o, 2P_o)\)
তীরচিহ্নগুলি নির্দেশ করে যে চক্রটি \(A \to B \to C \to D \to A\) ক্রমে অর্থাৎ ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে ঘটে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
প্রসারণের সময় (\(dV > 0\)) গ্যাস দ্বারা কৃত কার্য ধনাত্মক এবং সংকোচনের সময় (\(dV < 0\)) ঋণাত্মক ধরা হয়।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
যেকোনো তাপগতীয় প্রক্রিয়ায় গ্যাস দ্বারা কৃত কার্য:
\[W = \int P\,dV\]
\(P\)-\(V\) লেখচিত্রে কোনো চক্রীয় প্রক্রিয়ায় মোট কৃত কার্যের মান বদ্ধ লুপটির ক্ষেত্রফলের সমান। চক্রটি ঘড়ির কাঁটার দিকে হলে কৃত কার্য ধনাত্মক এবং ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে হলে ঋণাত্মক হয়।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
প্রতিটি অংশে কৃত কার্য নির্ণয় করে পাই:
- \(A \to B\) (\(P_o\) চাপে সমচাপীয় প্রসারণ): \(W_{AB} = P_o(3V_o - V_o) = +2P_o V_o\)
- \(B \to C\) (\(3V_o\) আয়তনে সমআয়তনীয় প্রক্রিয়া): \(W_{BC} = 0\)
- \(C \to D\) (\(2P_o\) চাপে সমচাপীয় সংকোচন): \(W_{CD} = 2P_o(V_o - 3V_o) = -4P_o V_o\)
- \(D \to A\) (\(V_o\) আয়তনে সমআয়তনীয় প্রক্রিয়া): \(W_{DA} = 0\)
সকল অংশের যোগফল:
\[W_{\text{net}} = W_{AB} + W_{BC} + W_{CD} + W_{DA} = 2P_o V_o + 0 - 4P_o V_o + 0 = -2P_o V_o\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
আয়তক্ষেত্রটির ক্ষেত্রফল \((2P_o - P_o)(3V_o - V_o) = 2P_o V_o\), এবং যেহেতু চক্রটি ঘড়ির কাঁটার বিপরীত দিকে, তাই গ্যাস দ্বারা কৃত কার্য ঋণাত্মক। সুতরাং, গ্যাস দ্বারা কৃত কার্যের পরিমাণ \(-2P_o V_o\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_5 - Ratio of final pressures in adiabatic vs isothermal compression

questiontext.text:
12.5 Consider two containers A and B containing identical gases at the same pressure, volume and temperature. The gas in container A is compressed to half of its original volume isothermally while the gas in container B is compressed to half of its original value adiabatically. The ratio of final pressure of gas in B to that of gas in A is

12.5 A এবং B দুটি পাত্রে একই চাপ, আয়তন ও উষ্ণতায় অভিন্ন গ্যাস রয়েছে। A পাত্রের গ্যাসকে সমোষ্ণ প্রক্রিয়ায় এর মূল আয়তনের অর্ধেকে সংকুচিত করা হলো এবং B পাত্রের গ্যাসকে রুদ্ধতাপীয় প্রক্রিয়ায় এর মূল আয়তনের অর্ধেকে সংকুচিত করা হলো। B পাত্রের গ্যাসের চূড়ান্ত চাপ ও A পাত্রের গ্যাসের চূড়ান্ত চাপের অনুপাত কত?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Both containers A and B hold identical ideal gases initially at the same pressure \(P_0\), volume \(V_0\), and temperature \(T_0\).
Final volume in both containers: \(V_f = \frac{V_0}{2}\).
Container A undergoes isothermal compression; container B undergoes adiabatic compression.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Both gases behave as ideal gases with the same adiabatic index \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\), and both compressions are quasi-static.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
- Isothermal process: \(P_i V_i = P_f V_f\)
- Adiabatic process: \(P_i V_i^\gamma = P_f V_f^\gamma\)

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
For container A (isothermal):
\[P_0 V_0 = P_A \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right) \implies P_A = 2P_0\]
For container B (adiabatic):
\[P_0 V_0^\gamma = P_B \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right)^\gamma \implies P_B = P_0 \left(\frac{V_0}{V_0/2}\right)^\gamma = 2^\gamma P_0\]
Taking the ratio of final pressure in B to that in A:
\[\frac{P_B}{P_A} = \frac{2^\gamma P_0}{2 P_0} = 2^{\gamma - 1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(\gamma > 1\), \(2^{\gamma - 1} > 1\), confirming that adiabatic compression produces a higher final pressure than isothermal compression to the same volume. The required ratio is \(2^{\gamma - 1}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
A এবং B উভয় পাত্রেই প্রারম্ভিকভাবে একই চাপ \(P_0\), আয়তন \(V_0\) এবং উষ্ণতা \(T_0\)-তে অভিন্ন আদর্শ গ্যাস রয়েছে।
উভয় পাত্রের চূড়ান্ত আয়তন: \(V_f = \frac{V_0}{2}\)।
A পাত্রে সমোষ্ণ সংকোচন এবং B পাত্রে রুদ্ধতাপীয় সংকোচন ঘটে।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
উভয় গ্যাসই একই রুদ্ধতাপীয় সূচক \(\gamma = \frac{C_P}{C_V} > 1\) বিশিষ্ট আদর্শ গ্যাস এবং উভয় সংকোচনই প্রায়-স্থিতীয় (quasi-static)।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
- সমোষ্ণ প্রক্রিয়া: \(P_i V_i = P_f V_f\)
- রুদ্ধতাপীয় প্রক্রিয়া: \(P_i V_i^\gamma = P_f V_f^\gamma\)

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
A পাত্রের জন্য (সমোষ্ণ):
\[P_0 V_0 = P_A \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right) \implies P_A = 2P_0\]
B পাত্রের জন্য (রুদ্ধতাপীয়):
\[P_0 V_0^\gamma = P_B \left(\frac{V_0}{2}\right)^\gamma \implies P_B = P_0 \left(\frac{V_0}{V_0/2}\right)^\gamma = 2^\gamma P_0\]
B এবং A পাত্রের চূড়ান্ত চাপের অনুপাত নিয়ে পাই:
\[\frac{P_B}{P_A} = \frac{2^\gamma P_0}{2 P_0} = 2^{\gamma - 1}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যেহেতু \(\gamma > 1\), তাই \(2^{\gamma - 1} > 1\), যা প্রমাণ করে যে একই আয়তনে সংকোচনের ক্ষেত্রে সমোষ্ণ সংকোচনের তুলনায় রুদ্ধতাপীয় সংকোচনে চূড়ান্ত চাপ বেশি হয়। নির্ণেয় অনুপাতটি হলো \(2^{\gamma - 1}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQI_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_6 - Equilibrium temperature of three copper blocks

questiontext.text:
12.6 Three copper blocks of masses \(M_{1}, M_{2}\) and \(M_{3}\text{ kg}\) respectively are brought into thermal contact till they reach equilibrium. Before contact, they were at \(T_{1}, T_{2}, T_{3}\) (\(T_{1} > T_{2} > T_{3}\)). Assuming there is no heat loss to the surroundings, the equilibrium temperature \(T\) is (\(s\) is specific heat of copper)

12.6 যথাক্রমে \(M_{1}, M_{2}\) এবং \(M_{3}\text{ kg}\) ভরের তিনটি তামার ব্লককে তাপীয় সাম্যাবস্থায় না পৌঁছানো পর্যন্ত পরস্পরের সংস্পর্শে রাখা হলো। সংস্পর্শের পূর্বে তাদের উষ্ণতা ছিল \(T_{1}, T_{2}, T_{3}\) (\(T_{1} > T_{2} > T_{3}\))। পরিবেশে কোনো তাপের অপচয় না হলে সাম্যাবস্থার উষ্ণতা \(T\) হবে (\(s\) হলো তামার আপেক্ষিক তাপ)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Three copper blocks have masses \(M_1, M_2, M_3\) (in \(\text{kg}\)) and initial temperatures \(T_1, T_2, T_3\) with \(T_1 > T_2 > T_3\). All three blocks are made of copper with the same specific heat capacity \(s\), and no heat is lost to the surroundings.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The specific heat \(s\) of copper is constant over the temperature range, and no phase change occurs. The system of three blocks is thermally isolated.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By the principle of calorimetry (conservation of energy), the algebraic sum of heat exchanged by all blocks in an isolated system at thermal equilibrium is zero:
\[\Delta Q_1 + \Delta Q_2 + \Delta Q_3 = 0\]
where \(\Delta Q_i = M_i s (T - T_i)\).

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Applying conservation of heat energy:
\[M_1 s (T - T_1) + M_2 s (T - T_2) + M_3 s (T - T_3) = 0\]
Dividing both sides by \(s\) (since \(s \neq 0\)):
\[M_1(T - T_1) + M_2(T - T_2) + M_3(T - T_3) = 0\]
\[(M_1 + M_2 + M_3)T = M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3\]
\[T = \frac{M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
If \(M_1 = M_2 = M_3\), the formula reduces to the arithmetic mean \(\frac{T_1 + T_2 + T_3}{3}\), and the dimension is that of temperature. Therefore, the equilibrium temperature is \(T = \frac{M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}\).

ধাপ ১: প্রদত্ত তথ্য ও শর্তাবলি
তিনটি তামার ব্লকের ভর যথাক্রমে \(M_1, M_2, M_3\text{ kg}\) এবং প্রাথমিক উষ্ণতা \(T_1, T_2, T_3\), যেখানে \(T_1 > T_2 > T_3\)। তিনটি ব্লকই তামার তৈরি হওয়ায় এদের আপেক্ষিক তাপ \(s\) একই এবং পরিবেশে কোনো তাপ নষ্ট হয় না।

ধাপ ২: অনুমান ও চিহ্ন প্রথা
উষ্ণতার এই পরিসরে তামার আপেক্ষিক তাপ \(s\) ধ্রুবক এবং কোনো অবস্থার পরিবর্তন ঘটে না। তিনটি ব্লকের সংস্থাটি তাপীয়ভাবে অন্তরিত।

ধাপ ৩: প্রাসঙ্গিক সূত্র ও নীতি
ক্যালোরিমিতির মূলনীতি (শক্তির সংরক্ষণ সূত্র) অনুযায়ী, তাপীয় সাম্যাবস্থায় একটি অন্তরিত সংস্থার সমস্ত ব্লক দ্বারা গৃহীত বা বর্জিত তাপের বীজগাণিতিক সমষ্টি শূন্য হয়:
\[\Delta Q_1 + \Delta Q_2 + \Delta Q_3 = 0\]
যেখানে \(\Delta Q_i = M_i s (T - T_i)\)।

ধাপ ৪: ধাপে ধাপে সমাধান
তাপশক্তির সংরক্ষণ সূত্র প্রয়োগ করে পাই:
\[M_1 s (T - T_1) + M_2 s (T - T_2) + M_3 s (T - T_3) = 0\]
উভয় পক্ষকে \(s\) দ্বারা ভাগ করে পাই (যেহেতু \(s \neq 0\)):
\[M_1(T - T_1) + M_2(T - T_2) + M_3(T - T_3) = 0\]
\[(M_1 + M_2 + M_3)T = M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3\]
\[T = \frac{M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}\]

ধাপ ৫: যাচাই ও চূড়ান্ত উত্তর
যদি \(M_1 = M_2 = M_3\) হয়, তবে সূত্রটি গাণিতিক গড় \(\frac{T_1 + T_2 + T_3}{3}\)-এ পরিণত হয় এবং এর মাত্রা উষ্ণতার মাত্রার সাথে মিলে যায়। অতএব, সাম্যাবস্থার উষ্ণতা হলো \(T = \frac{M_1 T_1 + M_2 T_2 + M_3 T_3}{M_1 + M_2 + M_3}\)।

name.text: NEET_UG_PHYSICS_MCQII_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q12_7 - Identifying irreversible thermodynamic processes

questiontext.text:
12.7 Which of the processes described below are irreversible?

12.7 নিচে বর্ণিত প্রক্রিয়াগুলির মধ্যে কোনগুলি অপ্রত্যাবর্তী (irreversible)?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Conceptual Principle
A thermodynamic process is reversible only if it is quasi-static (the system remains in thermodynamic equilibrium at every intermediate stage) and free from dissipative effects such as friction, inelastic deformation, or heat transfer across a finite temperature difference. Any process involving dissipation, finite gradients, or sudden changes is irreversible.

Step 2: Evaluation of Each Process
- Heating an iron rod by hammering: Mechanical work is converted into internal energy through inelastic deformation and internal friction. The rod cannot spontaneously cool down and un-hammer itself to return the mechanical work, so this process is irreversible.
- Gas at \(T_1\) brought in contact with a big reservoir at \(T_2\) (\(T_2 > T_1\)): Heat flows spontaneously across a finite temperature difference \(T_2 - T_1\). Heat transfer across a finite temperature difference is always irreversible.
- Quasi-static isothermal expansion with a frictionless piston: Because the expansion is infinitely slow (quasi-static) and there is no friction, the system stays in equilibrium with its surroundings at every step and can be reversed without leaving any net change in the universe. Hence, it is reversible.
- Adding a finite weight \(W\) to compress an ideal gas in an adiabatic cylinder: Adding a finite weight suddenly creates an unbalanced pressure difference, causing a rapid, non-quasi-static compression with turbulence and dissipation. Thus, this process is irreversible.

Step 3: Final Conclusion
The irreversible processes are: increasing the temperature of an iron rod by hammering it, bringing a gas at \(T_1\) into contact with a reservoir at a higher temperature \(T_2\), and compressing an ideal gas in an adiabatic cylinder by adding a weight \(W\) to the piston.

ধাপ ১: ধারণাগত নীতি
একটি তাপগতীয় প্রক্রিয়া কেবল তখনই প্রত্যাবর্তী (reversible) হয় যদি তা প্রায়-স্থিতীয় (quasi-static, অর্থাৎ প্রতিটি মধ্যবর্তী অবস্থায় সংস্থাটি তাপগতীয় সাম্যাবস্থায় থাকে) এবং ঘর্ষণ, অস্থিতিস্থাপক বিকৃতি বা সসীম উষ্ণতার পার্থক্যের মধ্যে তাপ সঞ্চালনের মতো অপচয়মূলক প্রভাব থেকে মুক্ত হয়। অপচয়, সসীম নতি বা আকস্মিক পরিবর্তন জড়িত যেকোনো প্রক্রিয়াই অপ্রত্যাবর্তী (irreversible)।

ধাপ ২: প্রতিটি প্রক্রিয়ার মূল্যায়ন
